translation_method: Independently translated and reviewed as complete units against revision-locked English campaign journals and BBMOD game terms.

units.source: The game has changed a lot since v1.1.0.8, when the first version of this guide was written. Looking back, I felt embarrassed by my cheap exploits of olde, and decided to totally re-write it to reflect the current state of my exploitation of game mechanics (just in time for everything to be altered by the next DLC).
units.zh: 【译注：本文保留作者写作时的版本机制与战术经验。】本攻略初版写于 v1.1.0.8，自那以后，游戏发生了很大变化。回头看，我都为当年那些廉价钻空子的招数感到羞愧，于是决定彻底重写，介绍这次重写时我又怎样利用游戏机制——刚好赶在下一个 DLC 把一切再改一遍之前。

units.source: Shield-swapping and cheating fatigue recovery with orcish items are things of the past, but Quick Hands and the ability to cycle potent combinations of fatigue-intensive skills (via Adrenaline and Recover) are still very distinctive features of the overall build.
units.zh: 来回换盾、利用兽人装备钻疲劳恢复的空子，都已成为过去。不过，快手，以及借助肾上腺素和恢复体力循环使用高疲劳消耗的强力技能组合，仍是整套配置的鲜明特点。

units.source: The build now features a greater variety of niche roles (many of them, however, with ample room for overlap). Most of them require masses of fatigue (and I predominantly recruit from high-fatigue backgrounds), but some of them are fatigue-neutral or initiative-based.
units.zh: 这次的配置包含更多专门分工，不过不少角色之间仍有很大的重叠空间。多数角色需要极高的疲劳上限，所以我主要招募疲劳上限较高的背景；也有一些角色追求疲劳收支平衡，或者围绕先攻来培养。

units.source: The introduction of the new form of the Nimble perk has made it easier to combine a high usable pool of fatigue with strong innate protection against injuries, and some of the rare Nimble-worthy armours (e.g. nightcloaks and steppe helms) offer amazing 200+ durability. With the addition of Light Padding Replacement, some heavier rare body-armours (even ones with ~300 durability) can become Nimble-worthy in combination with an efficient helm. Obviously, so much combined armour and Nimbleness synergizes very well with Indomitable! (In times past, I was happy enough to combine 150-240 armours with a plentiful pool of fatigue, high HPs, generous Indomitable usage, and no innate damage-reduction!)
units.zh: 新版轻灵让大量可用疲劳与强大的抗伤势能力更容易兼得。一些适合轻灵的名贵护甲，例如夜幕披衣和草原盔，耐久甚至能达到惊人的 200+。加上轻型替换衬垫后，一些较重的名贵身甲，甚至耐久约 300 的款式，也能搭配合适的头盔用于轻灵。显然，如此高的护甲和轻灵减伤，与不屈相得益彰！想当年，我只要有 150-240 的护甲、充足的可用疲劳、较高生命值，能频繁用不屈，就已经很满足了，根本没有额外的固有减伤！

units.source: Usually my companies have only a very limited number of members who combine exceptional values of both melee skill and melee defence. Recruiting someone with mega-talent for both (while still needing a significant investment to make several other stats meet my standards of well-roundedness) often causes me more anxiety than excitement. Most of my characters are designed to max out only one of them, taking only high rolls for the other. High HPs (almost always with Colossus) are desirable on everyone. High fatigue is even more desirable on the ones who aren’t mostly fatigue-neutral or initiative-based. Additionally, I have a bad conscience about making use of anyone (even an archer) who isn’t (by level 11) at least 50% enthusiastic about charging around in the mud amid pieces of sharp/blunt metal and shower-storms of blood.
units.zh: 我的战团里，近战命中与近战防御同时出众的人通常很少。招到这两项都天赋惊人的人，我往往焦虑多于兴奋，因为还得投入不少成长，才能让其他属性也达到我要求的均衡标准。我的大多数角色只会全力提高其中一项，另一项只在成长值高时才加。人人都需要较高生命值，几乎都会选巨人体魄；而那些不以疲劳收支平衡或先攻为核心的角色，更需要高疲劳上限。另外，如果某人到了 11 级，对在泥地、锋刃钝器和瓢泼血雨中冲锋连 50% 的热情都没有，哪怕他是弓手，我用起来也会良心不安。

units.source: With a mixture of predominantly offensive and predominantly defensive characters, a small handful of heroic or devious utilitarian ones, a bit of careful positioning and the timely application of powerful skills, every fight in the game can be beaten with level 11 stats (but heavy casualties may be incurred at the most challenging legendary locations) ...
units.zh: 把偏重进攻与偏重防御的角色搭配起来，再配上少数英勇或狡诈的多面手，谨慎站位，及时施放强力技能，仅凭 11 级的属性就能赢下游戏中的所有战斗。不过，挑战最难的传奇地点时，仍可能伤亡惨重……

units.source: The individual character builds (roughly grouped) are covered first, followed by an outline of the approach used (with a fully-developed party) against particular tough enemy types in the game.
units.zh: 下面先大致分类介绍各个角色的配点，再概述成型队伍如何应对游戏中几类特别难缠的敌人。

units.source: I don't quite believe it, but apparently the word-count for this new version comes out at almost 20,000 (a quarter of a novel) ...
units.zh: 我自己也不敢相信，这次新版居然写了将近 20,000 个英文词，都够一部长篇小说的四分之一了……

units.source: I always have at least two characters who can one-shot tower/kite shields in direct melee engagement (with greataxes or rusty barbarian equivalents) and one-shot schrat/heater shields from a safer distance of 2 tiles (with longaxes). Quick Hands is an essential perk for these characters.
units.zh: 我总会带上至少两名破盾手：他们能贴身用巨斧或蛮族的生锈同类武器，一击砍碎塔盾、鸢形盾；也能在更安全的 2 格外，用长柄斧一击砍碎树妖盾和熨斗形盾。快手是这些角色的必选特长。

units.source: Against enemies without high-durability shields and/or the Shield Expert perk (or against enemies with lots of 2-tile weapons), bardiches may be favoured for their AOE split ability. If you get a rare bardiche with greataxe-esque shield damage, that may be favoured for all engagements. On the other hand, if the character’s fatigue is high enough, you could even carry all three 2H axe variants. Other options for the third item slot include a 1H weapon (so that you can Recover after Berserk, or so that you can have an extra attack and use Indomitable after getting a kill and going Berserk in a tight situation) or a jagged pike (so that, after a kill/Berserk, you can move a tile and make an additional 2-tile attack, gaining part of the advantage of polearms without needing to master them) or a battle-whip (so that you can do all the above things, with a 3-tile range, but only inflict meaningful damage if the target is unarmoured).
units.zh: 如果敌人没有高耐久盾牌、没有盾牌精通，或者大量使用 2 格武器，可以优先用长刃斧，发挥劈开的范围攻击。若拿到一把破盾伤害堪比巨斧的名贵长刃斧，甚至可以一直用它。另一方面，疲劳上限够高的话，三种双手斧也可以全带。第三个装备栏还可以放单手武器，便于触发狂战后恢复体力，或在危急时刻击杀并触发狂战后，再攻击一下并使用不屈；也可以放锯齿长枪，击杀触发狂战后移动一格，再进行一次 2 格攻击，不用点长柄武器精通，也能获得部分长柄武器的优势；或者放战鞭，同样能完成上述操作，射程还有 3 格，但只有对无甲目标才打得出像样的伤害。

units.source: This character needs lots of fatigue and good melee skill (super-high values of 85-95 at level 11 would be ideal, although the ability to rapidly remove large shields and thus lower enemy defences means that even values of 75-80 can be acceptable on an otherwise remarkable recruit (e.g. a wildman with masses of fatigue, HPs and resolve).
units.zh: 这个角色需要很高的疲劳上限和不错的近战命中。11 级时能有 85-95 的超高命中当然理想，不过他能快速砍掉大盾、降低敌人的防御，所以其他方面特别出色的人，75-80 也可以接受，例如生命值、疲劳上限和意志都很高的荒野人。

units.source: Although the character is expected to get involved in direct melee engagement some of the time, it is not supposed to be surrounded by enemies and does not need exceptionally high defence (although you may choose Reach Advantage and even Underdog as optional perks if you chance to get lots of good rolls). Forget about cycling Round Swing with Indomitable, but by all means consider cycling Split with Indomitable. In the absence of high defences, excessive danger can avoided by using Rotation and/or Footwork (ideally on a different character, thus saving perks for this one) and by using Indomitable in tight spots.
units.zh: 虽然有时要贴身作战，但这个角色不该陷入包围，也不需要特别高的防御。如果近战防御多次掷出很好的成长值，可以考虑长兵优势，甚至以少敌多。别指望循环使用回旋斩加不屈，但完全可以考虑劈开加不屈。防御不高时，可以靠换位或灵活步法避开过度危险的处境，最好由其他队友负责，替这个角色省下特长点；危急时则用不屈保命。

units.source: Ideally, fatigue should be 90+ in gear when using a bardiche (91+ when holding a longaxe with the bardiche in a bag slot), so that the character has the option to continue cycling AOE Split attacks with Indomitable in tight spots. These figures can be reduced by 12 if the character has Iron Lungs.
units.zh: 理想情况下，使用长刃斧时，穿戴装备后应有 90+ 可用疲劳；手持长柄斧、把长刃斧放进背包时，则应有 91+，这样才能在危急时持续循环劈开的范围攻击与不屈。如果有铁肺，这些要求可以降低 12。

units.source: The character should have as many HPs as can be spared (bolstered by Colossus unless the value is already high, in which case the addition of Colossus will probably feel irresistible) and should have at least decent resolve (minimum of ~50 with a trophy, although ~60+ is ideal for fights like the Black Monolith).
units.zh: 应尽可能多给他生命值，并用巨人体魄进一步提高，除非原本生命值就很高；不过真有这么高的生命值，恐怕反而更难抗拒巨人体魄的诱惑。意志至少也要过得去：戴上战利品饰品后，最低约 50；若要打黑色巨石这样的战斗，最好有约 60+。

units.source: Since the character revolves primarily around attacks costing 6 action points (APs), the Pathfinder perk is very useful for fighting effectively in swamps and switching height levels in forests/mountains/snow (although a back-up jagged pike could offer a partial work-around for this difficulty). Pathfinder also synergizes brilliantly well with Adrenaline and an abundance of fatigue for trapping and slaughtering annoying, high-initiative enemies in the early stages of battles, and for advantageous positioning (in concert with allies) prior to an onslaught of attacks on rough terrain. In the absence of Pathfinder, use of Rotation and/or Footwork (by this character or another) can compensate partially for the lack of general mobility on tough terrain (e.g. still only 3 APs to shift a tile in swamp or up/down height levels in forests/mountains/snow).
units.zh: 这个角色主要使用消耗 6 点行动点的攻击，所以寻路者对于沼泽作战，以及森林、山地、雪地中的高低差移动很有帮助。当然，备用锯齿长枪也能部分绕过这个难题。寻路者与肾上腺素、充足的疲劳上限也配合得极好：既能在战斗初期追堵并杀死那些先攻很高的烦人敌人，也能在崎岖地形上与队友配合，先占好位置再猛烈进攻。没有寻路者时，由自己或队友使用换位、灵活步法，可以部分弥补复杂地形中的机动性不足；例如在沼泽里移动一格，或在森林、山地、雪地里跨越高低差，仍只消耗 3 点行动点。

units.source: Another potentially valuable anti-annoyance perk for this character (and other offence-oriented ones) is Resilient. While this perk is very optional, I’d say it’s vital to have it on at least some damage-dealers with high melee skill, since it makes life a lot easier in slow, frustrating fights against shamans and hexen (e.g. advance into attacking range, use Adrenaline, wait turn, and then recover from any curses or charms before slaughtering those devious cheating bastards at the start of the next turn)!
units.zh: 另一个能减轻烦恼、值得这个角色及其他输出角色考虑的特长，是顽强。它不是必选，但我认为至少应让部分近战命中高的输出手点出它，因为面对萨满和女巫时，那些缓慢又烦人的战斗会轻松得多。例如先进入攻击距离，使用肾上腺素后等待行动，让诅咒或魅惑先消退，再在下回合开始时杀掉这些狡诈作弊的混蛋！

units.source: Since the character revolves primarily around offence and damage, however, Killing Frenzy (possibly bolstered by Strange Mushrooms if you have a spare slot for them) is always an enticing perk (even if you always end up opting for easy kills against near-dead enemies to ensure that the bonus remains active, and hardly ever manage to get an additional kill thanks to the effect of KF). For otherwise remarkable recruits with mediocre melee skill in the high 70s or even low 80s, you could consider Backstabber (excellent against barbarians, swordmasters and irrlichts). Other optional perks include Rotation and/or Footwork (for avoiding direct melee engagement after smashing large shields or spamming Split attacks), Reach Advantage and/or Underdog (if the character has decent talent/rolls for melee defence), a second mastery (whips?), Fortified Mind (if resolve is below ~50), or Bags and Belts so that you can store Strange Mushrooms (and/or carry back-up 1H items and nets)!
units.zh: 不过，这个角色的核心毕竟是进攻和伤害，所以杀戮狂热始终很诱人；若有空位，还可以用奇异蘑菇进一步强化。哪怕你最后总是优先收割濒死敌人来维持加成，几乎没靠它多杀到什么人，它也依然让人心动。若新兵其他方面很好，近战命中却只有 70 大几或 80 出头，可以考虑背刺者，对蛮族、剑术大师和克拉肯触手尤其有用。其他可选项还有：换位或灵活步法，用于劈碎大盾或反复劈开后脱离近战；如果近战防御天赋或成长不错，可选长兵优势或以少敌多；再点一种武器精通，例如鞭；意志不足约 50 时选坚定心智；或者选行囊与腰带，存放奇异蘑菇，也能携带备用单手装备和网。

units.source: The character should either be Nimble or wearing armours with durability at least around the mid-200s (in the latter case, ideally without using a perk on Brawny). Ideally the character would be highly Nimble in super-efficient famed armours with durability in the low/mid-200s, or Battle Forged (still without using a perk on Brawny) in super-efficient famed armours with durability in the mid/high-300s. A perk-sparing compromise would to have a high pool of fatigue in efficient armours in the mid/high 200s, with no Nimble, Brawny or BF (but yes Indomitable).
units.zh: 这个角色要么用轻灵，要么穿耐久至少处于 200 多点中段的护甲；后一种情况最好不要再为壮硕花费特长点。理想方案是穿重量效率极高、耐久处于 200 多点低段或中段的名贵护甲，保留较强的轻灵效果；或者穿耐久处于 300 多点中段或高段的高效名贵护甲，搭配久经战阵，仍然不用壮硕。节省特长点的折中方案，是穿耐久处于 200 多点中段或高段的高效护甲，保留大量可用疲劳，不点轻灵、壮硕或久经战阵，但要有不屈。

units.source: Bone Plating attachments tend to be best for Nimble armours, and Additional Fur Padding (AFP) for heavy ones (BF or not), but sometimes Light Padding Replacement (LPR) is necessary for the latter to save using a perk on Brawny, and Bone Plating may be the best attachment for all armours against enemies like lindwurms. Direwolf mantles are the coolest-looking attachment, however, and (by stackingly lowering the resolve of engaged enemies) may help you to do some cheap spooking against unholds, orc warlords et al. Fur Padding attachments (the type that lower ranged armour and HP damage by 20%) could be used for some large goblin fights (these armours can be kept spare in the inventory the rest of the time, if you have room for them).
units.zh: 轻灵护甲通常最适合骨板护层，重甲则适合附加毛皮衬垫，无论是否点了久经战阵。不过，重甲有时必须用轻型替换衬垫，才能省下壮硕的特长点；对付林德蠕龙之类的敌人时，骨板护层可能对所有护甲都是最佳附件。然而，恐狼皮披肩的外观最帅，而且能叠加降低贴身敌人的意志，或许能帮你用些取巧手段吓跑巨魔、兽人军阀等敌人。某些大型地精战中，也可以用毛皮衬垫，即降低 20% 远程护甲伤害与生命伤害的那一种。若仓库放得下，平时可以把这类护甲留作备用。

units.source: {#1}Probable Perks:{/#1} Colossus, Nimble or [Brawny and/or BF]
units.zh: {#1}通常会选的特长：{/#1}巨人体魄、轻灵，或者壮硕与久经战阵中的一项或两项。

units.source: {#1}Possible Perks:{/#1} Pathfinder, Resilient, Killing Frenzy, Backstabber, Reach Advantage, Underdog, Rotation, Footwork, Fortified Mind, B&B, 2nd mastery
units.zh: {#1}可选特长：{/#1}寻路者、顽强、杀戮狂热、背刺者、长兵优势、以少敌多、换位、灵活步法、坚定心智、行囊与腰带、第 2 项武器精通。

units.source: {#1}Most Vital Stats:{/#1} Melee Skill (~80+), Max Fatigue (136 base for minimal Nimble armour and one 2H axe of each type!)
units.zh: {#1}最重要的属性：{/#1}近战命中约 80+；疲劳上限：穿最轻的轻灵护甲、三种双手斧各带一把时，需要 136 基础值！

units.source: {#1}Also Important Stats:{/#1} HPs (at least ~90, ideally 100+), Resolve (at least ~50, ideally 60+), Melee Defence (usually ~10-25, but feel free to neglect if Huge/Cocky/Wild without talent)
units.zh: {#1}同样重要的属性：{/#1}生命值至少约 90，最好 100+；意志至少约 50，最好 60+；近战防御通常约 10-25，但如果高大、自负或出身荒野，而且没有这方面天赋，也可以舍弃。

units.source: {#1}Optional Stats:{/#1} Ranged Defence, Ranged Skill (if it can get to 50-65 with 0-3 rolls)
units.zh: {#1}可选属性：{/#1}远程防御；远程命中：如果只需投入 0-3 次成长就能达到 50-65，可以考虑。

units.source: {#1}Recommended Traits:{/#1} Huge, Strong, Iron Lungs, Iron Jaw, Athletic, Tough, Brave/Fearless, Dexterous, Surefooted, Paranoid, Hate for Beasts/Greenskins/Undead, Deathwish
units.zh: {#1}推荐特性：{/#1}高大、强壮、铁肺、铁下巴、健步如飞、强健、勇敢或无畏、灵巧、步伐稳健、多疑、憎恨野兽或绿皮或亡灵、视死如归。

units.source: {#1}Recommended Backgrounds:{/#1} wildman, lumberjack, farmhand, beastslayer, brawler, messenger, vagabond, flagellant, caravan hand, graverobber, gravedigger, butcher, fisherman, cultist, mason, miller, daytaler
units.zh: {#1}推荐背景：{/#1}荒野人、伐木工、农场帮工、猎兽者、拳斗者、信使、流浪汉、苦修者、商队杂工、盗墓贼、掘墓人、屠夫、渔夫、邪教徒、石匠、磨坊主、短工。

units.source: The new 2H maces are magnificent weapons and I use of them a lot (without mastery) for the powerful Daze effect of their basic (fatigue-neutral) attack. Additionally, however, I sometimes have one or two characters who master the mace, since 1H maces can be useful if you want to stun multiple enemies who have the Resilient perk (or move two tiles to stun one enemy), and they also tend to be the best Duellist weapons (Duellist becoming an enticing perk if you’ve chanced to loot an awesome 1H mace with exaggerated damage). Against many medium-armoured enemies, an attack from a 2H mace leaves them devoid of armour but clinging onto just a few HPs; an attack from a 1H mace with Duellist doesn’t do as much devastation, but does leave enough APs for another attack that will finish them off.
units.zh: 新增的双手钉锤非常出色，我经常不点精通直接使用，主要看中它普通攻击附带的强力恍惚效果，而且这种打法能保持疲劳收支平衡。不过，我有时也会培养一两名点出钉锤精通的角色：单手钉锤可以击晕多个带顽强特长的敌人，也可以先移动两格再击晕一个敌人。它们往往也是最适合决斗家的武器；如果碰巧捡到一把伤害超高的名贵单手钉锤，决斗家就很诱人了。许多中甲敌人挨一次双手钉锤攻击后，会护甲尽毁，却还剩几点生命。单手钉锤配决斗家虽然一击没有这么强，但还留有足够行动点，可以再打一下收掉人头。

units.source: Other than specializing in the mace, such characters are often not massively different from Axe Murderers, but they are a little more liable to end up in direct melee engagement with more than one enemy, and defence may be more of a priority (although it’s not that vital so long as most nearby enemies are either stunned or dazed). Also, since 1H maces usually make the best Duellist weapons, that perk is more likely to be an option for this build (although the character still functions primarily as a 2-hander, initially from 2 tiles, only advancing to engage enemies when the right opportunity arises).
units.zh: 除了专精于钉锤，这类角色通常与斧头杀手没有太大区别，不过他们更容易同时与多个敌人贴身交战，因而可能更重视防御。当然，只要周围多数敌人都被击晕或处于恍惚状态，防御也不至于特别关键。单手钉锤通常是决斗家的最佳武器，因此这个配点更可能考虑决斗家特长；不过角色仍主要使用双手武器，起初在 2 格外作战，等到时机合适才上前接敌。

units.source: This build can potentially be fatigue-intensive (with Adrenaline and Indomitable), mostly fatigue-neutral (still with Recover for facilitating sprees of stunning or Berserking) or even initiative-based.
units.zh: 这个配点可以走高疲劳消耗路线，搭配肾上腺素和不屈；也可以基本维持疲劳收支平衡，仍带恢复体力，以便连续击晕或接连触发狂战；甚至还能以先攻为核心。

units.source: At one extreme, having 88 fatigue in gear with a 2H mace (76 with Iron Lungs) allows you (after using Recover+Adrenaline from a state of exhaustion on the previous turn) to kill/Berserk, use Indomitable, switch to a 1H mace, and make a 4 AP attack. However, since the mace is not an AOE weapon (and since high damage from 1H maces is highly situational), this character should generally not be surrounded and needing to cycle Indomitable to prevent injuries (a dazed enemy makes you 35% Indomitable anyway), and Adrenaline is not an essential perk even if the character is fatigue-intensive and has Indomitable (the initiative-lowering effect of dazing often leaves an enemy after you in the turn order anyway). Adrenaline is still a very viable pick for incapacitating quick and nasty enemies such as necrosavants and bounty hunters, and Indomitable is still very handy after those annoying clutch misses against Resilient enemies (e.g. barbarians, large beasts, orc warriors/warlords/berserkers).
units.zh: 一个极端是：手持双手钉锤、穿戴装备后有 88 可用疲劳，有铁肺则只需 76。这样在上回合筋疲力尽时用过恢复体力加肾上腺素后，本回合就能击杀触发狂战、使用不屈，再换成单手钉锤做一次 4 行动点攻击。不过，钉锤不是范围攻击武器，单手钉锤打高伤害的条件又比较苛刻，所以通常不该让这个角色陷入包围，靠循环不屈防止受伤。况且敌人恍惚时，本来就相当于你获得了 35% 的不屈减伤。因此，即便走高疲劳消耗路线且带不屈，肾上腺素也不是必选，恍惚降低先攻后，敌人往往自然就排在你后面了。尽管如此，肾上腺素仍很适合抢先制住死灵剑士、赏金猎人这类又快又凶的敌人；而面对蛮族、大型野兽、兽人战士、兽人军阀和兽人狂战士等带顽强的敌人时，关键一击偏偏落空，不屈仍能很好地救场。

units.source: At the other extreme, you could have just 60-70 fatigue in minimal Nimble gear (just enough for a bit of situational stun spamming and/or Berserking) and could take high initiative rolls and take Dodge and Overwhelm and maybe Relentless as well (the Daze effect lowering enemy initiative by 35% and making it easier to stay ahead in the turn order to apply Overwhelm and keep them dazed to compensate for not having Indomitable).
units.zh: 另一个极端是：穿最轻的轻灵装备，只留 60-70 可用疲劳，刚够在必要时连续击晕或连续触发狂战。把较高的成长值投入先攻，选择闪避、压制，也许再加不懈。恍惚能降低敌人 35% 的先攻，让你更容易持续先手、施加压制并维持恍惚，以此弥补没有不屈的缺点。

units.source: The above variant is shaky against barbarians/chosen, but its lack of access to fatigue-intensive skills can be compensated for by using such skills on other characters (e.g. a positioner can use Rotation+Footwork to rescue them both from an unpleasant spot, or a Huge wildman who is much easier to hit can enter the melee next to the dodgy dazer and use Indomitable). Also, if one of your fatigue-intensive characters and a barbarian have both used Adrenaline (yours first), hitting that barbarian with a 2H hammer at the start of the subsequent turn will stagger it and send it straight back to the end of the turn order in spite of having used Adrenaline (like being sent directly to jail in Monopoly). (You should also be cautious to avoid having this happen to your guys!) Since barbarians use Adrenaline when they sense that you have more initiative, there is no reason for a high-initiative character not to wait turn to assess developments again them, and sometimes it is possible to stun a chosen after it has closed in and waited to use Adrenaline (which is not possible once it’s stunned). High-initiative characters can also be protected against barbarians by Spearwalls (which can prevent Adrenalized chosen from engaging to get the first attack) and by throwing nets (to delay engagement or to prevent chosen from rotating to focus attacks after they’ve already engaged).
units.zh: 上面这种方案面对蛮族和神选战士不太稳，不过可以让队友施放高疲劳消耗技能来补足。例如专门调位的人用换位加灵活步法，把两人都从险境中救出；也可以让一个更容易挨打的高大荒野人，站到这名擅长闪避、制造恍惚的队友身边接敌，再用不屈。还有一种情况：己方高疲劳消耗角色与某个蛮族都用了肾上腺素，而且己方先用；下回合开始时，用双手锤打中蛮族，踉跄就会把它直接送到行动顺序末尾，哪怕它已经用了肾上腺素，就像玩大富翁时被直接送进监狱。当然，也要小心别让己方遭到同样待遇！蛮族察觉你先攻更高时才会用肾上腺素，因此高先攻角色完全可以先等待，观察局面。有时能在神选战士靠近、等待施放肾上腺素时把它击晕，它晕着就没法用了。矛墙也能保护高先攻角色，让开了肾上腺素的神选战士无法贴身抢先攻击；投网则能拖延接敌，或在它们已经接敌后阻止其换位集中攻击。

units.source: A mostly fatigue-neutral variant (better-suited to backgrounds with high melee skill and mediocre/crap fatigue) would also have around 60-70 fatigue in gear, would spend no stat points on initiative, and would save more stat points for defence, HPs and resolve (and good rolls for fatigue). In this case, the Bags and Belts perk could be handy for carrying nets and/or throwing spears to make it even easier to hit and incapacitate nearby enemies (and, in the case of nets, to manipulate the turn order without Adrenaline or high initiative, and to prevent dangerous enemies from engaging too soon).
units.zh: 基本保持疲劳收支平衡的方案，更适合近战命中高、疲劳上限一般甚至很差的背景。穿戴装备后同样留约 60-70 可用疲劳，不给先攻加点，把更多成长留给防御、生命值和意志，疲劳上限则只取高成长。此时行囊与腰带很有用，可以多带网或投矛，更容易打中并制住附近敌人。网还可以让你不依赖肾上腺素或高先攻来操控行动顺序，并阻止危险敌人过早贴身。

units.source: While very high melee skill is best for this build (a minimum of ~85 at level 11), the Backstabber perk remains an option for making annoying sequences of clutch misses less common. Melee defence can vary depending on talent and the base value. The high-initiative variant will add significant defence via Dodge, and Underdog and Reach Advantage are options for those with a high value/talent, but you can also neglect defence and be more careful to ensure that the character is usually only in attacking range of enemies who can be quickly dazed/stunned/killed.
units.zh: 这个配点最好有很高的近战命中，11 级至少约 85；但也可以选背刺者，减少关键时刻连续失手的烦恼。近战防御的投入取决于基础值和天赋。先攻型会靠闪避增加大量防御；若近战防御高或有天赋，也可以选以少敌多和长兵优势。你也能舍弃防御，转而更谨慎地站位，确保通常只有那些可以迅速打入恍惚、击晕或杀死的敌人能攻击到他。

units.source: The character’s armour should be Nimble (if mostly fatigue-neutral or initiative-based) or (if fatigue-intensive) either Nimble or heavy (in the latter case, preferably with BF and without Brawny).
units.zh: 如果主要追求疲劳收支平衡或先攻，应使用轻灵护甲。若走高疲劳消耗路线，则轻灵或重甲都可以；重甲最好搭配久经战阵，不点壮硕。

units.source: {#1}Probable Perks:{/#1} Berserk, Colossus, Nimble or [Brawny and/or BF]
units.zh: {#1}通常会选的特长：{/#1}狂战、巨人体魄、轻灵，或者壮硕与久经战阵中的一项或两项。

units.source: {#1}Possible Perks:{/#1} Indom, Adren, Pathfinder, Resilient, Killing Frenzy, Duellist, Backstabber, Reach Advantage, Underdog, Rotation, Footwork, Dodge, Overwhelm, Relentless, Fortified Mind, B&B, 2nd mastery
units.zh: {#1}可选特长：{/#1}不屈、肾上腺素、寻路者、顽强、杀戮狂热、决斗家、背刺者、长兵优势、以少敌多、换位、灵活步法、闪避、压制、不懈、坚定心智、行囊与腰带、第 2 项武器精通。

units.source: {#1}Also Important Stats:{/#1} Melee Defence (usually ~10-40, but feel free to neglect if Huge/Cocky/Wild without talent), Max Fatigue (or Initiative), HPs (at least ~90, ideally 100+), Resolve (at least ~50, ideally 60+)
units.zh: {#1}同样重要的属性：{/#1}近战防御通常约 10-40，但如果高大、自负或出身荒野，而且没有这方面天赋，也可以舍弃；疲劳上限或先攻；生命值至少约 90，最好 100+；意志至少约 50，最好 60+。

units.zh: {#1}推荐特性：{/#1}铁肺、灵巧、强壮、铁下巴、健步如飞、高大、强健、勇敢或无畏、步伐稳健、多疑或迅捷、憎恨野兽或绿皮或亡灵、视死如归。

units.source: {#1}Recommended Backgrounds:{/#1} squire, militia, beastslayer, wildman, lumberjack, brawler, caravan hand, graverobber, butcher, farmhand, messenger, gravedigger, vagabond, flagellant, fisherman, cultist, mason, miller, daytaler, thief, gambler, miner, bastard, disowned noble, retired soldier
units.zh: {#1}推荐背景：{/#1}骑士侍从、民兵、猎兽者、荒野人、伐木工、拳斗者、商队杂工、盗墓贼、屠夫、农场帮工、信使、掘墓人、流浪汉、苦修者、渔夫、邪教徒、石匠、磨坊主、短工、盗贼、赌徒、矿工、私生子、被逐贵族、退伍军人。

units.source: Not massively different from the other melee/fatigue-based offensive types/variants (with room for enough overlap to make them indistinguishable), but this is an exciting one based on maximizing damage with any awesome rare weapons you’ve been able to find.
units.zh: 这个角色与其他依靠近战和疲劳上限的输出类型或变体，没有特别大的区别，重叠空间甚至足以让人分不清。不过，它很令人兴奋：围绕你找到的任何一把出色名贵武器，把伤害推到极致。

units.source: This character may or may not have a mastery, but should have a big 2-hander (often a mace), a 2-tile weapon and either Strange Mushrooms or a 4-AP weapon (ideally all weapons rare variants with exaggerated damage and/or fatigue efficiency). Foregoing a mastery frees up more perk options for damage (Killing Frenzy, Duellist), for making sure you hit bastards in the first place (Backstabber), or for carrying more offensive weapons and/or nets and/or throwing spears and/or Strange Mushrooms (Bags and Belts).
units.zh: 这个角色可以有武器精通，也可以没有，但应当带一把大型双手武器，通常是钉锤，再带一把 2 格武器，以及奇异蘑菇或一把消耗 4 行动点的武器。理想情况下，所有武器都是伤害极高、疲劳效率极佳的名贵款式。不点武器精通，就能腾出更多特长点：用杀戮狂热或决斗家增加伤害，用背刺者确保先打中那些混蛋，或者用行囊与腰带多带进攻武器、网、投矛和奇异蘑菇。

units.source: There are no very specific fatigue requirements, but more fatigue is generally very desirable for bursts of aggression. Indomitable usage is situational. Several rounds of Adrenaline are good for taking out dangerous enemies who have high initiative. Generally, the character hangs behind the frontline with a 2-tile item (close to gaps in the formation that have been left to entice enemies), and switches to a more offensive implement to bash in anything that foolishly advances through the gap. Nets can be useful to prevent barbarian chosen from using Rotation (aka Barbarian Wrath) to focus attacks on this character (or other less defensive or tanky characters).
units.zh: 疲劳上限没有特别明确的门槛，不过越高越利于短时间猛攻。不屈视情况使用。连续几个回合用肾上腺素，适合干掉危险的高先攻敌人。通常，这个角色会持 2 格武器待在前排后方，靠近故意留来引诱敌人的缺口；哪个蠢货敢穿过空隙，就换上更凶猛的武器敲扁它。网能阻止蛮族神选战士使用换位，也就是它们的“蛮族之怒”，集中攻击这个角色或其他防御、承伤能力较弱的队友。

units.source: The armour requirements are the same as for the Axe Murderer.
units.zh: 护甲要求与斧头杀手相同。

units.source: {#1}Possible Perks:{/#1} Killing Frenzy, Backstabber, Duellist, Resilient, Pathfinder, B&B, Weapon Mastery, Fortified Mind, Fast Adaptation, Rotation, Footwork
units.zh: {#1}可选特长：{/#1}杀戮狂热、背刺者、决斗家、顽强、寻路者、行囊与腰带、武器精通、坚定心智、快速适应、换位、灵活步法。

units.source: {#1}Also Important Stats:{/#1} Max Fatigue, HPs (at least ~90, ideally 100+), Resolve (at least ~50, ideally 60+)
units.zh: {#1}同样重要的属性：{/#1}疲劳上限；生命值至少约 90，最好 100+；意志至少约 50，最好 60+。

units.source: {#1}Optional Stats:{/#1} Melee Defence, Ranged Defence, Ranged Skill (if it can get to 50-65 with 0-3 rolls)
units.zh: {#1}可选属性：{/#1}近战防御、远程防御；远程命中：如果只需投入 0-3 次成长就能达到 50-65，可以考虑。

units.source: {#1}Recommended Traits:{/#1} Huge, Drunkard, Dexterous, Strong, Iron Lungs, Iron Jaw, Athletic, Tough, Brave/Fearless, Hate for Beasts/Greenskins/Undead, Deathwish, Paranoid, Surefooted
units.zh: {#1}推荐特性：{/#1}高大、酒鬼、灵巧、强壮、铁肺、铁下巴、健步如飞、强健、勇敢或无畏、憎恨野兽或绿皮或亡灵、视死如归、多疑、步伐稳健。

units.zh: {#1}推荐背景：{/#1}荒野人、伐木工、拳斗者、猎兽者、农场帮工、信使、商队杂工、盗墓贼、掘墓人、屠夫、流浪汉、苦修者、渔夫、邪教徒、石匠、磨坊主、短工、民兵、骑士侍从。

units.source: The ranged offensive variant, with no need for Adrenaline or Indomitable, and Recover merely an option. It’s a good idea to take high rolls for fatigue; but, so long as you can chuck most of your ammo before being exhausted, it’s not otherwise overly important.
units.zh: 这是远程输出变体，不需要肾上腺素或不屈，恢复体力也只是可选。疲劳上限遇到高成长时值得加，但只要能在累瘫前扔出大部分弹药，它就不算特别重要。

units.source: You could have this character in heavy armour, but Nimble is by far the most practical option. Bags and Belts allows a decent ammo count and extra nets (and even a back-up shield).
units.zh: 这个角色也可以穿重甲，但轻灵无疑最实用。行囊与腰带能让他带上充足弹药和额外的网，甚至再备一面盾。

units.source: If you want the character to be a bit more useful against massive beasts (unholds, schrats, lindwurms), or if you just fancy some weird roleplaying with a cheap no-ammo weapon (the staff sling), you could take Head Hunter to try keeping more of those creatures dazed. Since lindwurms are divided into head/body and tail components, you can deliberately miss the head by hitting the tail, and then stand a very good chance of applying Daze by aiming at the head/body.
units.zh: 如果想让他对巨魔、树妖、林德蠕龙这类巨兽更有用，或者想拿一件不用弹药的便宜武器——投石杖——玩点奇怪的角色扮演，可以选猎首者，尝试让更多巨兽陷入恍惚。林德蠕龙分成头身与尾巴两部分，你可以先故意攻击尾巴、避开头部，再瞄准头身，就很有机会打出恍惚。

units.source: Although they are one-use only, throwing spears can inflict absolutely awe-inspiring damage from 2 tiles with Throwing Mastery and Duellist. You can save a single spear for after a kill when Killing Frenzy is active, and then salivate ecstatically as blood flows forth from an enemy’s supposedly impenetrable armour (or fume as it bounces off an orc warlord’s helmet).
units.zh: 投矛虽然只能用一次，但配合投掷精通和决斗家，从 2 格外扔出去能打出惊人的伤害。你可以留一根投矛，等击杀后杀戮狂热生效，再看着鲜血从敌人那身号称坚不可摧的护甲里喷出来，兴奋得直流口水；当然，也可能看着投矛被兽人军阀的头盔弹开，气得冒烟。

units.source: Nimble and high HPs make ranged characters relatively safe from enemy x-bow bolts, but ranged defence can be very useful pre-Nimble in the early-game. However, since pre-Nimble is also pre-Duellist, there’s no reason why a thrower can’t carry a shield in the early/mid-game.
units.zh: 轻灵加高生命值，让远程角色面对敌方弩箭时相对安全；但前期还没点出轻灵时，远程防御很有用。不过，既然还没轻灵，也就还没决斗家，那么前中期的投掷手带面盾也完全没问题。

units.source: {#1}Possible Perks:{/#1} Pathfinder, Recover, Bullseye, Fast Adaptation, Head Hunter, XBowM, BowM, MeleeM
units.zh: {#1}可选特长：{/#1}寻路者、恢复体力、鹰眼、快速适应、猎首者、弩精通、弓术精通、近战武器精通。

units.source: {#1}Also Important Stats:{/#1} HPs (at least ~80, ideally 100+), Max Fatigue (enough to not be exhausted before throwing most ammo)
units.zh: {#1}同样重要的属性：{/#1}生命值至少约 80，最好 100+；疲劳上限要足以让你在扔出大部分弹药前不至于筋疲力尽。

units.source: {#1}Optional Stats:{/#1} Melee Skill (ideally ~75+, but neglect if low value and no talent), Ranged Defence, Resolve, Melee Defence
units.zh: {#1}可选属性：{/#1}近战命中最好约 75+，但如果基础低又没天赋，就舍弃；远程防御、意志、近战防御。

units.source: {#1}Recommended Traits:{/#1} Strong, Iron Lungs, Iron Jaw, Athletic, Tough, Brave/Fearless, Paranoid, Swift, Surefooted, Deathwish, Hate for Beasts/Greenskins/Undead
units.zh: {#1}推荐特性：{/#1}强壮、铁肺、铁下巴、健步如飞、强健、勇敢或无畏、多疑、敏捷、步伐稳健、视死如归、憎恨野兽或绿皮或亡灵。

units.source: A specialist 2-handed tank who has enough fatigue (in gear) to cyclically AOE and use Indomitable. Swords are recommended, since they have more AOE options and are lighter to carry. However, in rare instances (e.g. Iron-Lunged wildmen with high melee talents), you may be able to achieve the fatigue (98 in gear) to cycle Indomitable with 2H axe Round Swing attacks (while still having enough resolve to avoid dropping to negative morale states on being engaged by additional enemies from a position of isolation). Bardiche Split attacks are not recommended, because there are many situations in which you’re surrounded and want to use a swinging attack. Hammer Shatter attacks are not recommended, since 2H hammers potentially apply the Staggered effect which lowers the initiative of enemies and leaves them behind you in the turn order when you need to use Recover. Split attacks are sometimes highly desirable (e.g. for killing ancient pike wielders), but swords can do that as well as swinging. Greataxes and their rusty (but situationally slightly superior) barbarian equivalents can only swing and have a rather impractical AOE with a nasty penalty to accuracy, but remain a temptation (more damage, more Reach Advantage) in those rare instances …
units.zh: 这是专门承伤的双手武器角色，穿戴装备后仍有足够可用疲劳，能够循环使用范围攻击和不屈。推荐剑，因为它的范围攻击选择更多，也更轻。不过，在铁肺荒野人还恰好有很高近战天赋等少见情况下，你也许能凑够穿戴后 98 可用疲劳，用双手斧的回旋斩循环搭配不屈，还留有足够意志，避免孤立在外时被更多敌人贴身就掉入负面士气。这里不推荐长刃斧的劈开，因为被包围时，很多情况需要横向扫击。也不推荐锤的击碎，因为双手锤可能造成踉跄，降低敌人先攻，结果你需要恢复体力时，敌人反而排在你之后行动。有时确实很需要劈开，例如击杀古代长枪手，但剑既能劈开，也能挥击。巨斧和它生锈、却在某些情况下略强的蛮族同类，只能使用回旋范围攻击，攻击范围不太实用，还带有很重的命中惩罚；但在那些难得的条件下，更多伤害、更多长兵优势，仍然很诱人……

units.source: This kind of character, while somewhat heroic and inspiring, is also a bit boring and restricted and immobile, usually spending every turn either using Recover+Adrenaline at the very end of the turn order (hopefully) or using an AOE attack (Split or Swing) with Indomitable at the very start of the turn order (hopefully). Moving instead of remaining Indomitable feels dangerous in the most challenging fights (for which this character is made), and Berserk (which may allow you to move and use Indomitable, but only if you have surplus fatigue available) is a luxury perk that is difficult to fit in. Quick Hands allows 2-tile attacks when movement isn’t possible, but also adds to the fatigue requirements and requires the sacrifice of probably more important perks. The character’s immobility can be compensated for by using other characters (e.g. Spear/2H Positioners or Sergeants) to achieve favourable positioning (and favourable AOE angles).
units.zh: 这种角色虽然有点英勇鼓舞人心，却也有些单调、受限、难以移动。通常每回合不是尽量在行动顺序最末使用恢复体力加肾上腺素，就是尽量在最前使用一次范围攻击，劈开或挥击，再接不屈。在专门需要他出场的高难战斗中，放弃不屈去移动，总让人感觉危险。狂战能在击杀后让你移动并使用不屈，但必须还有多余疲劳；而且它是很难挤出位置的奢侈特长。快手能让你无法移动时改用 2 格攻击，却也提高了疲劳需求，还要牺牲其他可能更重要的特长。机动性不足可以让队友弥补，例如长矛或双手武器调位手、军士，帮他换到更有利的位置和范围攻击角度。

units.source: The character needs a bare minimum of 90 in-gear fatigue (98 if being stupid and going for axes and Round Swing), and it is preferable to have some extra as security against accidents (and to allow move+Indom after a kill if you’ve found room for Berserk). From a state of exhaustion (90/75), you can use Recover+Adrenaline (90/37, 90/57, since Recover rounds figures down) and then, at the start of the next turn (90/42), use an AOE attack (90/65) followed by Indomitable (90/90). If any enemies are behind you in the turn order when you Recover (e.g. because they’re dazed or staggered or because you’re cursed with too much initiative in spite of all the fatigue you’ve used wantonly), any attacks against you will add +2 to your fatigue (+5 if they hit) and will prevent you from being able to use both an AOE and Indom at the start of the next turn. If the character has Iron Lungs, the above minimum values of 90/98 can be reduced to 78/86.
units.zh: 穿戴装备后，这个角色最低需要 90 可用疲劳；若非要犯傻用斧和回旋斩，就要 98。最好再留一点余量应付意外；如果挤得出狂战，也能在击杀后移动并用不屈。从筋疲力尽的状态 90/75 出发，先恢复体力、再用肾上腺素，依次变为 90/37、90/57，因为恢复体力向下取整；下回合开始是 90/42，范围攻击后为 90/65，再用不屈刚好 90/90。如果恢复体力后还有敌人排在你后面，例如它们恍惚、踉跄，或你尽管拼命消耗疲劳，先攻却仍高得像中了诅咒，它们每次攻击都会让你的疲劳 +2，命中则 +5，导致下回合开始时无法同时使用范围攻击和不屈。若有铁肺，上述最低需求 90/98 可以降到 78/86。

units.source: For the above reasons, it’s preferable to wear armour that’s as heavy as possible, to guarantee having the lowest possible initiative. For obvious practical reasons, however, it’s very difficult to meet the fatigue requirements for the build in heavy armour, and Nimble (or a vulnerable medium-armoured build with no Nimble but with an extra perk point freed) is often the only option. With minimal Nimble armour and a greatsword and no back-up items, only 117 base max fatigue is the minimum value needed (but your initiative will sometimes still be too high, forcing you to awkwardly wait turn to lower it on the active turns, which is often still not enough). In theory, in the most efficient rare armours offering ~300+ durability and with LPR and no Brawny, you could get by with 130 base max fatigue. In more realistic conditions, you’re more likely to need ~140 base max fatigue for sub-optimal heavy-ish ~250+ armours with LPR and no back-up items, and that leaves little room for HPs and resolve (which are also very important in the tough fights for which this kind of character is made). Traits such as Strong and Iron Lungs (and Tough and Fearless) are therefore gifts from the grim gods of battle. Remember that Iron Lungs reduces the base fatigue requirements by 12.
units.zh: 因此，最好尽量穿重甲，确保先攻尽可能低。但很明显，重甲下极难达到这套配点的疲劳要求，所以轻灵常是唯一选择；也可以穿中甲而不点轻灵，腾出一个特长点，但会比较脆。穿最轻的轻灵护甲、拿巨剑、不带备用物品时，基础疲劳上限最低只需 117。不过有时先攻还是太高，不得不在需要攻击的回合别扭地等待来降低先攻，而且往往仍不够。理论上，穿最高效、耐久约 300+ 的名贵护甲，使用轻型替换衬垫且不点壮硕，基础疲劳上限 130 就够。现实中，更可能是穿不那么理想、耐久约 250+ 的较重护甲，加轻型替换衬垫，不带备用物品，仍需要约 140 基础疲劳上限。这样就没多少成长能留给生命值和意志，而这两项在该角色要面对的艰难战斗中同样重要。所以，强壮和铁肺，以及强健和无畏，都是残酷战神赐予的礼物。记住，铁肺能把基础疲劳需求降低 12。

units.source: This character has a significant degree of overlap with the next (shield-based) one, the main difference being that the latter has less ability/talent in the area of melee skill (and is therefore easier to find). In some cases, though, a character with melee skill in the 70s but an abundance of defence and fatigue (enough to have 90 fatigue with a greatsword in ~300+ armours without needing Brawny or even LPR) can make a viable zweihander, since this build is primarily defensive (and Reach Advantage is more of a lucky bonus if you’re already Indomitable in an enormous suit of BF armour with AFP). HPs and resolve must remain strong, however, and must be bolstered by the relevant perks if necessary. HPs need to be ~100 (or at least ~90) and resolve needs to be ~60 for the Black Monolith (and at least ~75 for anyone on the frontal/western flanks of the formation).
units.zh: 这个角色和下面的持盾版本有很大重叠，主要区别在于后者的近战命中或天赋较低，因此更容易招到。但有些角色近战命中只有 70 多，防御与疲劳上限却很高，穿约 300+ 护甲、拿巨剑还能有 90 可用疲劳，不需要壮硕，甚至不需要轻型替换衬垫，也能当合格的双手剑士。毕竟这套配点主要负责防御；如果你穿着厚重护甲，带久经战阵、附加毛皮衬垫，又开着不屈，长兵优势更像碰巧获得的添头。但生命值和意志仍必须够高，必要时用对应特长强化。生命值应有约 100，至少也要约 90；打黑色巨石时意志应有约 60，而阵形前侧或西侧翼的人至少要约 75。

units.source: Both Underdog and Reach Advantage are usually highly advisable. Just Underdog may be viable (as suggested above) on a character with abundant defence and fatigue but melee skill in the 70s. Just Reach Advantage (with Berserk for extra stacks and for killing off additional enemies to remove surrounding malus) may be viable for a relatively more offensive character (~85+ melee skill) who has more support from shield tanks (less heavy surrounding) and/or positioners (Rotations) and/or damage-dealers (more rapid removal of surrounding enemies).
units.zh: 通常强烈建议同时选以少敌多和长兵优势。如上所述，如果防御与疲劳上限充足、近战命中只有 70 多，只选以少敌多也可以。若角色更偏进攻，近战命中约 85+，而且有更多盾卫分担包围、调位手用换位支援，或输出手快速清理周围敌人，那么只选长兵优势也可能可行，再配狂战多叠层数、击杀额外敌人以减轻包围惩罚。

units.source: Resilient is a highly recommended perk for this character, since it provides an escape from the Dazed, Cursed and Charmed status effects and allows the continuation (with normal performance) of AOE+Indomitable cycles. Without Resilient in the Goblin City (Rul’Gazhix), you could remain cursed for five turns (-50% melee defence, plus any additional penalty from vines/nets), and that in turn would greatly increase the risk of being Punctured and Poisoned and of not having enough APs to Recover (further increasing the risk of additional poisoning and debilitation). With Resilient, you can use Recover+Adrenaline, wait turn (if there are any shamans still to act), and then savagely annihilate an evil shaman piece of shit (and use Indomitable) at the start of the next round! The same goes for being Charmed by hexen (Resilient also lessens the pressure on resolve in hex and alp fights). Being Dazed by chosen (or lindwurms or any raiders or hedge knights with 2H maces) reduces your fatigue to a minimal state, making you unable to use both Indomitable and an attack (even a single-target attack) after using Recover+Adrenaline. With Resilient, your fatigue parameters miraculously return to normal on the turn after using Recover+Adrenaline (despite still looking awful at the end of the previous turn), and normal service can be resumed. Since the whole point of this character is to serve as a bulwark against such enemies, it’s highly advisable to take Resilient, in spite of its deceptive un-sexiness.
units.zh: 非常推荐给这个角色点顽强：它能让你更快摆脱恍惚、诅咒和魅惑，恢复正常的范围攻击加不屈循环。在地精城市鲁尔加希克斯，如果没有顽强，诅咒可能持续五回合，近战防御 -50%，还得承受藤蔓或网的额外惩罚。这会大幅提高遭到破甲刺击、中毒，以及行动点不足以恢复体力的风险，进一步陷入反复中毒、虚弱的恶性循环。有了顽强，你就可以恢复体力、使用肾上腺素，如果还有萨满没行动就先等待，等下回合开始时凶狠地碾碎那个邪恶的萨满混蛋，再用不屈！被女巫魅惑时也一样；顽强还能减轻对抗女巫和梦魇时的意志压力。若被神选战士、林德蠕龙，或持双手钉锤的强盗劫掠者、流浪骑士打入恍惚，可用疲劳会被压到很低，以至于恢复体力加肾上腺素后，连一次单体攻击都无法与不屈一起使用。有了顽强，使用恢复体力加肾上腺素后的下一回合，疲劳相关数值就会奇迹般恢复正常，哪怕上回合结束时看着还很糟，也能照常运转。这个角色存在的意义，就是挡住这样的敌人，所以别看顽强不怎么起眼，实在很值得选。

units.source: Note that, while this character is usually an AOE’er, AOE attacks are weak against large beasts (unholds, schrats, lindwurms), and large beasts have such vast pools of fatigue that, once they’ve started catching their breath, they are likely to be behind any zweihander in the turn order, even a Paranoid, Brain-Damaged one that’s been pedantically waiting turn. For fights against large beasts, this sort of character is best given a 2H mace and a spare suit of armour with AFP (Bone Plates for lindwurms), using Indomitable only when threatened by a non-Dazed giant (and, against unholds, to resist charges and to prevent throws when a vulnerable ally would be engaged). Another benefit from Resilient is that, if you are staggered and fatigued against a not-entirely-fresh unhold/schrat whose turn has already passed, just using Recover will leave you ahead of it (with abundant fatigue) for the next turn.
units.zh: 注意，虽然这个角色通常打范围攻击，但面对巨魔、树妖、林德蠕龙这类巨兽，范围攻击并不好用。巨兽的疲劳上限极高，一旦开始喘气积累疲劳，行动顺序很可能落到任何双手剑士后面，即使后者又多疑、又脑损伤，还一丝不苟地等待行动。打巨兽时，这类角色最好换双手钉锤，再备一套带附加毛皮衬垫的护甲；对林德蠕龙则用骨板护层。只有受到尚未恍惚的巨兽威胁时才用不屈；对巨魔，也用它抵抗冲撞，以及防止自己被抛开后让脆弱队友接敌。顽强还有一个好处：如果你已经踉跄、疲劳很高，而对面的巨魔或树妖也消耗了一些疲劳、且本回合已经行动，只用恢复体力，就能在下回合拥有充足可用疲劳并抢在它前面行动。

units.source: {#1}Probable Perks:{/#1} Colossus, Nimble or [Brawny and/or BF], Resilient, Underdog, Reach Advantage
units.zh: {#1}通常会选的特长：{/#1}巨人体魄、轻灵，或者壮硕与久经战阵中的一项或两项；顽强、以少敌多、长兵优势。

units.source: {#1}Possible Perks:{/#1} Pathfinder, Berserk, QH, Fortified Mind, Killing Frenzy, Shield Expert, 2nd Mastery
units.zh: {#1}可选特长：{/#1}寻路者、狂战、快手、坚定心智、杀戮狂热、盾牌精通、第 2 项武器精通。

units.source: {#1}Most Vital Stats:{/#1} Melee Defence (at least ~25, ideally 35+), Melee Skill (at least ~75, ideally 85+)
units.zh: {#1}最重要的属性：{/#1}近战防御至少约 25，最好 35+；近战命中至少约 75，最好 85+。

units.source: {#1}Also Important Stats:{/#1} Max Fatigue (at least 90 with all gear, ideally with ~10 spare), HPs (at least ~90, ideally 100+), Resolve (at least ~50, ideally 60+)
units.zh: {#1}同样重要的属性：{/#1}穿戴全部装备后，至少有 90 可用疲劳，最好再留约 10 余量；生命值至少约 90，最好 100+；意志至少约 50，最好 60+。

units.source: {#1}Recommended Traits:{/#1} Paranoid, Surefooted, Dexterous, Strong, Iron Lungs, Iron Jaw, Athletic, Tough, Brave/Fearless, Hate for Beasts/Greenskins/Undead, Deathwish, Optimist, Hesitant
units.zh: {#1}推荐特性：{/#1}多疑、步伐稳健、灵巧、强壮、铁肺、铁下巴、健步如飞、强健、勇敢或无畏、憎恨野兽或绿皮或亡灵、视死如归、乐观、犹豫。

units.source: {#1}Recommended Backgrounds:{/#1} wildman, hedge knight, messenger, lumberjack, beastslayer, farmhand, brawler, squire, militia, caravan hand, graverobber, gravedigger, butcher, vagabond, flagellant, fisherman, cultist, houndmaster, mason, miller, daytaler
units.zh: {#1}推荐背景：{/#1}荒野人、流浪骑士、信使、伐木工、猎兽者、农场帮工、拳斗者、骑士侍从、民兵、商队杂工、盗墓贼、掘墓人、屠夫、流浪汉、苦修者、渔夫、邪教徒、驯犬师、石匠、磨坊主、短工。

units.source: An easier variant of the above character, with less need for high melee skill and with free additional defence from a shield. Instead of cyclically combining Indomitable with an AOE attack (which requires 90 fatigue in gear, or 82 with Iron Lungs), this character combines it with Riposte (which requires 82 fatigue in gear, or 70 with Iron Lungs). Assuming a fatigue cost of 8 for the 1H sword and of 18 for the best kind of rare shield (offering both high melee defence and high durability), this character would require a minimum of 123 base max fatigue to perform the role in minimal Nimble armour, or 130 allowing for a back-up heater shield (since any shield tends to break in the most massive fights, even without any axes in sight). If you want the role to be performed in efficient heavy armours with ~300+ durability and with LPR and no Brawny (saving a perk only to agonize over whether it’s worth spending it on BF), those requirements will increase to over 140 base max fatigue, again leaving precious little room to distribute stat points (except in instances of Iron Lungs, where the requirements are reduced by 12). Since this character needs less melee skill, it is at least possible to devote more attention to HPs and resolve while taking defence and fatigue to max and near-max values. HPs and resolve need more attention, however, since these guys will always occupy the most vulnerable and isolated positions in the formation (furthest from any sergeant) and will be the most swarmed with enemies (and miasma).
units.zh: 这是上一种角色更容易培养的变体：对近战命中的要求更低，还能从盾牌免费获得额外防御。上一种角色循环使用不屈和范围攻击，穿戴后需 90 可用疲劳，有铁肺则为 82，原文此处与上文数值不一致；这个角色则把不屈与还击架势搭配，穿戴后需 82 可用疲劳，有铁肺则为 70。假设单手剑负担为 8、同时兼具高近战防御与高耐久的极品名贵盾负担为 18，那么穿最轻的轻灵护甲时，基础疲劳上限至少要 123；若再带一面备用熨斗形盾，就要 130。毕竟最大规模的战斗中，即使看不见斧头，盾也常常会破。如果想穿耐久约 300+ 的高效重甲，使用轻型替换衬垫而不点壮硕，省出一个特长点，却又纠结要不要拿去点久经战阵，基础疲劳需求就会超过 140，再次挤占其他属性的成长空间。铁肺例外，它能把需求降低 12。由于不太需要近战命中，至少可以在把防御和疲劳上限堆到最高或接近最高的同时，更多照顾生命值与意志。而且这两项确实更需要投入，因为这些人总会站在阵形中最脆弱、最孤立、离军士最远的位置，被最多的敌人和瘴气包围。

units.source: As mentioned above, the degree of overlap between this character and the zweihander is sufficient that, in some cases, you might be tempted to try combining the two (e.g. taking both Shield Expert and Reach Advantage, or foregoing both of them). Taking Shield Expert makes it much easier to develop this character in the early-mid game, however, as well as prolonging the lifespan and inflating the defence values of any magnificent rare shields you find.
units.zh: 如前所述，这个角色与双手剑士的重叠足够大，有时你会想把两者合并，例如同时选盾牌精通和长兵优势，或两个都不选。不过，盾牌精通能让前中期的培养轻松得多，也能提高你捡到的极品名贵盾的防御，并延长其使用寿命。

units.source: While Riposte and 1H swords inflict rather pitiable damage against heavily armoured opponents, they become highly impressive once most of that armour has been removed from afar by 2-tile weapons, and Riposte is an excellent counter to necrosavants in fights like the Black Monolith. Combining Indomitable with Riposte is mostly more effective (against tough late-game enemies) than combining it with Shieldwall (or Riposte with Shieldwall). Because of diminishing returns, the additional defence gained from Shieldwall is (with standard heater shields) usually not enough to minimize the hit chances of elite, high-damage enemies, and the volume of attacks sustained by these characters in the most massive, prolonged fights is sufficient to make at least one high-damage hit per round likely, even if all hit chances are minimized. Furthermore, enemies with the Shield Expert perk and high melee skill (e.g. honor guards) get a +40 bonus to hit with the Knock Back skill (75+40=115), meaning that they (when spamming the skill en masse, as they always do) still have an obscenely high chance of knocking you back and cancelling Shieldwall and/or Riposte if you use them without Indomitable. Indomitable+Riposte gives more security than Shieldwall+Riposte while allowing the shield tank to contribute a surprisingly impressive amount of damage that reduces the volume/duration of enemy attacks (even with mediocre melee skill values ~65).
units.zh: 还击架势和单手剑对重甲敌人的伤害很可怜，但等远处的 2 格武器削掉大部分护甲后，表现就会非常亮眼；在黑色巨石这样的战斗里，还击架势也很克制死灵剑士。面对后期强敌，不屈加还击架势通常比不屈加盾墙，或还击架势加盾墙更有效。由于收益递减，普通熨斗形盾开启盾墙增加的防御，通常还不足以把精锐高伤害敌人的命中率压到最低。而在规模最大、持续最久的战斗里，这些角色会承受海量攻击，即使敌人命中率都最低，每回合仍很可能挨至少一次重击。此外，带盾牌精通且近战命中高的敌人，例如荣誉卫士，用击退时有 +40 命中加成，75+40=115；它们总会成群反复用这一招，如果你不开不屈，仍有高得离谱的概率把你推开，取消盾墙或还击架势。不屈加还击架势比盾墙加还击架势更稳，还能让盾卫打出意外可观的伤害，哪怕近战命中只有约 65，从而减少敌人的攻击次数或缩短战斗。

units.source: Increasing the pool of in-gear fatigue to 84+ allows the possibility of combining Indomitable with Shieldwall when you want to remain alive in especially tough situations (or if you have an excellent rare shield with an exaggerated melee defence value and want to minimize enemy hit chances in massive fights at legendary locations).
units.zh: 把穿戴后的可用疲劳提高到 84+，就可以在特别艰难、只求活命的情况下，把不屈与盾墙一起用；如果有一面近战防御高得夸张的名贵盾，想在传奇地点的大型战斗中把敌人的命中率压到最低，也能这样做。

units.source: A cheap, cheesy build combining a large shield (and maybe several spares with Bags and Belts) with high initiative to add a significant bonus to melee defence and further lower enemy hit chances by applying Overwhelm with fatigue-neutral attacks. Hitting and damaging things is of no importance. Non-mastered dagger stabs are perfectly sufficient; punches may be even better (unless you have a rare fencing sword with a -3 fatigue cost per skill use). Resilient ensures that any Stagger effect lasts just a single turn. Relentless and Recover are not necessary unless you want to try using some fancy shield skills and/or taking advantage of a small free pool of fatigue to use Indomitable until you have been entirely surrounded by charging orcs (this does help to make this character usable in more high-level fights). While this build is a stop-gap that isn’t intended for the biggest and toughest encounters, it is possible to emerge unscathed from fights against large numbers of lindwurms (especially with Overwhelming assistance from long-distance whippers and bows) …
units.zh: 这是个便宜又取巧的配点：拿大盾，甚至用行囊与腰带多备几面，再靠高先攻增加大量近战防御，使用能维持疲劳收支平衡的攻击来施加压制，进一步降低敌人的命中率。能不能打中、能打多少伤害，都不重要。不点精通的匕首刺击就完全够用，拳头甚至可能更好，除非你有一把每次技能疲劳消耗 -3 的名贵决斗刺剑。顽强确保踉跄只持续一回合。不懈和恢复体力都不是必需，除非你想玩些花式盾牌技能，或者利用少量空余疲劳，在兽人冲锋把你团团围住前使用不屈。这确实能让它适用于更多高难度战斗。虽然这只是过渡方案，并非为最大、最难的战斗准备，但对付一大群林德蠕龙也有可能毫发无损，尤其有远处鞭手和弓手帮忙叠压制时……

units.source: Another cheap, cheesy stop-gap that can be effective before finding something better. The heavy equivalent of the above. No intention of being able to attack twice per turn or use shield skills or make use of any 1H weapon special skills other than those (e.g. Decapitate, Puncture, Split Shield) that are already fatigue-neutral with (or even without) mastery (unless the character is an otherwise mediocre recruit who has Iron Lungs, in which case every-turn use of Destroy Armor is an option). Wears/carries as much gear as possible while still leaving at least 15 fatigue or 19 with Iron Lungs (always recovered and usable each turn). Waiting turn is the only defence against stunning charges. The neglect of fatigue (and initiative) makes it much easier to get HPs and resolve to good values along with melee defence and melee skill. If melee skill is still on the low side (or you want to do Puncture every turn), Fast Adaptation is an option; if it’s already quite high, Killing Frenzy is an option. Bags and Belts allows the carrying of many spare weapons and shields. Quick Hands is not at all necessary (unless you have Iron Lungs and want to combine Destroy Armor with dagger stabs or something).
units.zh: 这又是个便宜、取巧的过渡方案，在找到更好人选前颇有效果，可以视为上一种配点的重甲版本。它不打算每回合攻击两次，不打算用盾牌技能，也不打算使用那些点了精通甚至不用精通仍无法维持疲劳收支平衡的单手武器特殊技能；斩首、破甲刺击、破盾这类能维持平衡的技能除外。如果是其他方面平平、却带铁肺的新兵，也可以每回合用摧毁护甲。尽量穿戴、携带更多装备，只需保证至少留 15 可用疲劳，有铁肺则留 19，每回合都能全部恢复后使用。面对带击晕的冲锋，唯一防备就是等待行动。不投入疲劳上限和先攻，就更容易在提高近战防御、近战命中的同时，把生命值和意志也加到不错的水平。如果近战命中仍低，或想每回合用破甲刺击，可以选快速适应；若命中已经相当高，可以选杀戮狂热。行囊与腰带能带大量备用武器和盾牌。快手完全不是必需，除非你有铁肺，想把摧毁护甲与匕首刺击之类的动作搭配使用。

units.source: Instead of being a conventional shield-user built primarily around high defence, this one is made for the utility of keeping enemies away from vulnerable spots (or encouraging/forcing them into ones that are vulnerable to themselves) with the use of spear and shield skills, and of keeping allies out of harm with Rotation (or one’s self out of it with Rotation or Footwork). Footwork can also be used to disengage from breaching enemies before re-setting Spearwall. If only one enemy has breached the Spearwall, and you want to remain on the same tile (or force the enemy onto a vulnerable tile), shield Knock Back has the same fatigue cost and (with Expert) +40 chance to hit.
units.zh: 这个持盾角色不同于以高防御为核心的传统盾卫，主要负责调位：用长矛和盾牌技能把敌人挡在己方薄弱点之外，或引诱、逼迫它们进入对自身不利的位置；用换位让队友脱险，也用换位或灵活步法让自己脱险。敌人突破矛墙后，还可以用灵活步法脱离，再重新架起矛墙。如果只有一个敌人突破，你又想留在原地，或把敌人推到不利位置，盾牌击退的疲劳消耗相同，点了盾牌精通后还有 +40 命中。

units.source: 90 fatigue with all gear allows (after Recover+Adrenaline on the previous turn) the use of Footwork or Rotation or Indomitable followed by Spearwall. 94 fatigue with all gear allows (after the same) the use of any two combinations of Footwork/Rotation/Indomitable. Iron Lungs would reduce these fatigue requirements to 78 and 82. Combining Spearwall with Indomitable is good when there are lots of charging orcs about and an eventual breach is likely. Combining Rotation with Indomitable or Footwork is good for rescuing wounded allies from tight spots while protecting one’s self (or just avoiding the same spot altogether).
units.zh: 穿戴全部装备后有 90 可用疲劳，便能在上回合恢复体力加肾上腺素后，先用灵活步法、换位或不屈中的一种，再架起矛墙。若有 94 可用疲劳，在同样的准备后，就能任意组合灵活步法、换位、不屈中的两种。有铁肺时，这两项需求降为 78 和 82。周围有大量冲锋兽人、矛墙迟早会被突破时，可以把矛墙与不屈一起用。把换位与不屈或灵活步法结合，则能救出险境中的伤员，并保护自己，或干脆也离开那个险地。

units.source: In theory, the character could use a spetum to lower fatigue costs, and could take Reach Advantage instead of Shield Expert, but a spetum provides no defence once the wall has been breached, and cannot be used to re-position enemies like a shield can. Also, if you do end up surrounded by orcs after the eventual breach of the wall, a few turns of Indomitable+Shieldwall may be the order of the day until assistance arrives.
units.zh: 理论上，可以用三尖矛降低疲劳消耗，并用长兵优势代替盾牌精通；但矛墙一旦被突破，三尖矛就不能提供防御，也无法像盾牌那样调整敌人的位置。另外，如果矛墙终究被冲破，你被兽人包围，可能就得连续几回合用不屈加盾墙，撑到支援赶来。

units.source: Fatigue is the most important stat for this build. In addition to a boar/fighting spear and a preferably large and durable shield, a spare of each is advisable for long and gruelling fights (the extra spear could be just a little goblin one). With this gear and the ideal geared fatigue requirement of 94+, you’ll be looking at a base max fatigue value of over 140 (reduced by 12 by Iron Lungs), even if wearing minimal Nimble armour (the most practical option). Defence, HPs, resolve and melee skill all have some importance (especially if you’re being silly and trying to use a spetum for weird roleplaying reasons), but melee skill is of more moderate importance considering that a 1H Spearwall has +20 chance to hit (and that its mere existence often forces enemies to wait) and that shield Knock Back (with Expert) has +40 chance to hit.
units.zh: 疲劳上限是这套配点最重要的属性。除了猎猪矛或战矛，以及最好又大又耐用的盾牌，漫长艰苦的战斗中，建议矛和盾各备一件；备用矛可以只带小巧的地精矛。带齐这些装备，若要满足理想的 94+ 可用疲劳，即使穿最实用、最轻的轻灵护甲，基础疲劳上限也得超过 140；铁肺能降低 12。防御、生命值、意志和近战命中都有一定重要性，尤其如果你非要为了奇怪的角色扮演拿三尖矛。不过，近战命中的重要性相对有限：单手矛墙有 +20 命中，而且光是摆在那里就经常能逼敌人等待；盾牌击退在点了盾牌精通后，则有 +40 命中。

units.source: This character is potentially very similar to the fatigue-intensive offensive builds, but with less focus on offence (“barbaric” level-11 melee skill in the 70s is okay, but more is welcome if available), a primary focus on fatigue (94+ in all gear with the heaviest weapon equipped), and a definite requirement for the Rotation and Footwork perks (hence “positioner”). The role is ideal for someone from a high-fatigue, high-HP background (ideally with a strong resolve value/talent as well) who seems exceptional except for not being able (except with extremely lucky rolls) to reach ~80 melee skill by level 11.
units.zh: 这个角色可能与高疲劳消耗的输出配点非常相似，只是没那么重视进攻。11 级时有蛮族水平、70 多的近战命中就够用，能更高当然更好。首要属性是疲劳上限：穿戴全套装备、拿最重武器时，仍要有 94+ 可用疲劳；换位和灵活步法则必选，所以叫“调位手”。它很适合那些出身高疲劳、高生命背景，最好意志基础或天赋也不错，其他方面都很出色，却除非成长特别幸运，否则 11 级无法达到约 80 近战命中的人。

units.source: This character can still make a strong contribution to damage at times, but is also used to position others advantageously and (if things go wrong) to rescue them from tight spots (also rescuing themselves with Footwork or tanking damage with Indomitable).
units.zh: 这个角色有时仍能贡献相当多的伤害，但也负责把队友调到有利位置；局面出错时，还要救他们脱离险境，再用灵活步法让自己也脱身，或用不屈扛住伤害。

units.source: A weapon mastery is optional for this character, but mastery of an AOE weapon (or just usage of it with a high fatigue pool) would be useful. Swords offer more angles and are lighter and more accurate (important considerations for this build with its already high fatigue requirements and its lesser focus on melee skill), but axes offer the possibility of being useful by removing shields (and splitting enemy ranged/2-tile units with bardiche attacks).
units.zh: 武器精通不是必选，不过精通一种范围攻击武器，或者只靠高疲劳上限使用它，会很有帮助。剑的攻击角度更多，更轻、命中更高；对本来就极度需要疲劳上限、又不太重视近战命中的这套配点来说，这些都很重要。斧则能靠破盾发挥作用，长刃斧的劈开还能攻击敌方远程或 2 格武器单位。

units.source: Alternatively, the character can just have Quick Hands (a viable option with or without a mastery) and can select a 1-tile and 2-tile item suited to each enemy faced. Maces and dazing are always good. Or, since this character is expected to have less elite melee skill, you may find situational uses for (e.g.) a rare 2H flail with a good damage bonus, or a rare spetum that’s highly fatigue efficient and highly effective against armour.
units.zh: 另一种做法是只选快手，无论是否点精通都可行，再针对不同敌人搭配合适的 1 格和 2 格武器。钉锤与恍惚总是很好用。这个角色的近战命中本来就不算顶尖，因此有时也可以利用其他武器，例如伤害加成很高的名贵双手连枷，或疲劳效率高、对护甲效果出色的名贵三尖矛。

units.source: This character should have Adrenaline, Recover and Indomitable, but should not just mindlessly engage enemies and continually cycle Indomitable with AOE attacks (although this should still be an option for tight situations). Instead, more use should be made of Rotation and Footwork, which have the same fatigue and AP costs as Indomitable, can be used to evade damage altogether (instead of staying in the same spot to stoically tank it), and can be used (Rotation) to position allies favourably or (either) to position one’s self favourably, or (both in tandem) to rescue you both from an awkward spot. For the latter to always be possible (after Recover+Adrenaline at the end of the previous turn), a minimum of 94 fatigue (or 82 with Iron Lungs) is required in gear with the heaviest weapon equipped.
units.zh: 这个角色应有肾上腺素、恢复体力和不屈，但不应无脑接敌，反复循环不屈加范围攻击，尽管危急时仍应保留这个选项。更应该多用换位和灵活步法：它们与不屈的疲劳、行动点消耗相同，却能直接避开伤害，而不是待在原地硬扛；换位能给队友调整有利站位，两者都能让自己站得更好，连续使用还能把双方一起救出险地。若想在上回合末恢复体力加肾上腺素后，始终能完成最后这种组合，穿戴全套装备、手持最重武器时，至少需要 94 可用疲劳；有铁肺则是 82。

units.source: The character’s mobility also allows it to unleash bursts of offensive activity (possibly including AOE attacks) without needing to have elite melee defence (a “barbaric” value ~15 is fine).
units.zh: 这种机动性也让他能短时间猛烈进攻，甚至使用范围攻击，而不必拥有顶尖的近战防御，有约 15 的“蛮族水平”就够了。

units.source: As an example, this character might take the initiative and engage lots of enemies, use Adrenaline (after making an initial attack if possible), make another attack at the start of the next turn, and then rotate a high-defence ally (e.g. an Indomitable/Riposte shield tank or an Indomitable/AOE zweihander) into position. This ally may also have used Adrenaline (or Indomitable on its own), and can subsequently perform its own actions. You can even use two 2H Positioners in tandem, as the barbarians do (hence “barbaric”), with the second one rotating the tankier, more defensive ally into place. For this, you need to keep a careful eye on their initiative values to make sure that they remain in the desired order at the start of the next round.
units.zh: 例如，他可以主动上前接触大量敌人，能先攻击就先打一下，再用肾上腺素；下回合开始时再攻击，然后用换位把一名高防御队友送上去，例如不屈／还击盾卫，或不屈／范围攻击双手剑士。那名队友也可能已经用过肾上腺素，或单独用过不屈，之后就能执行自己的行动。你甚至可以像蛮族那样，让两名双手武器调位手接力，所以才叫“蛮族式”：由第二人再把更耐打、更偏防御的队友换上。这样做时，要仔细留意先攻数值，确保下回合开始时仍按你想要的顺序行动。

units.source: If the character is quickly fatigued after an opening onslaught of activity, that does not matter, since it also has the ability to be fatigue-neutral from the backline with a 2-tile item. If an emergency arises for an ally, the character can co-use Recover and Adrenaline and then, at the start of the subsequent turn, Rotation (to rescue the ally) followed by Indomitable (to tank damage and possibly divert attacks from other allies) or Footwork (to avoid damage) or even (if in an especially heroic/reckless frame of mind) an AOE attack (to finish all the bastards off before they can do any more harm … good luck with that). Recover+Adrenaline (followed by attacks and Indomitable) can also be used if lots of enemies swarm around the formation and make mobility impossible.
units.zh: 开局一轮猛攻后很快累了也没关系，他仍能退在后排，用 2 格武器维持疲劳收支平衡。若队友遇险，就恢复体力并使用肾上腺素，下回合开始先换位救人，再用不屈扛伤，顺便可能吸引对其他队友的攻击；或者用灵活步法避伤。如果特别英勇，或者特别鲁莽，还可以接一次范围攻击，赶在那些混蛋继续伤人前把它们全干掉……祝你好运。若大量敌人把阵形围住，彻底无法移动，也可以恢复体力加肾上腺素，再接攻击与不屈。

units.source: The armour requirements for this character are the same as for all the other fatigue-intensive ones.
units.zh: 护甲要求与其他高疲劳消耗角色相同。

units.source: Sergeants need ridiculously high resolve (for obvious reasons). Since their most important role is repeatedly using the Rally the Troops skill when lots of people are wavering/breaking/fleeing in the face of stupid blue ghosts or ancient priests, they also need lots of fatigue. Rally the Troops has the same fatigue cost as Rotation, Footwork and Indomitable. So why not use all of these perks (and Recover and Adrenaline) so that a good sergeant (who’ll more easily meet the minimum requirement of 94 in-gear fatigue, or 82 with Iron Lungs) can be useful as a positioner/saviour (similar to the Spear/Shield Positioner and the 2H Barbaric Positioner) in fights that don’t pose a severe challenge to resolve?
units.zh: 军士需要高得离谱的意志，原因不言而喻。他最重要的工作，是在许多队友被那些蠢兮兮的蓝色怨魂或古代祭司吓得动摇、濒临崩溃、溃逃时，反复使用鼓舞，因此也需要很高的疲劳上限。鼓舞与换位、灵活步法、不屈的疲劳消耗相同。那为什么不把这些特长全选上，再加恢复体力与肾上腺素呢？一个好军士更容易达到穿戴后最低 94 可用疲劳，有铁肺则是 82；在不太考验意志的战斗里，他就能像长矛／盾牌调位手或双手武器“蛮族式”调位手一样，负责调位救人。

units.source: Alternatively, sergeants can be made more useful by letting them also be whippers/disarmers (if they have high melee skill) or by letting them also be throwers (if they have high ranged skill). They could also in essence be Spear/2H Positioners who take Rally the Troops and Fortified Mind over two of the optional perks for those builds.
units.zh: 也可以用其他方式让军士更有用：近战命中高，就兼任挥鞭缴械手；远程命中高，就兼任投掷手。还可以本质上照长矛或双手武器调位手来练，用重振士气和坚定心智替换其中两个可选特长。

units.source: Battle whips are very light. They have a range of 3 tiles. They can be used to disarm dangerous enemies (whatever their armour). They suck against armour, but they apply two stacks of two-turn bleeding damage per hit against unarmoured enemies, and can be used to hit those enemies twice per turn (potentially eight stacks of 10 bleeding damage inflicted per turn, on top of the base damage of 36-74 for two hits with double grip, resulting in a potential 116-154 total HP damage inflicted per turn, or 76-114 against Resilient enemies – better than a much heavier billhook).
units.zh: 战鞭很轻，有 3 格攻击距离，还能缴械危险敌人，无论对方穿什么护甲。它对护甲很无力，但每次命中无甲敌人，都能施加两层持续两回合的流血，而且每回合可以攻击两次。因此，每回合最多能产生八次、每次 10 点的流血伤害，再加双手握持时两次命中的基础伤害 36-74，每回合合计可造成 116-154 生命伤害；面对有顽强的敌人，也能有 76-114，比重得多的钩镰还好。

units.source: So why not use this wonderful weapon on a light, high-initiative character who applies two stacks of Overwhelm (and multiple stacks of bleeding and more total HP damage than with a billhook) every turn against large beasts with no remaining armour (e.g. unholds, schrats, lindwurms), or who disarms one dangerous enemy every turn (and maybe finishes off another) in tough fights against orcs (berserkers/warlords), barbarians (chosen) and undead (necrosavants, honour guards, possessed fallen heroes), often while standing in a position of safety (but with at least good defence against encroaching enemies thanks to high initiative and Dodge)?
units.zh: 那为什么不把这件好武器交给轻装、高先攻的角色呢？面对护甲已经打光的巨兽，例如巨魔、树妖、林德蠕龙，他每回合能叠两层压制、多层流血，造成比钩镰更高的总生命伤害。在对抗兽人狂战士、兽人军阀、蛮族神选战士，以及死灵剑士、荣誉卫士、被附身的陨落英雄等亡灵的艰难战斗中，他还能每回合缴械一个危险敌人，或许再收掉另一个。通常还能站在安全位置；即使敌人逼近，高先攻加闪避也至少能提供不错的防御。

units.source: Since the whip’s skills require 4 or 5 APs, it is possible to switch to bigger, more armour-efficient weapons (1H or 2H cleavers, throwing items or a mastered billhook) without needing Quick Hands (which is still a nice optional perk, especially if you’d still like to smash things with a 2H mace). The high initiative on this character could also make a fencing sword a tempting option (and a means of escaping from tight spots without Rotation or Footwork).
units.zh: 鞭的技能消耗 4 或 5 行动点，所以不用快手，也能换成更大、更擅长破甲的武器，例如单手或双手斩刀、投掷武器，或点了精通的钩镰。快手仍是不错的可选特长，尤其当你还想用双手钉锤砸人时。高先攻也让决斗刺剑成为诱人的选择，同时还能在不依赖换位或灵活步法的情况下脱离险境。

units.source: Resilient is a very useful perk for rapidly restoring the character’s effectiveness after being staggered (although that should not happen often, especially if you’re careful).
units.zh: 顽强很有用，能让角色遭到踉跄后迅速恢复战斗力。当然，只要足够谨慎，踉跄本来就不该经常发生。

units.source: While the character should have super-high initiative (ideally over 120 at the start of battle) and could come from a low-fatigue background (ensuring a high ratio of initiative versus fatigue), whips can potentially use a lot of fatigue each turn (making Recover a vital perk for restoring effectiveness) and recruits from fairly-high-fatigue backgrounds who also have high talent for initiative are also great for the role.
units.zh: 这个角色的先攻应当极高，最好战斗开始时超过 120。出身低疲劳背景也可以，这能保证先攻相对于疲劳更高；但鞭每回合也可能消耗大量疲劳，所以恢复体力对恢复战斗力至关重要。因此，疲劳上限较高、同时先攻天赋也很高的新兵，同样非常适合这个角色。

units.source: Since this role is very useful for fights involving orc warlords, geists and ancient priests, resolve should not be entirely neglected, despite the character’s typical position of safety.
units.zh: 这个角色在面对兽人军阀、怨魂和古代祭司时很有用，因此即使通常站得安全，也不能完全忽略意志。

units.zh: 我还没在正经战役里多试过击剑士，倒是在不太正经的试验局里折腾过。他们确实既有效又好玩，尤其如果你弄到一把每次技能疲劳消耗 -3 的名贵决斗刺剑。

units.source: Basically a character who combines Polearm Mastery (5 APs per attack) with use/mastery of another weapon with a 4-AP cost per skill use.
units.zh: 基本思路是把长柄武器精通带来的每次攻击 5 行动点，与另一种每次技能消耗 4 行动点的武器搭配起来；后一种武器也可以点精通。

units.source: Depending on the talents/stats and the perks selected, the character could be fatigue-intensive, mostly fatigue-neutral or initiative-based, and could be very similar to (or the same as) some of the builds already outlined above (e.g. Throwing Duellist, Overwhelming Whip, Heavy Metal Dazer, High-Functioning Mushroom Addict, 2H “Barbaric” Positioner).
units.zh: 视天赋、属性和所选特长而定，这个角色可以走高疲劳消耗、基本维持疲劳收支平衡，或以先攻为核心。它可能与前面介绍的某些配点很相似，甚至就是同一个角色，例如投掷决斗家、压制鞭手、重钉锤控场手、高效嗑菇手、双手武器“蛮族式”调位手。

units.source: For the fatigue-intensive options, 92 in-gear fatigue (80 with Iron Lungs) would allow (after Recover+Adrenaline) two billhook attacks (either side of Berserk) to be combined with use of Indomitable (or Rotation or Footwork). 94 in-gear fatigue (82 with Iron Lungs) would allow the combined use (after the same) of any two of the 25-fatigue skills.
units.zh: 高疲劳消耗方案中，穿戴后有 92 可用疲劳，有铁肺则是 80，就能在恢复体力加肾上腺素后，用钩镰攻击、击杀触发狂战、再攻击，并使用不屈，或换位、灵活步法。若穿戴后有 94 可用疲劳，有铁肺则是 82，就能在同样的准备后，把任意两种消耗 25 疲劳的技能组合使用。

units.source: While it might be said that the combination of Polearm Mastery (5 APs) and Throwing Mastery (4 APs) is unnecessary, since the latter can attack twice per turn (and inflict more HP damage against suitable targets), it should be remembered that polearms inflict more damage against naked or heavily armoured enemies (and can be used initially to lower the value of enemy armour to Duellist-prey levels), and that throwing weapons can be used to attack targets from 3 or 4 tiles (even 6 with a sling) after killing a first target from 2 tiles. With Berserk, a kill with a mastered billhook (after no initial movement) leaves you with 8 APs and the ability to move one tile before attacking again. If you have throwing weapons and good ranged skill, you can move two tiles before attacking again. Even in situations in which throwing weapons can do more damage than a polearm, it is possible for accuracy with ranged attacks to be severely impeded by terrain obstacles that pose no problem for polearms. Ranged accuracy is also impeded at night, and high-damage throwing weapons also have limited ammo.
units.zh: 有人会说，长柄武器精通的 5 行动点攻击，与投掷精通的 4 行动点攻击没必要同时选，因为后者每回合本来就能攻击两次，而且对合适目标造成的生命伤害更多。但别忘了，长柄武器对无甲或重甲敌人的伤害更高，还能先削甲，把敌人打到适合决斗家收割的护甲水平。投掷武器则能在击杀 2 格外的首个目标后，转攻 3 或 4 格外的敌人，投石索甚至能打 6 格。若有狂战，起手不移动、用精通的钩镰击杀后，会剩 8 行动点，能移动一格再攻击。如果带投掷武器且远程命中不错，就能先移动两格再攻击。即使投掷武器本可造成更高伤害，地形障碍也可能严重妨碍远程命中，而长柄武器不受这种影响。夜间也会降低远程命中，高伤害投掷武器的弹药还很有限。

units.source: A traditional, reliable sniper against necromancers in the early-mid game. Takes conventional ranged perks (and levels ranged defence) to stay alive before reaching level 7 and becoming semi-immortal with Nimble. May continue to boost initiative to more readily Overwhelm enemies for the benefit of allies. May later metamorphose into a damage-dealer with Throwing Mastery and Duellist, or may (with good melee skill and especially with Iron Lungs) metamorphose into a hybrid fencer or whipper.
units.zh: 传统而可靠的狙击手，在前中期负责射杀亡灵法师。选择常规远程特长，并提高远程防御，撑到 7 级点出轻灵，变得近乎不死。之后可以继续提高先攻，更容易用压制帮助队友；也可以点投掷精通和决斗家，转为输出手。若近战命中不错，尤其还带铁肺，也能转为兼任击剑士或鞭手的混合角色。

units.source: The nature of fights against giant orc camps (and the effectiveness of set-ups against them) can vary somewhat depending on the composition of the garrison. Some of them have very large numbers of heavily armoured warriors and only small-ish numbers of youngs and berserkers (often a total garrison size ~24); others have masses of youngs and berserkers and a more modest number of warriors (often a garrison size in the low 30s); others have rather large quantities of youngs, berserkers and warriors (often a garrison size in the mid/high 30s).
units.zh: 大型兽人营地的战斗方式，以及不同配置的效果，会随守军构成而变化。有些营地重甲战士很多，兽人青年和狂战士相对少，守军总数通常约 24；有些则有大量兽人青年和狂战士，兽人战士较少，总数通常是 30 出头；还有些三者都很多，总数通常在 30 多的中段或高段。

units.source: Despite their masses of armour, the camps with large numbers of warriors and very few berserkers tend to be the easiest. Not having to worry about being stunned by charging youngs (or split in two by berserkers) makes it much easier to handle the warriors, despite their greater individual difficulty rating. More berserkers increases the actual difficulty because of their menacing weapons, their greater resistance to injuries and negative morale states, and their greater mobility for moving over terrain (Pathfinder) and lesser stupidity in charging into enemies using Indomitable or Spearwall (they tend to keep moving around and forcing you to use more energy as a precaution). The combination of large numbers of berserkers and warriors (and a warlord with a double-gripped rare weapon with an obscene damage boost) makes for the toughest orc fight.
units.zh: 尽管护甲极厚，兽人战士多、狂战士很少的营地往往最容易。少了兽人青年冲锋击晕和狂战士把人劈成两半的顾虑，兽人战士即使单体难度更高，也更好处理。狂战士越多，实际难度越高：它们武器凶猛，更能抵抗伤势和负面士气，有寻路者、跨地形更灵活，也不会那么傻地冲向开着不屈或矛墙的敌人。它们更喜欢四处绕行，逼你为防备而多消耗体力。大量狂战士与战士，再配一个双手握持伤害加成高得离谱的名贵武器的军阀，就是最难的兽人战。

units.source: High numbers of charging young can pose problems, but they make orc battles easier because of the ease with which they drop to wavering/breaking/fleeing morale if you take the initiative with Adrenaline and spam AOE and/or 2-tile attacks against them (or even just as a result of being repelled by Spearwalls). Lots of fleeing young often has a knock-on effect on the morale of warriors and even the warlord (I once encountered a “champion” warrior who was already fleeing before managing to strike a blow), but the warlord is likely to rally some of them, and you need to remain vigilant for irritating end-of-round stunning charges by youngs who seemed as good as dead only moments before.
units.zh: 大量兽人青年冲锋确实会制造麻烦，但它们也让兽人战更容易。你若用肾上腺素抢先，不断用范围或 2 格攻击打它们，很容易把它们打到动摇、濒临崩溃或溃逃，甚至光靠矛墙把它们挡回去也会如此。大批兽人青年溃逃，往往会连带动摇战士乃至军阀的士气。我曾遇到过一个精英兽人战士，还没来得及出手就已经逃了。不过军阀可能重整其中一部分，因此必须小心：刚才还像必死无疑的兽人青年，可能突然在回合末冲锋，把人击晕。

units.source: For large orc camps, I usually have 3-4 Indomitable tanks (2H/AOE or Shield/Riposte, the latter type on the flanks), 4-6 offensive quick-handed 2H characters, 0-2 Spear/Shield Positioners, 1-2 Overwhelming Whippers, and 1 sergeant (who may also be a whipper). Sometimes I may have a ranged character as well. If not, I usually give the sergeant or someone else a staff sling to start the battle, to trick the orcs into thinking that we have a ranged threat and that they need to advance instead of sitting back and adopting a clumsy defensive formation. If there are lots of warriors and only a few berserkers, taking up a desired position (with Indomitable on the frontline) and waiting for the orcs to advance into it is fine.
units.zh: 大型兽人营地中，我通常带 3-4 名不屈承伤角色，使用双手范围攻击或持盾还击，后者放在侧翼；再带 4-6 名有快手的双手武器输出手、0-2 名长矛／盾牌调位手、1-2 名压制鞭手，以及 1 名军士，军士也可能兼任鞭手。有时还会带远程角色。若没有，我通常让军士或其他人开战时拿投石杖，骗兽人以为我方有远程威胁，必须推进，而不是待在后面摆出笨拙的防御阵形。如果兽人战士多、狂战士少，占好预定位置，前排开不屈，等兽人自己走进来就行。

units.source: If there are lots of berserkers, it’s better to be more proactive in tying lots of them up with tanks in the opening rounds (but you don’t need to be pedantic and it’s fine if a few of them still end up circling around your formation).
units.zh: 如果狂战士很多，开局几回合最好更主动，用承伤角色缠住其中大量敌人。不过不用过分较真，仍有少数绕着阵形走也没关系。

units.source: In either case, I like to leave a gap of one or two tiles between each of the Indomitable tanks at the front of my formation (or, if there are two sword-wielding zweihanders, they may stand next to each other in the centre, with a gap of two tiles between the others). Generally, a 2-tile gap between the occupants of the frontline is desirable, since that leaves just enough room for a single careless orc to advance through each of the gaps to engage the backline. Usually, this careless orc is a warrior who is unable to attack on that same turn, and who is quickly Dazed and/or Disarmed and stripped of all armour, and close to death before it gets any chance to attack (if it even does).
units.zh: 无论哪种情况，我都喜欢在前排不屈承伤角色之间留一两格空隙；如果有两名持剑的双手剑士，也可以让他们在中央并肩站立，与其他人之间留两格。一般来说，前排成员之间留 2 格较理想，因为每处空隙刚好只容一个冒失兽人穿过，接触后排。通常，钻进来的是兽人战士，当回合已经无法攻击，接着很快就会被打入恍惚、缴械、剥光护甲，还没机会出手就濒临死亡，甚至根本没机会出手。

units.source: Ideally, the sergeant should be within a 4-tile range of everyone (or at least within 5 tiles of the tanks on either flank, so that it is a simple matter to move one tile to either side and use Rally if required).
units.zh: 理想情况下，军士应距离每个人都在 4 格以内；至少也应距离两翼承伤者不超过 5 格，这样只需向任意一侧移动一格，就能在必要时鼓舞。

units.source: If there are lots of berserkers, they can be proactively engaged by tanks who advance and (after attacking if possible) use Adrenaline (followed by Indomitable and AOE or Riposte at the start of the next turn). It may be possible for a positioner to advance and rotate a zweihander in the opening round, so that the latter can advance one tile and AOE, and then use Adrenaline (followed by AOE+Indomitable at the start of the next round). Thereafter, the tanks should continue cycling Indomitable with AOE or Riposte, sometimes waiting turn as a precaution (e.g. to lower their initiative on “on” turns, and as a precaution against stunning charges from rallied orcs on “off” turns after using Recover+Adrenaline).
units.zh: 狂战士很多时，可以让承伤者主动上前接敌，能先攻击就先打，然后用肾上腺素；下回合开始再用不屈，加范围攻击或还击架势。开局也可能让调位手先上前，用换位送上双手剑士，使后者还能前进一格并打出范围攻击，再用肾上腺素，下回合开始接范围攻击加不屈。之后，承伤者继续循环不屈与范围攻击或还击架势。有时应先等待以防意外，例如在输出回合降低先攻，或在恢复回合用了恢复体力加肾上腺素后，防备重整士气的兽人冲锋击晕。

units.source: 2-handers with 2-tile items should advance behind the tanks and use Adrenaline to try to kill/injure/demoralize as many berserkers as possible in round 2. They may repeat this in round 3 (waiting turn after Adrenaline use if there’s a risk of a stunning charge onto the backline). Whippers should be positioned to be in range of a couple of berserkers (or youngs with double-gripped orc weapons), while remaining relatively guarded within the formation. Whippers may be engaged by warriors in the late stages of long battles, and may choose to Recover and Disarm and/or switch to a 1H or 2H cleaver to do more damage while continuing to apply Overwhelm. Lots of youngs (and hopefully lots of berserkers) will be killed/injured/demoralized in the early rounds. The warriors and the warlord will shamble slowly forwards. If there are a couple of Spear/Shield Positioners, they should be on the rear flanks to delay any outflanking berserkers and to delay the warriors/warlord until enough of the others have been cleared out of the way. After Spearwall is breached, the positioner may be able to Recover and use Footwork+Spearwall, but more probably should either just Footwork away and re-form Spearwall at another point later on, or go into tank mode with Shieldwall+Indomitable (this helps to tie up lots of orcs to let the damage-dealers focus on offence and not worry about stuns/Indomitable). Often, the warriors will start trying to outflank, but then change their minds and try to occupy a spot vacated by a dead/fleeing young/berserker. This often means that they move into engagement without being able to attack, allowing them to be netted and/or disarmed and/or dazed and quickly reduced to a state of uselessness. Nets make warriors even easier to hit/disarm/daze, prevent them from pushing through the formation (unless you want to lure them further in), and encourage them to waste APs on trying to break free. Nets can also be thrown over any berserkers who have advanced to within 2 tiles of the general formation (making it rather safe to stand and attack them with 2-tile items).
units.zh: 带 2 格武器的双手武器手应跟在承伤者后面推进，使用肾上腺素，争取第 2 回合尽可能多杀伤、打击狂战士的士气。第 3 回合也可以重复；如果后排可能遭到冲锋击晕，用完肾上腺素后就先等待。鞭手应站在能打到几个狂战士，或双手握持兽人武器的兽人青年的位置，同时尽量留在阵形保护之内。战斗拖久后，鞭手可能被兽人战士贴身；这时可以恢复体力、缴械，或换成单手或双手斩刀，在持续施加压制的同时提高伤害。最初几回合应能杀伤、打击大量兽人青年的士气，希望也能这样对付大量狂战士。战士和军阀则会慢吞吞地向前挪。如果有两名长矛／盾牌调位手，应放在后侧两翼，拖住绕侧的狂战士，并延缓战士和军阀，直到其他敌人清得差不多。矛墙被突破后，调位手也许能恢复体力，再用灵活步法加矛墙；但更常见的选择，是先用灵活步法脱身，之后换个位置重建矛墙，或改用盾墙加不屈承伤。这能缠住大量兽人，让输出手专心进攻，不必担心击晕或忙着开不屈。战士经常先想绕侧，又改主意去填死去或逃跑的兽人青年、狂战士留下的空位。因此它们接敌后往往不能立即攻击，可以趁机投网、缴械、打入恍惚，迅速废掉。网能让战士更容易被命中、缴械、打入恍惚，阻止其撞穿阵形，除非你有意引它更深入，还能诱使它浪费行动点挣脱。逼近阵形 2 格以内的狂战士也可以网住，之后原地用 2 格武器攻击就相当安全。

units.source: The fight will be overwhelmingly in your favour, but there will be lots of orcs and lots of armour to break through, and the warlord will rally some fleers and you will need to remain vigilant for end-of-round stunning charges. Any shield tanks will almost certainly have their shields broken, and will need to arm with a spare (if they can afford the fatigue to carry one) or hope that double-gripped Ripostes will help to finish off any remaining youngs/berserkers and allow the 2-handers (no longer threatened by stunning charges) to advance on the warriors/warlord with 2H maces/axes and 2-tile weapons. Zweihanders (or shield tanks) may end up in the awkward position (despite having waited turn) of being ahead of warriors in the turn order when they need to Recover, and will have to hope that Nimble/HPs/armour/defence (or even a bit of offence) keeps them safe until the final orc-slaying advance of their offensive comrades. It usually does.
units.zh: 战局会明显偏向你，但兽人数量多，护甲也厚，军阀还会重整逃兵，所以仍须警惕回合末的冲锋击晕。盾卫的盾几乎肯定会碎，必须换备用盾，如果他们的疲劳上限允许携带的话；否则只能指望双手握持下的还击架势，帮助清掉剩余兽人青年和狂战士，让双手武器手不再受冲锋击晕威胁，能拿双手钉锤、斧和 2 格武器压向战士与军阀。双手剑士或盾卫可能遇到尴尬局面：即使已经等待，到了需要恢复体力时，行动顺序仍在战士前面。此时只能指望轻灵、生命值、护甲、防御，甚至一点进攻，保他们撑到输出队友发起最后的屠兽攻势。通常能撑住。

units.source: Generally speaking, the largest goblin camps are tougher (and less enjoyable to fight) than the largest orc ones. Rul’gazhix always has 43 goblins (including 3 shamans and 3 overseers); other large camps have a garrison size from the mid-20s to mid-30s, including more than one shaman and/or more than one overseer.
units.zh: 一般来说，最大的地精营地比最大的兽人营地更难，打起来也更烦。鲁尔加希克斯固定有 43 个地精，包括 3 个萨满和 3 个地精督军；其他大型营地的守军，从 20 多的中段到 30 多的中段不等，其中萨满或地精督军不止一个。

units.source: Overseers whip their underlings directly into a state of confident morale (or rally them if they’re fleeing from a spree of slaughtered allies) and occasionally shoot crossbow bolts that (if they hit the head) are much more comfortably countered by Nimble than by heavy armour (BF makes no meaningful difference to ignore-armour damage). AFP is good against body-shots from spiked impalers, but the Fur Padding attachment (the white one created from two unhold furs) may be better to have against large goblin camps, since the persistent low-level damage from ambusher bows can easily remove a suit of Nimble armour in a single round (even with Indomitable active). Heavy suits of armour last longer, of course, but their occupants are more susceptible to Puncture attacks (and poisoning) while cursed/vined/netted, and are dead meat if their armour eventually runs out.
units.zh: 地精督军能一鞭子把手下直接打到斗志昂扬；如果手下因同伴接连被杀而溃逃，也能将其重整。它们偶尔还会射弩箭，若命中头部，轻灵比重甲更容易扛住，因为久经战阵对无视护甲的伤害没有实质帮助。附加毛皮衬垫能很好地抵御刺桩重弩命中身体，但大型地精战或许更适合普通毛皮衬垫，就是用两张巨魔毛皮做的白色那一种：伏击者弓箭持续的小额伤害，很容易一回合打光轻灵护甲，即使开着不屈也一样。重甲当然能撑更久，但穿它的人被诅咒、藤蔓或网困住时，更容易遭到破甲刺击并中毒；护甲最后一旦耗尽，就只能等死。

units.source: Shamans have the automatic ability to trap any enemy (within an 8-tile range) within vines, and additional enemies from 9 tiles away will also be trapped if they are behind the ones who are in range. Having a height advantage increases the range of the shaman’s skills (i.e. potentially to 11 tiles, and potentially trapping enemies from 12 tiles away, in the worse-case scenario).
units.zh: 萨满能直接用藤蔓缠住 8 格以内的敌人；如果其他敌人站在这些范围内目标的后方，即使距离 9 格，也会一起被缠住。高地会扩大萨满技能的范围，最坏情况下可达到 11 格，甚至把 12 格外的敌人也一起困住。

units.source: The goblin trophy confers immunity to being trapped in nets/vines. You can give this to a backliner who focuses on freeing others from nets/vines so that they can concentrate on offence, or you can give it to an Indomitable shield tank who tries to press through the melee to catch the shamans and/or chase them away out of range of others.
units.zh: 地精战利品项链能免疫网和藤蔓束缚。可以给一名后排成员，让他专门帮其他人解开网和藤蔓，好让他们集中输出；也可以交给不屈盾卫，让他试着穿过混战抓住萨满，或把萨满追赶到无法影响其他人的距离之外。

units.source: Shamans also have the ability (with the same range) to curse any enemy (including the one wearing the goblin trophy).
