Whereas vines reduce melee and ranged defence (and initiative) by 35% (compared to 45% with the nets thrown by many of the skirmishers), curses reduce these values (and melee and ranged skill) by 50% and essentially render the combatant useless for the duration of the curse (4 entire turns without the Resilient perk).
units.zh: 萨满还可以在相同距离内诅咒敌人，佩戴地精战利品项链的人也不例外。藤蔓使近战防御、远程防御和先攻降低 35%，许多散兵投出的网则降低 45%；诅咒会把这些属性连同近战命中、远程命中一起降低 50%，基本让受害者在持续期间丧失作用。没有顽强的话，会持续整整 4 回合。

units.source: As a general rule, shamans prioritize trapping you in vines while any of you are loose and in range, and resort to cursing if you make no attempt to break free from the traps and just try to slaughter goblins with AOE and/or Berserking attacks. Without the Resilient perk, it’s easy to end up with an entire company cursed (as well as netted/vined) and all too easy to poison with Puncture attacks (or arrows once most armour is gone). The Poisoned status effect lasts for 5 turns without Resilient, and initially reduces your AP count to 5 (not enough for a big 2H attack, and only just enough to try to break free from any nets/vines, which feels futile since they’ll just be replaced before you get another chance to act).
units.zh: 一般来说，只要范围内还有没被困住的人，萨满会优先用藤蔓；如果你不试着挣脱，只顾用范围攻击或狂战连续屠杀地精，它们就会开始诅咒。没有顽强，很容易全队都被诅咒，还困在网或藤蔓里，极易被破甲刺击打中并中毒；护甲大多没了之后，箭也能造成同样后果。没有顽强时，中毒持续 5 回合，起初会把行动点降到 5，连大型双手武器攻击都不够，只勉强够尝试挣脱网或藤蔓。而这也让人觉得徒劳，因为还没轮到你再次行动，它们就又补上了。

units.source: So it’s a conundrum. High-initiative troops are relatively useless against large goblin parties with multiple shamans (even if their initial initiative is higher than any of the goblins), since freeing themselves from nets/vines lowers their initiative and lowers their offensive output, and remaining in the nets/vines keeps their initiative lowered and results in them being perpetually cursed and incapacitated (but I suppose that an entire company of Relentless fencers with extreme values of melee attack and defence could work for this fight thanks to the ease of killing goblins with lunge attacks after breaking free). High-fatigue troops can attack/kill, break free with the additional APs from Berserk, and then advance one tile (and maybe use Adrenaline to kill a goblin at the start of the next turn if they’re very lucky), but it doesn’t take long for them to be back in nets (and more likely to be Poisoned since they moved instead of using Indomitable on the previous turn). If they are cautious and use Indomitable instead of moving after breaking free, the shamans will curse them and make them useless for the duration of the curse.
units.zh: 这就是难题所在。面对多个萨满带领的大队地精，高先攻角色相对没什么用，即使开局先攻高过所有地精也一样。挣脱网和藤蔓会降低先攻、减少输出；留在其中则持续压低先攻，还会被不断诅咒，彻底失去作用。不过，我想如果全队都是带不懈、近战命中和防御极高的击剑士，或许也能打，因为挣脱后用突刺杀地精很容易。高疲劳上限角色能先攻击击杀，靠狂战多出的行动点挣脱，再向前一格；运气极好时，还能用肾上腺素在下回合一开始再杀一个。但很快就会重新被网住，而且上回合移动而没用不屈，更容易中毒。若谨慎些，挣脱后不移动、改用不屈，萨满又会诅咒你，让你在整个持续期间无所作为。

units.source: That is why Resilient is a great perk against annoying enemies like shamans and hexen. After using Recover+Adrenaline from a state of exhaustion, and waiting turn if any shamans are still to act in the round, any tank or damage-dealer can then use a curse-free combination of fatigue-intensive offensive/defensive skills at the start of the next round, potentially allowing you to win the battle even if you’re boring and decide to remain rooted in nets/vines for much of the fight. Fortunately, the poor resolve of goblins means that several untouched ones are liable to end up fleeing after a sudden spree of kills.
units.zh: 所以，顽强特别适合对付萨满、女巫这类烦人的敌人。筋疲力尽时先恢复体力加肾上腺素，如果本回合还有萨满没行动，就先等待；这样无论承伤者还是输出手，下回合开始都能摆脱诅咒，正常组合高疲劳消耗的攻防技能。即使你采取很无聊的打法，大部分时间留在网和藤蔓里，也可能赢下战斗。好在地精意志差，一波突然的连杀之后，几个没受伤的也可能直接逃跑。

units.source: The most stress-free way to beat the biggest goblin city (besides using a load of level-25 archers with 110 ranged skill and continually reloading until you start on the high-ground) is to leave just a few Indomitable shield tanks within range of the shamans and to withdraw everyone else out of range (taking care to allow for the effect of any height elevations held by the shamans). Luckily, the wolfriders and skirmishers (and some ambushers) will still advance towards your main body, even if you don’t have any archers.
units.zh: 打赢最大地精城市，压力最小的办法，除了带一群 25 级、110 远程命中的弓手，不断读档直到刷在高地上之外，就是只留少数不屈盾卫在萨满范围内，其余人全部退出范围。记得把萨满占高地带来的射程变化算进去。幸运的是，即使你没带弓手，狼骑兵、散兵和部分伏击者仍会向主力推进。

units.source: Almost everyone except the trophy-wearer is liable to be vined in round 1, since the shamans will have range on those in the front rank (at least 3), and anyone behind will also be caught. This impedes mobility, but everyone should be able to break free (hopefully at the first attempt) and then move away from the frontal tanks (hopefully out of range of the shamans) if they have any more APs. If they are unable to move out of range of the shamans in round 1, or if they are unable to move away onto neutral or advantageous terrain, they should use Adrenaline and then move to suitable terrain at the start of round 2. After that, from their position of relative safety, it should be straight-forward to slaughter the goblins who advance (remaining cautious to avoid being in range of too many ambushers).
units.zh: 第 1 回合，除佩戴项链者外，几乎所有人都可能被藤蔓困住：萨满能覆盖前排至少 3 人，站在他们后面的人也会被连带缠住。这会妨碍移动，但每个人应该都能挣脱，希望第一次就成功，再用剩余行动点远离前方承伤者，希望能离开萨满范围。若第 1 回合无法退出范围，或无法移动到平坦、对己方有利的地形，就用肾上腺素，第 2 回合开始再去合适位置。之后，从相对安全的位置屠杀推进的地精，应该就不难了；但仍要小心，别同时进入太多伏击者的射程。

units.source: The shield tanks at the front will need to remain rooted in nets/vines, except any one of them to which you have given the goblin trophy. A tank with the trophy can try to move through the melee (probably using Indomitable as a precaution) to catch or chase one or more of the shamans (and probably several ambushers and the odd overseer as well). The others should continue using Riposte+Indomitable (or even Shieldwall+Indomitable if their armour’s getting thin) every other turn, always waiting turn (if they have the Resilient perk) to recover from any curses before coming under attack in the next round). After using Recover+Adrenaline on “off” turns, they should also wait turn if any shamans are still to act, since this will cause them to recover from any fresh curses before the start of the next round. The shamans will almost certainly curse them again in the next round, but the shamans usually act after the other goblins, and so the curse will not be active for the majority of attacks.
units.zh: 前方盾卫必须留在网或藤蔓里，佩戴地精战利品项链的人除外。戴项链的盾卫可以试着穿过混战，抓住或追赶一两个萨满，大概也会顺带赶跑几个伏击者和偶尔一名地精督军；最好先开不屈以防万一。其他盾卫继续隔一回合使用还击架势加不屈，护甲薄了甚至改用盾墙加不屈。如果有顽强，务必先等待，让诅咒在下回合挨打前消退。在恢复回合用过恢复体力加肾上腺素后，只要还有萨满没行动，也应等待，这样新中的诅咒也会在下回合开始前消退。萨满下回合几乎肯定还会再诅咒，但它们通常比其他地精晚行动，因此多数攻击到来时，诅咒并未生效。

units.source: Once the advancing goblins have been slaughtered by the main body of troops who moved back in the opening rounds, there is likely to be an awkward spell in which the main body needs to move forwards again to get at the remaining goblins (and the shamans who can curse and trap them). The best thing to do is take a turn or two to Recover everyone’s fatigue and to move them all to within 9 tiles of the nearest shaman (again taking account of the effect of height levels). In the next round, after all of them have waited turn until the shamans have (hopefully) ended their turns, they can all advance 4 tiles (keeping at least 1 tile’s gap between themselves) and use Adrenaline, and then all advance to within attacking range of a shaman (again keeping a gap of at least one tile between themselves). This advance will also threaten lots of ambushers (and possibly the overseers) and make them less willing to remain still and shoot. In the next round, it won’t be possible for the shamans to root everyone, and any shamans or other goblins who remain still to use skills will probably be within attacking range of someone who isn’t rooted in place (even anyone who is rooted in place might have a 2-tile attacking opportunity). The rest of the battle could still be a bit messy, and casualties are a possibility (especially if any of the advancers were already bereft of armour), but from this point your victory is assured.
units.zh: 开局撤后的主力杀光推进的地精后，通常会有一段尴尬时期：你必须重新前进，才能打到剩余地精，以及会困住、诅咒你的萨满。最好先花一两回合让全队恢复体力，再推进到距离最近萨满 9 格处，仍要考虑高低差。下回合全员先等待，直到萨满应该都结束行动了，再一起前进 4 格，彼此至少隔 1 格，并使用肾上腺素；随后在下一次行动中，全员进入能攻击萨满的距离，仍保持至少一格间隔。这波推进也会威胁大量伏击者，可能还包括地精督军，让它们不敢站定射击。下一回合，萨满不可能困住所有人；凡是原地使用技能的萨满或其他地精，大概都会落入某个未被束缚者的攻击范围。就连被困住的人，也可能有 2 格攻击机会。剩下的战斗仍可能混乱，也可能有人伤亡，尤其是推进者早已没了护甲时；但从这里开始，胜利已经确定。

units.source: Honor guards have 75 melee skill and often wield ancient pikes with +10 chance to hit that inflict 68-100 raw damage against armour (or rhomphaias with +10 chance to hit that inflict up to ~70 raw armour damage per hit). Necrosavants have 85 melee skill and wield double-gripped cleavers that inflict up to 85 raw damage (per hit) against armour. The Conqueror has 90 melee skill and Fast Adaptation and an innate damage bonus and wields a crypt cleaver that (accounting for the damage bonus) can inflict over 100 raw armour damage per hit. A level 11 veteran who started with 5 base melee defence and 2 talent stars and levelled melee defence every time will have 35 melee defence, meaning that necrosavants and pike/rhomphaia-wielding honor guards will have a basal 50% chance to hit, and that one stack of Reach Advantage will be required for The Conqueror to have half a chance of missing (before instantly gaining +8 from Fast Adaptation). Other honor guards and ancient legionaries wield tower shields (with an effective 48 durability) and habitually form shieldwalls that give them 50 melee defence (plus another 5 for any adjacent allies using the skill). Necrosavants and The Conqueror don’t have shields but do have 25 base melee defence. A level 11 veteran who started with 55 melee skill and 2 talent stars and levelled melee skill every time will have 85 melee skill, and will still miss shieldwalling legionaries more than half the time, and necrosavants and The Conqueror more than a third of the time. And our hypothetical level 11 veteran would have only another 10 stat improvements available to distribute among fatigue, HPs and resolve. Given the high-damage and high hit-chances of the above enemies, it’s pretty important to wear good armour and to be able to use Indomitable a lot, which means that plenty of fatigue is needed. Given that it takes a lot of time to kill shieldwalling skeletons and teleporting necrosavants (and to work through all The Conqueror’s armour and HPs), and given that many of their weapons inflict bleeding damage and that they are accompanied by priests who continually plant miasma clouds across the battlefield, HPs are also of high importance. And, given that priestly spooking can drop morale (and impair combat stats and increase the risk of further morale failures) or impose the Horrified status effect (and potentially cause the sacrifice of a turn and the inability to use Indomitable when surrounded by perilous enemies in miasma), resolve is also important. 62 HPs and 33 resolve won’t cut it (truly, I’ve seen tanks with ~90 resolve drop from steady to wavering to breaking morale just as a result of being engaged in melee by a couple of legionaries with broken swords).
units.zh: 荣誉卫士有 75 近战命中，常持带 +10 命中的古代长枪，对护甲基础伤害为 68-100；也会持同样有 +10 命中的镰刃长剑，每击基础护甲伤害最高约 70。死灵剑士有 85 近战命中，双手握持斩刀，每击基础护甲伤害最高 85。征服者有 90 近战命中、快速适应、固有伤害加成，还拿墓穴斩刀，计入加成后，每击基础护甲伤害可超过 100。假设一名 11 级老兵起始近战防御为 5、有 2 星天赋，每次升级都加近战防御，最终会有 35。这意味着死灵剑士、持古代长枪或镰刃长剑的荣誉卫士，基础命中率仍有 50%；还得叠一层长兵优势，征服者才有一半概率打空，然后快速适应立刻给它 +8 命中。其他荣誉卫士和古代军团兵持有效耐久 48 的塔盾，习惯架盾墙，让近战防御达到 50，每个相邻、同样开盾墙的盟友再加 5。死灵剑士和征服者没有盾，但基础近战防御有 25。假设一名 11 级老兵起始近战命中为 55、有 2 星天赋，每次都加近战命中，最终会有 85；攻击开盾墙的军团兵，仍超过一半会失手，攻击死灵剑士和征服者，也超过三分之一会失手。而这名假想的 11 级老兵，只剩另外 10 次属性提升，可以分配给疲劳上限、生命值和意志。敌人伤害、命中都这么高，穿好甲、经常用不屈就很重要，因此需要大量疲劳上限。杀死盾墙骷髅、传送的死灵剑士，以及打穿征服者的护甲与生命，都很耗时；许多武器还会造成流血，随行祭司又不断在战场上铺瘴气，因此生命值同样重要。祭司的恐吓还能降低士气，损害战斗属性、增加后续士气检定失败的风险，或造成惊恐状态，可能迫使你放弃一回合，在危险敌人与瘴气包围下无法用不屈，因此意志也很重要。62 生命值和 33 意志远远不够。我真的见过约 90 意志的承伤者，仅仅被几个拿断剑的军团兵贴身，就从镇定掉到动摇，再到濒临崩溃。

units.source: In the Black Monolith, you face a total of 47 enemies, including The Conqueror, 6 necrosavants, 3 ancient priests and a plethora (i.e. an awful bloody lot of) honor guards (as well as an awful bloody lot of shieldwalling or pike-wielding legionaries). How can you beat this host in a single battle with a level 11 party (or a level 11-16 party, given that some veterans will probably gain additional levels while you’re getting the others up to scratch)? And how can you do it now that it’s no longer possible for 2H damage-dealers to gain free defence from shields without crippling themselves offensively?
units.zh: 黑色巨石一共要面对 47 名敌人，包括征服者、6 名死灵剑士、3 名古代祭司，以及多得该死的荣誉卫士，外加同样多得该死的盾墙军团兵和长枪军团兵。只靠 11 级队伍，怎么在一场战斗里打赢？或者说，11-16 级的队伍，毕竟你把其他人练成时，部分老兵可能又升了几级。更何况，双手武器输出手如今已经无法在不严重损害进攻能力的前提下，从盾牌白拿防御了，又该怎么办？

units.source: The most effective formation I’ve found for this fight (using the typical kind of troops that I use, some with uber-defence, some with uber-offence, but few with uber-both) involves four lines. The frontline has two zweihanders next to each other in the centre, and two shield tanks on either flank, with a 1-tile gap between the tanks and zweihanders. The shield tank on the western flank (the most vulnerable spot) could be a pure shield (armed only with a dagger to reduce fatigue and allow a spare shield) who endlessly cycles Indomitable+Shieldwall (ideally with a rare shield with enhanced durability and melee defence); the other shield tank at the front should also have enough usable fatigue to cycle Indom+Shieldwall in an emergency, but should generally favour Indom+Riposte (better for clearing necrosavants). Three characters are positioned in the centre of the second line, behind the zweihanders at the front. Two of these (the ones to either side) are axe-users (with a longaxe, a bardiche and/or greataxe and/or a battle-whip); the one in the centre could be another axe-user or a whipper with mastery (fatigue-intensive or initiative-based). In the centre of the third line, behind the axes/whips, are two more offensive characters who should have very high melee skill and preferably an abundance of fatigue and high mobility (i.e. the Rotation and Footwork perks). These two should be armed with 2H maces, battle-whips (mastered or not) and either a bill or a longaxe. Behind these two, in the centre of the backline, is the sergeant (4 tiles from each of the shield tanks on the flanks of the frontline), who should also have abundant fatigue and the Rotation and Footwork perks (and possibly, if you can squeeze it in, a whip with Quick Hands). (The sergeant’s position could be switched with one of those immediately ahead, if one of those has fairly high melee defence, but these three are likely to switch positions at points in the fight anyway.) On the flanks of the backline, 3 tiles behind the front flanks and just to their inside, are two more troops with high melee defence. The one on the western flank (the second-most vulnerable spot, most likely to encounter The Conqueror) should definitely be a shield-user (with the option of Indom+Riposte or Indom+Shieldwall, and ideally with a spare shield, since the initial one is almost certain to break); the one on the eastern flank could be another zweihander (even a Round-Swinger). Since the eastern rear flank is the position from which exposure to miasma and curses is most minimal, this is the best spot for a zweihander with exceptional melee values but mediocre HPs and resolve (but at least try to have close to ~90 and ~50 instead of 62 and 33, since teleporting necrosavants can easily break morale when it most needs to stay solid).
units.zh: 我找到的最有效阵形有四排，适合我常用的队伍：有人防御极强，有人进攻极强，但两者兼具的很少。前排中央并肩放两名双手剑士，左右各放一名盾卫，盾卫与双手剑士之间留 1 格。西侧是最危险的位置，这里的盾卫可以彻底专注防御，只带匕首以降低疲劳负担、腾出余力带备用盾，不断循环不屈加盾墙，最好拿一面耐久和近战防御都增强的名贵盾。前排另一名盾卫也应有足够可用疲劳，能在紧急时循环不屈加盾墙，但平时更应偏重不屈加还击架势，方便清理死灵剑士。第二排中央站三个人，在前排双手剑士后方；两侧用斧，携带长柄斧，再带长刃斧、巨斧或战鞭。中间可以再放一名斧手，或点了精通的鞭手，无论是高疲劳消耗型还是先攻型都行。第三排中央，在斧手、鞭手后面，再放两名输出手。他们应有极高的近战命中，最好还疲劳上限高、机动性强，也就是有换位和灵活步法。这两人应带双手钉锤、战鞭，无论鞭是否精通，再带钩镰或长柄斧。两人后方，末排中央是军士，距离前排两翼盾卫都是 4 格；他也应有很高疲劳上限、换位和灵活步法，如果挤得出位置，也可以带鞭和快手。如果紧邻前方的其中一人近战防御较高，可以与军士互换位置，反正这三人在战斗中很可能会多次换位。末排两翼，在前排两翼后方 3 格、略向内的位置，再放两名高近战防御成员。西侧是第二危险的位置，最可能遇到征服者，必须用持盾角色，可选不屈加还击架势或不屈加盾墙，最好带备用盾，因为第一面几乎肯定会破。东侧可以再放一名双手剑士，甚至用回旋斩的双手斧手。东后侧受到瘴气与诅咒的影响最少，最适合近战属性出众、生命值和意志却一般的双手武器手。但至少尽量有约 90 和约 50，别只有 62 和 33，因为传送而来的死灵剑士很容易在最需要稳住军心时击垮士气。

units.source: If any of the quick-handed characters have any spare slots for additional items, they could start the battle with throwing spears and/or nets (most of them will only be able to have the latter). Nets are best thrown over necrosavants once they have engaged one of the flank tanks, so that others can whip/Disarm/bleed them and shift a tile to hit them with bigger items, sometimes using Adrenaline when there’s a chance to finish one off). If no quick-handed character can manage a throwing spear, the zweihanders at the front (or even one or both of the shield tanks at the front) could start the battle with a throwing spear, which should be used in pairs to remove a tower shield from a skeleton who is advancing towards the zweihanders (making it easier for the vulnerable shieldless zweihanders to get off to a good start, building up some Reach Advantage and making early kills and confident morale more likely). If using throwing spears without QH on the frontline, you’ll need to be committed to keeping them in the same spots, since they’ll need the rest of their APs to arm with their usual weapons in round 1 (allowing them to attack in round 2).
units.zh: 若有快手的角色还有空位，可以开战时带投矛或网，不过多数人只能再带网。最好等死灵剑士贴住侧翼承伤者，再把网扔上去，让其他人鞭打、缴械、叠流血，或移一格换重武器攻击；有机会收掉它时，也可以用肾上腺素。如果所有快手角色都带不动投矛，前排双手剑士，甚至前排的一名或两名盾卫，可以开战时拿投矛。两根配合，用来拆掉向双手剑士推进的骷髅的塔盾，让脆弱的无盾双手剑士开局更顺，叠起长兵优势，更容易尽早击杀并进入斗志昂扬状态。前排若没有快手却用了投矛，就必须准备留在原地，因为第 1 回合剩余行动点要用来换回常用武器，才能第 2 回合攻击。

units.source: While shield-splitting seems severely laborious against such a host, only a small number of shieldwalling legionaries will be able to engage the vulnerable zweihanders at any one time, and there’s no reason why the axe-users on the second line can’t occasionally remove a tower shield as a team (perhaps after Berserking). Making the frontal legionaries vulnerable makes it easier for the zweihanders to build higher defence and can create opportunities for them (after kills, especially if they’ve found room for Berserk) to advance a tile to directly engage the pike-wielding legionaries, who do not have Polearm Mastery and who will incur a -15 penalty to hit-chance. Such an opportunity should probably be seized even if the zweihanders aren’t able to remain Indomitable, since the axes behind them will probably be able to advance and make quick work of the ancient pikes.
units.zh: 面对这么多敌人，破盾似乎费时费力，但任一时刻，能贴住脆弱双手剑士的盾墙军团兵其实只有少数。第二排斧手完全可以偶尔配合拆掉一面塔盾，也许是在触发狂战之后。让正面的军团兵更脆弱，双手剑士就更容易叠防御，也可能在击杀后，尤其点出了狂战时，前进一格直接贴住长枪军团兵。后者没有长柄武器精通，贴身会受 -15 命中惩罚。即使双手剑士无法继续维持不屈，也大概值得抓住这个机会，因为身后的斧手很可能跟着推进，迅速解决古代长枪手。

units.source: Another excellent way of keeping the zweihanders safer against ancient pikes is to disarm their wielders, who are much easier to disarm than necrosavants (The Conqueror is immune). Disarming honor guards with rhomphaias or crypt cleavers is also sometimes a good idea (e.g. if they’ve engaged the zweihanders or any of the axe-users). Necrosavants should mostly only be disarmed by masters of the whip (but extinguishing their Nine Lives with bigger weapons and then finishing them off with basic whips is best, and hopefully some of them will be taken out by Ripostes from the tanks).
units.zh: 让双手剑士免受古代长枪威胁，还有个极好的办法：缴械持枪者。它们比死灵剑士容易缴械得多，而征服者免疫缴械。有时也值得缴械持镰刃长剑或墓穴斩刀的荣誉卫士，例如它们已经贴住双手剑士或斧手时。死灵剑士大多只应交给鞭术娴熟、点了精通的人缴械；不过，最好还是先用重武器打掉九命，再用普通战鞭收尾，也希望盾卫的还击能带走其中几个。

units.source: The longer the shield tanks in the most vulnerable spots can stay alive, the greater the chance of victory. It is unlikely that those on the western flanks will survive, but they should cling to every last HP with clenched fists. The better their health (and that of their armour) when The Conqueror engages, the better the chance of victory.
units.zh: 最危险位置上的盾卫活得越久，胜算越大。西侧的人很可能无法幸存，但他们应该攥紧拳头，守住最后一点生命。征服者贴上来时，他们自身和护甲的状态越好，获胜的机会就越大。

units.source: Since The Conqueror engages (towards the western rear flank) after the initial engagement, it is typical for the tank on that flank to already be almost entirely surrounded when the boss arrives. Ideally, there will be one free spot for the boss to engage the tank to the interior of the formation, near or next to the sergeant or one of the 2H mace-wielding troops towards the rear. Alternatively, The Conqueror may engage one of these centre-rear troops directly. Either way, the protocol is to try to Daze it after its turn has ended, so that it is not necessary to use Adrenaline. If the sergeant is engaged, one of the damage-dealers can be rotated into place to daze The Conqueror. The other centre-rear damage-dealer (also now armed with a 2H mace) can either move a tile to attack The Conqueror (if this is possible without engaging anything else) or be rotated in turn for an attack (or just attack from 2 tiles if that’s the only option). On the next turn, they can attack again, with Footwork probably being used to avoid damage (or the sergeant can rotate one of them away and then use Footwork or Indomitable). If the western rear tank is engaged by The Conqueror and getting into to trouble, Indomitable can be used instead of Footwork so that one/some of these fresher troops with lower melee defence are likely to be attacked instead. The axe-users from the second line may also be able to attack with longaxes (even whips), and quickly killing The Conqueror should be a priority. Note that hitting The Conqueror’s armour from 2 tiles does not incur the 20% damage reflection, and that using Indomitable before hitting it from 1 tile (but not after doing so) halves the reflective damage.
units.zh: 征服者会在最初交锋之后才接战，通常从西后侧靠近。因此，它到来时，那一侧承伤者往往已经几乎被完全包围。理想情况下，阵形内侧还剩一个空位，让它能贴住承伤者，同时靠近或紧挨军士、后方某名双手钉锤手。它也可能直接贴上中央后方的这些人。无论哪种情况，基本流程都是等它结束行动后，再尽量打出恍惚，这样就不必用肾上腺素。若军士被贴住，就换位送上一名输出手，使它陷入恍惚。中央后方另一名输出手也换好双手钉锤，如果不会接触其他敌人，就移一格攻击；否则再通过换位上前打一击，实在没办法就只从 2 格外打。下回合他们可以再攻击，然后多半要用灵活步法避伤；也可以让军士把一人换走，自己再用灵活步法或不屈。如果西后侧承伤者正被征服者攻击、陷入危险，就可以用不屈代替灵活步法，让这些状态更好、近战防御较低的成员吸引它的攻击。第二排斧手也可能用长柄斧，甚至战鞭攻击；迅速击杀征服者应当优先。注意，从 2 格外攻击它的护甲，不会触发 20% 伤害反弹；从 1 格攻击时，必须先用不屈再打，才能把反伤减半，打完后再用没有效果。

units.source: If you’ve killed The Conqueror and all the necrosavants, and the flank tanks are all still alive and with at least a little bit of durability left in them, victory is at this point assured. If one or even both of the western tanks have fallen (or are on the brink of it), but the zweihanders are still in good/decent health, there is still a reasonable chance of victory, but it’s liable to be an awkward and laborious mess.
units.zh: 如果已经杀掉征服者和所有死灵剑士，而侧翼承伤者全部还活着、多少还撑得住，那么胜利已经稳了。如果西侧一人甚至两人都倒下了，或濒临倒下，但双手剑士状态仍好或尚可，也仍有不错的胜算，只是后面很可能变成一场别扭、费劲的烂仗。

units.source: Not having any more teleporting necrosavants makes it much easier to Recover in safety, to patiently wait turn within 2 or 3 tiles of pike-wielders, and then move in to attack after their turn has ended, knowing you’ll get to attack again (and hopefully kill them and Berserk) before being attacked yourself. Whippers can disarm pike-wielders. Longaxe-users can occasionally team up to remove a tower shield (making infuriating prolonged sequences of team-missing less likely). Zweihanders should prioritize directly engaging pike-wielders. Those with 2H maces should prioritize dazing enemies while any adjacent pikes have been disarmed.
units.zh: 没有不断传送的死灵剑士后，就更容易安全地恢复体力。你可以耐心待在长枪手 2 或 3 格外等待，等它们结束行动再上前攻击，知道自己在挨打前还能再攻击一次，希望能击杀并触发狂战。鞭手可以缴械长枪手，长柄斧手则偶尔联手拆掉一面塔盾，减少全队接连打空、拖得令人抓狂的情况。双手剑士应优先直接贴住长枪手；双手钉锤手则在附近长枪已经缴械时，优先给敌人施加恍惚。

units.source: The hard (or at least irritating) part is when the priests move towards you and start spawning more miasma and uttering curses. This is when you’ll wish you hadn’t gone along with the common wisdom that ~50 resolve is fine on “frontliners” and that resolve can be more-or-less neglected on everyone else. Sometimes someone will have advanced close to a priest and waited to see if there’s an opportunity for Adrenaline, only to be trapped in miasma and then Horrified and unable to move away. It’s best to try to keep everyone within a reasonable distance of the sergeant, in addition to keeping away from the miasma.
units.zh: 最难，或者至少最烦的部分，是祭司开始接近、不断铺瘴气并施放诅咒。这时你就会后悔相信“前排约 50 意志就够，其他人基本不用管意志”的普遍说法。有时某人靠近祭司，先等待看看是否有用肾上腺素的机会，结果却被瘴气困住，接着陷入惊恐，无法离开。除了远离瘴气，最好尽量让所有人离军士不要太远。

units.source: The remaining honor guards, who are actually acting as guards to the priests, have such low initiative that they are always behind you in the turn order, and they always wait turn as well. You can’t maintain Indomitable cycles against them, and they can always attack you after you engage them. However, if any shield tank is still alive with decent HPs (and hopefully a tiny bit of armour too), it’s good to engage one or more of these guards and use Indomitable (thereby preventing them from further movement to protect the priests). In the absence of any shield tanks with semblance of life, zweihanders will have to perform this role. In either case, it will create opportunities for damage-dealers to advance into range of the priests and use Adrenaline to attack before they can be Horrified. There will still be some loose honor guards to advance against these troops, but these ones will be relatively isolated and it should be fairly simple for someone to daze or disarm them (or just kill them as quickly as possible). Once only one priest remains, it is highly satisfying (even if it’s clinging to just a few HPs) to ritually execute it with the most gruesome, gratuitous weapon/attack available. This is a special moment for rare 2H axes or maces, or for Decapitate with a rare cleaver.
units.zh: 剩下的荣誉卫士真正承担着保护祭司的职责。它们先攻极低，总排在你后面，也总会等待行动。你无法对它们维持不屈循环；一旦主动贴上去，它们总有机会在你之后攻击。不过，如果还有盾卫活着、生命值尚可，最好也还剩一点护甲，就该让他贴住一个或多个卫士，使用不屈，阻止其继续移动保护祭司。如果盾卫都快不成人样，只能由双手剑士来做。无论怎样，这都能给输出手创造机会，让他们进入祭司攻击范围、使用肾上腺素，抢在陷入惊恐前出手。仍会有零散荣誉卫士前来迎击，但它们相对孤立，应该不难让人打入恍惚、缴械，或干脆迅速杀掉。等只剩最后一名祭司，即使它只剩几点生命，也要用手里最残酷、最过火的武器或攻击，像行刑一样解决它，那一刻特别解气。名贵双手斧、双手钉锤，或名贵斩刀的斩首，正适合这个特殊时刻。

units.source: Give the goblin trophy (also a kraken trophy) to someone who has Hammer Mastery (or a rare billhook with awesome armour effectiveness), and spend the opening rounds removing the kraken’s head armour with Demolish Armour (or just Strikes). The kraken’s body-armour is never hit/removed. The tentacles/irrlichts are (unarmoured) parts of the beast’s body, and killing them directly removes its HPs despite the presence of armour (but only up to a point). Once only eight irrlichts remain (vs 12 at the start), killing them no longer removes HPs (and they always regenerate) and you can only remove HPs by attacking the kraken directly – but all attacks are to the head and remove HPs once the head armour is gone. So that means that everyone should be armed with a battle whip (the 3-tile range is very handy), and that at least some of them should have Cleaver Mastery to increase the bleeding damage. Those without mastery should also have a jagged pike or a mastered billhook (better damage when only one attack is possible), and everyone should also have a high damage 2H sword/axe/mace/cleaver. Everyone in the party should have high melee skill (at least ~80+, but the more the better) for breaking free and freeing others (no shield tanks), along with a high pool of usable fatigue and the Recover perk. High melee defence makes casualties less likely, but you can get away with mediocre values on most people (e.g. 10-25) if the gods are pleased with you. High HPs (with Nimble or heavy armour) is highly advisable. Resolve isn’t important if you avoid casualties, but no sergeant means no Rally if anyone’s morale weakens after a casualty.
units.zh: 【译注：本节保留作者当时版本的克拉肯打法。】把地精战利品项链，也可以说是克拉肯战利品项链，交给有战锤精通的人，或持破甲能力出色的名贵钩镰者，开局几回合用粉碎护甲，或普通打击，拆掉克拉肯的头甲。它的身甲不会受到攻击，也不会被削除。触手，也叫伊尔利希特，是野兽身体上没有护甲的部分；杀死触手能无视主体护甲，直接扣除生命值，但只到一定阶段为止。最初有 12 条触手，等只剩八条时，再击杀就不扣主体生命，而且触手总会再生，只能直接攻击克拉肯削血。不过所有攻击都会打中头部，头甲拆光后就能扣生命。因此，每个人都该带战鞭，3 格距离很有用；至少部分人应有斩刀精通，提高流血伤害。没有精通的人，还应带锯齿长枪，或点了精通的钩镰，在只够攻击一次时造成更多伤害。人人还都应带一把高伤害双手剑、斧、钉锤或斩刀。全队近战命中都要高，至少约 80+，越高越好，以便自行挣脱和解救队友，不带盾卫；同时要有大量可用疲劳和恢复体力。近战防御高能减少伤亡，但如果诸神眷顾，多数人只有 10-25 这样的一般水平也能过。强烈建议高生命值，搭配轻灵或重甲。只要没人死，意志不重要；但没有军士，一旦有人死亡、其他人士气动摇，就没有鼓舞可用。

units.source: Once a certain portion of the kraken’s HPs have been removed by killing irrlichts, and possibly before the trophy-wearer has finished removing the head armour, these tentacles will become enraged and sometimes attack instead of dragging someone towards the beast (so it’s best if the trophy-wearer has high melee defence, even if the gods are pleased with you). Their attacks hit the head 50% of the time (so it’s best to have relatively heavy headgear, e.g. a barbute on Nimble guys), and they do high damage with high armour effectiveness, and cause bleeding (luckily just 5 per turn). They’re also frightfully accurate, and they always have high melee defence (25) and the Underdog perk. Hitting them (or breaking free from them) is especially awkward if you’re in the swamp. It may be worth having two Backstabber guys trying to stun two tentacles per turn with maces, but this uses a lot of fatigue (and they may be in the swamp and miss, or just miss anyway) and they may be dragged while highly fatigued and unable to move much (or at all) if they break free (sure to be snared before getting a chance to Recover). You may be better off just dazing lots of them (with or without mastery) to reduce their damage and quickly kill them and force them to re-spawn at a remove.
units.zh: 通过击杀触手削掉克拉肯一定比例生命后，可能在戴项链的人尚未拆光头甲时，触手就会狂暴，有时不再拖人，而是攻击。因此，即使诸神眷顾，戴项链者也最好有高近战防御。触手攻击有 50% 概率打头，所以头盔最好相对厚重，例如轻灵角色可以用巴布特盔。它们伤害高、破甲强，还会造成流血，好在每回合只有 5 点。命中也高得吓人，而且始终有 25 近战防御和以少敌多。身处沼泽时，打中它们或挣脱尤其麻烦。也许值得让两名带背刺者的人拿钉锤，每回合各晕一条触手，但这会大量消耗疲劳，而且可能因沼泽而失手，也可能单纯就是打空。若随后在高疲劳下被拖走，即使挣脱，也可能只能移动一点，甚至动不了，没机会恢复体力就又被缠住。也许更好的选择是，不管是否有精通，尽量用双手钉锤让更多触手恍惚，降低伤害，再迅速杀死它们，逼其在较远处重生。

units.source: Indomitable is a useful skill in this fight (you can’t be dragged while it’s active), but trying to cycle it endlessly is utterly futile. The kraken always waits turn, and irrlichts also wait turn if there is no one to drag or attack, meaning that you will be dragged after using Recover (and that co-use of Adrenaline will leave you with less fatigue to move away or hide or use Indomitable after breaking free). In some cases, however, enraged irrlichts will act to attack you (and do less damage) while you are Indomitable, and therefore leave you free to Recover with Adrenaline and re-use Indomitable.
units.zh: 不屈在这场战斗里很有用，生效时不会被拖走，但想无休止地循环它完全徒劳。克拉肯总会等待行动；触手若没人可拖、没人可打，也会等待。这意味着你恢复体力后仍会被拖走；同时使用肾上腺素，还会让你挣脱后剩下更少可用疲劳，难以远离、躲藏或使用不屈。不过，有时狂暴触手会在你开着不屈时攻击，伤害也较低，于是你之后就能自由地恢复体力加肾上腺素，再次用不屈。

units.source: If you are hidden in bushes, irrlichts will generally not be able to find and drag you, but it is still possible for them to re-spawn on adjacent tiles (or be displaced onto adjacent tiles when someone breaks free), and in these cases they will snare/drag you. Also, if everyone is hidden, they immediately become miraculously capable of locating you. Still, hiding in bushes (especially at a remove from others, e.g. after being dragged and breaking free and using Adrenaline to run and hide and avoid being recaptured before you can act again) is sometimes a very sound strategy (including in the opening rounds when you are trying to get everyone to good terrain before being dragged).
units.zh: 藏在灌木中，触手通常找不到、也拖不走你。但它们仍可能在相邻格重生，或在其他人挣脱时被挤到相邻格；这时仍会缠住并拖走你。另外，如果所有人都躲起来，它们立刻就会奇迹般地找到你。即便如此，躲灌木有时仍很稳妥，尤其是与其他人拉开距离。例如被拖走后挣脱，用肾上腺素抢先跑开藏好，避免尚未再次行动就被抓住。开局想在被拖前把全队带到好地形时，这也有用。

units.source: Adrenaline is situationally useful in this fight, including for getting everyone to good terrain in the opening rounds and for escaping and hiding after breaking free in proximity to the kraken, as indicated above. You may be able to Recover safely from a hidden spot at a 2- or 3-tile distance from the kraken, and then attack it with a whip or 2-tile item while the irrlichts attack/snare others further away.
units.zh: 肾上腺素在这场战斗里视情况很有用，包括开局把全队带到好地形，以及如前所述，在克拉肯附近挣脱后逃跑藏匿。你也许能躲在距克拉肯 2 或 3 格的隐蔽处，安全恢复体力，然后趁触手在更远处攻击、缠住其他人，用鞭或 2 格武器攻击主体。

units.source: Pathfinder is of course very useful for getting everyone to good terrain in the opening rounds. Once everyone (except the trophy-wearer) is grouped on good terrain, keeping everyone free from tentacles (which applies some damage to the tentacles) should generally be prioritized over attacks, but opportunities for kills should often be taken, since this forces the slain tentacle to re-spawn at a remove and reduces the rate at which they can snare and drag. Once the irrlichts are enraged, it’s a good idea to minimize their numbers with kills as quickly as possible. In other cases, when no kills are available and there is no one adjacent who can’t be freed by someone else, it is sometimes best to take a turn to Recover if quite a bit of fatigue has been built up.
units.zh: 寻路者当然很有助于开局把全队带到好地形。除戴项链者外的所有人都在好地形上集结后，通常应优先确保每个人都摆脱触手，再考虑攻击；挣脱本身也会伤到触手。但有击杀机会时，经常值得抓住，因为被杀的触手会在较远处重生，减少它们缠缚、拖人的频率。触手狂暴后，更应尽快击杀，压低数量。其他时候，如果没有击杀机会，旁边也没有只能靠你救的人，而你已经积累了不少疲劳，有时最好花一回合恢复体力。

units.source: At some point, some/many/most of you will need to move closer to the kraken (by themselves or by being dragged), and it’s best to have a high pool of fatigue free when this happens. Some may hang back and try to occupy lots of irrlichts (or lead them further away). The irrlichts tend to be more attack-oriented (and less drag-oriented) when someone has lost their armour and some HPs, and so this might be a fitting time for someone to become a noble sacrifice.
units.zh: 到了某个阶段，部分、许多、甚至大多数人都必须靠近克拉肯，主动过去或被拖过去都有可能。发生这种情况时，最好留有大量可用疲劳。有些人可以留在后面，尽量牵制多条触手，或把它们引得更远。某人护甲掉光、生命也损失一些后，触手更倾向攻击而非拖拽，所以这或许是让某个人英勇献身的合适时机。

units.source: Depending on how things pan out, and on the layout of the terrain, it may be possible for one or more of you to move forwards and occupy a hidden tile (ideally on good ground) in attacking range of the kraken. If this is not possible, it will not be possible to apply further damage so freely, and more of you will need to go forth (which increases the risk of someone breaking free next to the kraken only to have no free tile to move to). If some of the irrlichts stay back and keep attacking, some of you can stay back to kill them (if someone has been Devoured and others have dropped to wavering morale, killing irrlichts is the only way to induce a positive morale check in the absence of a sergeant).
units.zh: 视战况与地形而定，可能有一个或多个人能前进，占据克拉肯攻击距离内的隐蔽格，最好还在良好地面上。如果做不到，就没法这么自在地持续输出，更多人必须向前，这也提高了风险：有人在克拉肯旁边挣脱，却没有空格可走。若部分触手仍留在后方攻击，也可留人杀掉它们；一旦有人被吞噬、其他人降到动摇士气，在没有军士的情况下，杀触手就是触发正面士气检定的唯一办法。

units.source: Once some/many/most of you are close to the kraken and in range to attack, some/many of you will still be snared and potentially dragged into contact with the kraken, and the options when this happens are (a) to be freed by someone else who sacrifices one attack, (b) to free yourself and move to a good tile and use Indomitable, (c) to free yourself and move one tile, (d) to free yourself and move a tile and use Adrenaline (and then move to a hidden tile or as far away as possible), (e) to free yourself (or fail to free yourself) and be exhausted (and/or still snared) and get Devoured, or (f) to free yourself and (in sheer frustration and as a last act of defiance) use Decapitate with a 2H cleaver (or a rare orc 1H one) before being Devoured (or you may even manage to finish the beast off in style with this course of action).
units.zh: 等部分、许多、甚至大多数人都靠近克拉肯、进入攻击距离后，仍会有不少人被缠住，甚至拖到它嘴边。此时的选择包括：（a）让别人牺牲一次攻击来救你；（b）自行挣脱，移动到好格子，再用不屈；（c）自行挣脱，移动一格；（d）自行挣脱，移动一格并用肾上腺素，之后躲进隐蔽格或尽量跑远；（e）挣脱或挣脱失败，最后筋疲力尽，或者还被缠着，遭到吞噬；（f）自行挣脱，在极度恼火之下作出最后反抗，用双手斩刀，或名贵兽人单手斩刀斩首，然后被吞噬。当然，也可能靠这一击帅气地终结巨兽。

units.source: Kraken fights are generally repetitive yet unpredictable, with a high risk of casualties (which can impair morale and increase the risk of further casualties). But if everyone in attacking range of the kraken is either fresh or Indomitable or hidden, and if everyone who’s fatigued has managed to move further away (too far to be dragged next to the kraken, but maybe at just the right distance to be dragged next to someone fresher who can free them and allow them to Recover), the risk of casualties will be lower and the chance of victory greater.
units.zh: 克拉肯战通常重复而难以预测，伤亡风险很高；伤亡又会打击士气，增加后续损失。但如果所有进入克拉肯攻击距离的人，都体力充足、开着不屈或躲着，而所有疲劳过高的人都已退远，远到不会被一把拖到克拉肯旁边，却可能刚好被拖到状态更好、能救他们并让其恢复体力的队友旁边，那么伤亡风险就会降低，胜算也更大。

units.source: Adrenaline allows you to act before anyone else in the next round. It does this by adding a value of 2000 to your initiative (for the purpose of determining the turn order). If more than one person uses Adrenaline, the one with the highest initiative (for the purpose of determining the turn order) will act first in the next round. Adrenaline usage isn’t the only thing that affects initiative for the purpose of determining the turn order. The other thing that affects it (and that also is not reflected in the initiative value displayed on character screens) is waiting turn. Waiting turn results in 25% of your initiative being subtracted (for the purpose of determining the turn order). So, if you’ve used Adrenaline and waited turn, your initiative (for the purpose of determining the turn order) will be 1500 (plus whatever probably low value of regular initiative remained on the character screen after using Adrenaline).
units.zh: 肾上腺素让你在下一回合先于其他人行动，具体做法是为决定行动顺序所用的先攻加上 2000。如果多人使用肾上腺素，决定行动顺序的先攻最高者，下回合最先行动。影响这个数值的并不只有肾上腺素，还有等待行动，而且后者也不会体现在角色面板的先攻数值中。等待会把用于决定行动顺序的先攻扣去 25%。因此，如果用了肾上腺素又等待，这个数值就会是 1500，再加上用完肾上腺素后角色面板上剩余的、通常很低的常规先攻。

units.source: Barbarians have more initiative than the vast majority of my guys (despite, in the case of chosen, also wearing much heavier armour than many of them), and they also recover astronomical amounts of fatigue each turn (often bolstered still further by drummers) and (unlike any other enemy in the game) also have the Adrenaline perk (and will readily use it if they sense that a nearby opponent has higher initiative than themselves – including initiative from the turn-order bonus applied by Adrenaline).
units.zh: 蛮族的先攻比我队伍里绝大多数人都高，神选战士甚至还穿着比许多队员重得多的护甲。它们每回合恢复的疲劳也高得惊人，往往还有鼓手进一步增强。而且，按本文当时的敌人配置，它们与其他敌人不同，也有肾上腺素；一旦察觉附近对手先攻更高，就会很乐意使用，包括察觉到对手使用肾上腺素获得的行动顺序加成。

units.source: Fortunately, barbarians also wait turn before using Adrenaline, lest they waste energy unnecessarily when no one nearby will be ahead of them for the next turn anyway (not that it would really matter, given how much fatigue they recover). This means that, if you move in and use Adrenaline and don’t wait turn, you will be ahead of them for the next round, despite their usually higher regular initiative. For example, even if your regular initiative is -100 and theirs is 100, using Adrenaline without waiting turn will increase your initiative (for the purpose of determining the turn order) to 1880, whereas using it with waiting turn will increase theirs to 1560.
units.zh: 好在蛮族也会先等待，再用肾上腺素，以免附近本来就没人能在下回合抢先，还白白浪费体力。当然，考虑到它们恢复多少疲劳，其实也没多大差别。这意味着，你若上前使用肾上腺素而不等待，即使常规先攻通常较低，下回合也能排在它们前面。例如，你常规先攻即使是 -100，它们是 100，你用肾上腺素而不等待，决定行动顺序的先攻就会到 1880；它们等待后再用，则会到 1560。

units.source: If you and a barbarian have both used Adrenaline, and you are first to act in the subsequent round, staggering that barbarian with a 2H hammer will send it right to the end of the turn order for that round, despite having used Adrenaline! But beware that the same thing can happen to you if you accidentally wait before/after using Adrenaline!
units.zh: 如果你和某个蛮族都用了肾上腺素，而你下回合先行动，用双手锤让它踉跄，就会把它直接送到本回合行动顺序末尾，哪怕它已经用了肾上腺素！但要小心：如果你误在使用肾上腺素前后等待，同样的事也可能发生在你身上！

units.source: Because of the Adrenaline/initiative/turn-order mechanics outlined above, chosen do not get to act before tanks who are using Indomitable cycles (phew). It means that you can seize the initiative and use Adrenaline yourselves, or hang back and wait and take precautions if some of them do eventually use Adrenaline. If they are separated from your frontline by one tile, you can use Indomitable or throw nets over them or just move back so that they are unable to move+attack on the next turn anyway (possibly protecting any ranged characters whose turn has ended with a Rotation or Spearwall).
units.zh: 根据上述肾上腺素、先攻与行动顺序的机制，神选战士无法抢在循环不屈的承伤者前面行动，谢天谢地。你可以主动抢先使用肾上腺素，也可以后撤等待，若有敌人终于用了肾上腺素，再采取防备。若它们与前排之间隔着一格，你可以用不屈、朝它们投网，或干脆后退，使其下回合无法移动后攻击。必要时，还可用换位或矛墙保护已经结束行动的远程角色。

units.source: A downside of knowing that you can usually out-Adrenaline chosen is in situations in which you realize that a chosen could engage you (but not attack) later in the current turn, and will definitely be ahead of you for the next turn – unless you immediately use your last little bit of fatigue on Adrenaline as a precaution against this (thereby guaranteeing that you won’t be able to use Indomitable after attacking them in the next round, if they even engage you to start with).
units.zh: 知道自己通常能在肾上腺素竞速中胜过神选战士，也有一个坏处。有时你意识到，某个神选本回合稍后可能贴上来，但不能攻击，而下回合肯定先于你行动；除非立刻用最后一点可用疲劳开肾上腺素预防。这样一来，下回合攻击后就肯定没余力再用不屈，哪怕它最后根本没贴上来。

units.source: While their tendency to wait turn is disadvantageous to chosen in some respects, it can also be advantageous to them in that, since they have the Resilient perk, they often recover from the Dazed status effect before their next attack. You can even play this to your advantage, by waiting turn yourself before dazing them, but only if you can afford to wait.
units.zh: 神选战士习惯等待，有时是劣势，有时却是优势。它们有顽强，所以往往能在下次攻击前摆脱恍惚。你也可以反过来利用这一点，自己先等待，再给它们施加恍惚，但前提是你等得起。

units.source: Positioners with both the Rotation and Footwork perks can be very useful against large chosen parties. Those with spears can occupy the rear flanks to prevent chosen from outflanking the formation and surrounding more offensive characters. 2H Positioners can pre-emptively “rescue” offensive characters (e.g. the above one who was angsting over whether to use Adrenaline in case a chosen closed in) who’ve been engaged by non-isolated chosen that are liable to use their own form of Rotation (Barbarian Wrath) to focus attacks upon a character who is easier to hit. A fresh Positioner can use Rotation+Footwork or even Rotation+Attack+Adrenaline+Attack+Footwork.
units.zh: 面对大队神选战士，同时有换位和灵活步法的调位手很有用。持矛者可以站在后侧两翼，防止神选绕过阵形、包围输出角色。双手武器调位手则能提前“救出”已经接敌的输出手，例如前面那个纠结要不要预开肾上腺素的人。如果贴上来的神选周围还有同伴，它们可能用自己的换位，也就是蛮族之怒，集中攻击更容易命中的目标。状态充足的调位手可以用换位加灵活步法，甚至串起换位、攻击、肾上腺素，再在下回合攻击、灵活步法脱离。

units.source: As suggested above, one or two whippers are very useful against barbarians. They can hang back two tiles from the frontline (making the barbarians less likely to sense their high initiative), wait turn and then Disarm any dangerous chosen whose turn has already ended. Obviously any chosen engaging anyone who is already wounded or without armour is a threat (especially if wielding a cleaver). Otherwise, the most threatening ones are those with 2H maces (who can apply Dazed) and those with rusty 2H axes (which can make very short work of durable shields).
units.zh: 如前所述，一两名鞭手对付蛮族非常有用。他们可以待在前排后两格，让蛮族不容易察觉其高先攻，先等待，再缴械已经结束行动的危险神选。显然，任何贴住伤员或无甲队友的神选都是威胁，尤其是拿斩刀的。除此之外，最危险的是双手钉锤手，会造成恍惚，以及生锈双手斧手，很快就能拆掉耐用盾牌。

units.source: Also, as more and more players are discovering, throwers (especially with looted heavy barbarian javelins) can do devastation to chosen from close range, and one or two of these are always good to have.
units.zh: 此外，越来越多玩家发现，投掷手近距离打神选能造成毁灭性伤害，尤其拿着缴获的蛮族重标枪时。带上一两个总是好事。

units.source: My usual approach to large chosen battles is to have 3-4 more defensive tanks (shielded Indom+Riposte ones or 2H Indom+AOE ones) spread out (with a gap of one or two tiles) across the front (any shielded ones on the flanks), at least 4 offensive melee characters (and maybe one or two throwers) behind them, one or two whippers at the back, and sometimes Spear/Shield Positioners on the rear flanks (especially if there are no shielded tanks on the front flanks). Sometimes there may be some 2H Positioners mixed in with (and perhaps barely distinguishable from) the offensive melee characters.
units.zh: 我对付大队神选的常规配置是：前面散开 3-4 名更偏防御的承伤者，用持盾不屈加还击架势，或双手不屈加范围攻击，彼此隔一两格；持盾者放两翼。后面至少有 4 名近战输出手，也可能再带一两个投掷手；最后放一两名鞭手。有时在后侧两翼放长矛／盾牌调位手，尤其前排两翼没有盾卫时。近战输出手里有时也混着双手武器调位手，外表上甚至几乎分不清。

units.source: If there are any 2H Positioners, it’s fun to use them to seize the initiative with Adrenaline and do as the barbarians do by attacking and then rotating another attacker into place. In my case, the next attacker (who has also used Adrenaline) will be a more defensive tank who will then use Indomitable with either Riposte or a 2H attack. At least some of the offensive characters (or Positioners) on the second line will be in danger of becoming the focus of the barbarians’ own wrathful rotating attacks if/when a barbarian advances into one of the gaps between the tanks. This danger can be pre-empted by throwing a net over that barbarian (and then disarming/dazing it etc., and/or pelting it with heavy javelins) or subsequently evaded via use of Rotation and/or Footwork.
units.zh: 如果有双手武器调位手，可以用肾上腺素抢先，模仿蛮族的打法：自己攻击，再换另一名攻击者上前，玩起来很有趣。我的队伍里，接替者也会预先用肾上腺素，而且通常更偏防御，之后使用不屈，加还击架势或一次双手武器攻击。如果蛮族钻进承伤者之间的缺口，第二排至少部分输出手或调位手，就可能成为它们换位集火的目标。可以提前投网罩住那个蛮族，再缴械、打入恍惚，或用重标枪猛掷；也可以之后用换位、灵活步法脱险。

units.source: The general approach of the offensive melee characters is to hang on the second line with 2-tile items and wait for chosen to advance into the gaps in the frontline, and then (once those chosens’ turns have ended without using Adrenaline) wait for someone to chuck nets over them (preventing others from rotating them) and advance to daze them with 2H maces, knowing that they will act before those advanced chosen in the next round and that those chosen will be very nearly dead (or very actually dead) before they next get to act. If an advanced chosen waits turn and uses Adrenaline because of sensing the higher initiative of a whipper, it may be possible for an offensive character with a whip and lower initiative to Disarm that chosen at the end of the round.
units.zh: 近战输出手通常先在第二排拿 2 格武器，等神选钻进前排空隙。那些神选没用肾上腺素就结束行动后，先等队友投网，阻止其他蛮族把它们换走，再上前用双手钉锤施加恍惚。这样你知道下回合自己会先于这些神选行动，它们下次出手前，大概已经快死了，或者真的死了。如果钻进来的神选察觉鞭手先攻更高，便等待并使用肾上腺素，那么一名带鞭、先攻较低的输出手，也许能在回合末把它缴械。

units.source: The more the chosens’ numbers are thinned, the easier it is for offensive characters and whippers to group together and focus attention on the remaining chosen tied up by the tankiest characters, prioritizing whichever ones are posing the greatest threat.
units.zh: 神选数量削得越少，输出手和鞭手就越容易聚在一起，集中处理被最耐打队友牵制的残余敌人，并优先解决威胁最大的那些。

units.source: Large beasts have a massive pool of HPs but (mostly) not much armour. Snow/tundra unholds and lindwurms have some armour (mostly removed by one or two hits from 2-handed items), and schrats take a lot less HP damage when they have a “shield” (which has 32 durability like a heater shield), but the main problem (from an offensive perspective) is working through their HPs. From a defensive perspective, the main problem is their massive ignore-armour damage and, in the case of lindwurms, their massive armour damage (often ~100 versus Indomitable) and high melee skill (85 after ~day 200). Unholds pose the additional problem of being able to stun you with charges or toss you over their heads for a loss of 10 HPs (combining the orc menaces into one), and schrats pose the additional problem of being able to AOE three targets with a “Split” attack (and, although it’s easy to avoid the angle of any one particular schrat, battles against many schrats on complex terrain sometimes make it difficult to get in range to attack one schrat without accidentally being in range to be attacked by another). Oh, and lindwurms are able to attack any target within a 2-tile range, and their tails can AOE any 3 targets within a 2-tiles range with a “Swing/Shatter” attack, and sometimes apply the Dazed status effect (or knock them back – which is often beneficial, since it at least puts them out of range of the heads). Most hits from these enemies also apply the Staggered status effect, which lowers initiative by 50% and is not of much concern for fatigue-intensive characters, but of very big concern for any high-initiative characters whose role is to apply the Overwhelmed status effect to lower the melee skill of these beasts.
units.zh: 巨兽生命值极高，但多数护甲不多。雪地、苔原巨魔和林德蠕龙有一些护甲，通常挨一两下双手武器就大多没了；树妖有“盾”时受到的生命伤害少得多，盾耐久为 32，与熨斗形盾相同。不过从进攻角度看，主要问题仍是磨光它们的生命值。从防御角度看，主要问题是极高的无视护甲伤害；林德蠕龙还有极高的护甲伤害，打在不屈上往往仍约 100，以及较高近战命中，大约第 200 天后会有 85。巨魔还会冲撞击晕，或把你从头顶抛过去，造成 10 生命损失，相当于把兽人的两种麻烦合在一起。树妖则能用类似“劈开”的攻击一次打三个目标；单只树妖的攻击角度容易避开，但复杂地形上面对多只时，常会为了进入其中一只的攻击距离，不小心又落入另一只的范围。还有，林德蠕龙能攻击 2 格内任何目标，尾巴能用类似“挥击／击碎”的范围攻击，打到 2 格内的任意 3 个目标，有时还造成恍惚或击退。击退往往反而有利，至少让人离开头部的攻击范围。多数巨兽攻击还会造成踉跄，降低 50% 先攻；这对高疲劳消耗角色不算大问题，但对那些靠高先攻施加压制、降低巨兽近战命中的角色，就非常麻烦。

units.source: Naturally, it’s useful to have weapons that can attack these enemies without engaging them directly, and to be highly mobile to avoid being in line for schrat or lindwurm long-range attacks, or to avoid being engaged by an unhold who has tossed someone aside. Polearms (with mastery) afford good mobility thanks to their 5-AP cost. Jagged pikes offer the same thing without mastery, and (thanks to 10 bleeding damage per hit) do nearly as much damage as a billhook against unarmoured targets that are not immune to bleed (schrats are immune to bleed, but 50-70 damage is still decent and often avoids spawning a sapling). But battle whips have a range of 3 tiles and can make two attacks per turn, and apply a total of 4 lots of 10 bleeding (split over two turns) per hit against non-immune targets (meaning a total of 8 lots of 10 from two hits in one turn, or 4 lots of 10 against enemies who have the Resilient perk, as all these large beasts do). Their base damage of 15-30 may sound pathetic, but this increases to 18-37 with double-grip, and two hits with this (36-74) plus 8 lots of 10 bleeding damage equals 116-154 total damage from a single turn, or 76-114 total damage against Resilient non-immune enemies such as unholds and lindwurms (better than a billhook or longaxe, and applied from a safer distance). Even against non-bleeding targets, such as schrats, the whip is very useful for applying stacks of Overwhelm (while avoiding being in line for another schrat’s attacks).
units.zh: 自然，最好用能不贴身就攻击巨兽的武器，并保持高机动性，避开树妖和林德蠕龙的远距离攻击路线，也避免巨魔抛开别人后直接贴住你。精通长柄武器后，每击只需 5 行动点，机动性很好。锯齿长枪不必精通也能做到；每次命中还造成 10 流血伤害，对无甲且不免疫流血的目标，伤害几乎不输钩镰。树妖免疫流血，但 50-70 伤害仍不错，而且常能避免生成树苗。战鞭则有 3 格距离，每回合可攻击两次；对不免疫的目标，每次命中能施加共 4 次、每次 10 点的流血伤害，分两回合结算。一回合命中两次，就是共 8 次、每次 10 点；对带顽强的敌人则是 4 次、每次 10 点，而这些巨兽都有顽强。基础伤害 15-30 看着可怜，但双手握持后会到 18-37，两次命中就是 36-74，再加 8 次、每次 10 点流血，一回合总共可造成 116-154 伤害；对巨魔和林德蠕龙这类有顽强、但不免疫流血的敌人，也有 76-114。比钩镰或长柄斧更高，还能站得更安全。即使对树妖这类不流血的目标，鞭也很适合叠压制，同时避开其他树妖的攻击路线。

units.source: Bows can also apply stacks of Overwhelm (and deal high damage to unarmoured targets) from long-range, but they have the disadvantage of requiring line of sight to guarantee getting to the intended target.
units.zh: 弓也能远距离叠压制，并对无甲目标造成高伤害；缺点是必须有清晰射线，才能确保打到想要的目标。

units.source: A small number of tanks (especially of the shielded variety) is very useful against large beasts, and nearly essential against lindwurms (just 2-handers is viable against unholds and schrats, though sometimes slightly awkward). Engaging as many beasts as possible with each individual tank allows the other, more offensive characters to concentrate on hitting stuff. In the earlier days of campaigns, before proto-tanks have the Indomitable perk, unhold charges and tosses can be prevented (or at least delayed) by throwing nets over them (which also allows several characters to engage and attack them with 2H weapons and attack again on the next turn before the beast can do anything back).
units.zh: 少量承伤角色，尤其盾卫，对巨兽很有用，对林德蠕龙几乎必不可少。巨魔和树妖只用双手武器手也能打，不过有时稍显别扭。让每个承伤者尽量贴住多只巨兽，其他更偏进攻的角色就能专心输出。战役前期，承伤者尚未点出不屈时，可以给巨魔投网，阻止或至少延缓冲撞与抛掷；这样也能让几个人贴身用双手武器攻击，并在巨兽还击前于下回合再打一轮。

units.source: Tanks often need to be pro-active at engaging multiple large beasts, since the beasts often try to work around the formation to attack your most vulnerable troops. Spreading the tanks out along with front, with a gap of 2 tiles between each of them, makes it impossible for more than a single isolated beast to advance through the gap onto your backline, and focusing damage on isolated beasts is one of the keys to an efficient victory. An unhold that advances thus can be netted to prevent tosses and then dazed with 2H maces and struck with 2-tile items and Overwhelmed/bled with whips.
units.zh: 承伤者往往需要主动贴住多只巨兽，因为巨兽经常想绕过阵形，攻击最脆弱的人。把承伤者沿前方散开，彼此留 2 格空隙，就能确保每处空隙至多让一只孤立巨兽穿进后排。集中伤害消灭孤立目标，是高效取胜的关键之一。这样走进来的巨魔，可以先投网阻止抛掷，再用双手钉锤打入恍惚、用 2 格武器攻击、用鞭叠压制和流血。

units.source: If you have only a few tanks, they may need (after initial engagement with a single beast) to use Indomitable and then try to move through zone-of-control to engage as many additional beasts as possible, freeing less defensive characters from having to worry about defence. If they suffer sequences of hits and lose most of their armour, it may be judicious for the tanks (if they are shield-users) to cycle Indomitable+Shieldwall to maximize melee defence (especially against lindwurms with their massive armour damage and 85 melee skill). Most of the time, however, Indomitable+Riposte is a preferable combination, since it contributes damage to make shorter work of them (against unholds it often returns the damage that they recover at the start of each turn). Ideally, the hit chances of large beasts (especially lindwurms) should be lowered as much as possible by stacks of Overwhelm applied from a safe distance by whippers (or by any high-initiative ranged characters you may have).
units.zh: 如果承伤者很少，他们可能需要先贴住一只巨兽，开不屈，再尝试穿过控制区，接触尽可能多的其他巨兽，让防御较弱的角色不用担心自身。如果连续挨打、护甲大多掉光，持盾承伤者可以考虑循环不屈加盾墙，尽量提高近战防御，尤其对抗破甲极强、近战命中有 85 的林德蠕龙时。不过多数时候，不屈加还击架势更好，因为能贡献伤害、缩短战斗；对巨魔，还击常能抵消它每回合开始恢复的生命。理想情况下，鞭手或其他高先攻远程角色，应从安全距离叠压制，尽可能降低巨兽，尤其林德蠕龙的命中率。

units.source: Against unholds and schrats, 2H tanks with maces or axes (whatever their usual weapon) are viable, but it is easier and safer to tie up an especially large mass of beasts with a shielded tank.
units.zh: 对巨魔和树妖，无论平时用什么武器，承伤者改拿双手钉锤或斧都可行。但要牵制特别大的一群巨兽，盾卫更容易、更安全。

units.source: Against unholds, ideally, all the beasts will be tied up by a few tanks spread across the centre, and then the damage-dealers and debuffers will be able to divide into two groups that outflank the giants from both sides and (from each side) focus damage upon them one by one. Whips, jagged pikes and mastered bills make it easier for them to attack and move to within a single tile of a beast, so that (if needed) they can engage and daze it with a 2H mace after its next turn has ended. The more beasts that have already been removed, the easier it is to rapidly incapacitate and annihilate those that remain.
units.zh: 打巨魔时，理想情况是所有巨兽都被横列中央的少数承伤者牵住，输出手和施加负面效果的角色分成两组，从两翼包抄，各自集中攻击、逐只消灭。战鞭、锯齿长枪和点了精通的钩镰，方便他们攻击后移动到距离巨兽一格的位置；必要时，等巨兽下回合结束行动，再上前用双手钉锤打入恍惚。已经消灭的巨兽越多，就越容易迅速制住并歼灭剩余目标。

units.source: While 2H maces are excellent against large beasts for their Daze effect, it should also be noted that 2H axes with the Split Man attack are excellent against unarmoured targets with lots of HPs, since this single attack induces two negative morale checks and sometimes causes them to break early.
units.zh: 双手钉锤的恍惚效果很适合对付巨兽，但也别忘了，双手斧的劈身对高生命、无护甲目标同样出色，因为一次攻击会触发两次负面士气检定，有时能让它们提前崩溃。

units.source: Axes, for obvious reasons, are extremely useful against schrats. I always like to have at least two people with Axe Mastery, which allows schrat “shields” to be one-shotted by longaxes. I also sometimes have those without mastery use longaxes in pairs to quickly remove shields from safety. Throwing spears can also be used in pairs to remove durable shields, including those of schrats. All 1-tile 2H weapons (except flails) have the Split Shield skill and can (in pairs) remove schrat shields in one turn for the modest fatigue cost of 20 (except for longswords, which do just 12 damage to shields, but this is still enough to two-shot schrat shields in pairing with the 20 damage applied by 2H maces).
units.zh: 斧对树妖极其有用，原因很明显。我总喜欢至少带两名有斧术精通的人，让长柄斧一击劈碎树妖的“盾”。有时也让没有精通的人两两配合，用长柄斧从安全距离快速破盾。两根投矛也能配合拆掉耐用盾牌，包括树妖的盾。所有 1 格双手武器，连枷除外，都有破盾技能；两人配合，一回合就能拆掉树妖盾，只需消耗合计 20 疲劳。长剑例外，它只造成 12 盾牌伤害，不过和双手钉锤的 20 伤害配合，仍足够两击拆盾。

units.source: Against schrats, who can annoyingly regenerate their shields to massively lower your damage, it is much more efficient to have at least a couple of guys with Axe Mastery, or to use a lot of greataxes (since these can one-shot schrat shields without mastery). Rare versions of other 2H weapons (or of smaller axes) sometimes have enough extra shield damage to one-shot schrat shields. But it is still useful to have lots of throwing spears at the start of schrat battles, to facilitate a quick and efficient offensive. Shield-splitting aside, 2H maces are an excellent tool for schrat fights, since they can Daze them whether shielded or not, and this (thanks to their lowered initiative) often allows several characters to advance and attack twice without having to worry about being attacked back. 2H hammers achieve the same thing thanks to Stagger, but don’t reduce their damage.
units.zh: 树妖会烦人地再生盾牌，大幅降低你的伤害，因此至少有两名斧术精通者，或多带巨斧，会有效率得多，巨斧不用精通也能一击拆盾。其他双手武器或小斧的名贵版本，有时也会多出足够的盾牌伤害，一击破掉树妖盾。不过，开局多带投矛仍很有用，方便快速高效地进攻。除破盾外，双手钉锤也是树妖战的好工具：无论有没有盾，都能使其恍惚，降低先攻，往往能让几个人上前连打两轮，而不必担心还击。双手锤靠踉跄也能做到同样的先攻控制，但不会降低树妖伤害。

units.source: The key to schrat fights is to engage them all with as few tanky characters as possible (or engage any isolated ones with multiple offensive characters) and to get a couple of Axe Masters in suitable range of a couple of them (preferably ones that others can then attack without being endangered by other schrats’ AOE attacks). Alternatively, all the tanky characters (or some of them) can carry greataxes and serve as shield removers, allowing the others to concentrate on offence or debuffing. For a tank, cycling Indomitable with Split Shield with a non-mastered greataxe requires 82 in-gear fatigue (the same as Indomitable+Riposte, but with lesser total fatigue from in-hand items). Being unshielded makes a tank easier to hit, but also makes it quicker to kill the schrats (and encourages them to sacrifice attacks to regenerate the shields).
units.zh: 树妖战的关键，是用尽可能少的耐打角色贴住全部树妖，孤立者也可以让多名输出手围上，再让两名斧术精通者进入合适距离。优先处理那些破盾后，其他人能安全攻击、不会被别的树妖范围攻击波及的目标。另一种办法，是让全部或部分承伤者带巨斧，自己负责破盾，让其他人专心输出或施加负面效果。承伤者若用未精通的巨斧，循环不屈加破盾，穿戴后需 82 可用疲劳，与不屈加还击架势相同，但手持装备的疲劳负担更低。没有盾，自己更容易挨打，却也能更快杀死树妖，并诱使其放弃攻击去再生盾牌。

units.source: Saplings are mostly just a minor nuisance, with much weaker ignore-armour damage, but their basic armour damage is still decent and you need to be careful to not allow anyone to be too swarmed with them. Berserk is sometimes great for clearing them away (but a new one will be spawned if you immediately hit an unshielded schrat). Indomitable is very handy for when someone is swarmed by saplings or is unable to get in attacking range without also being in range for AOE attacks from one or more schrats. Ideally, damage-dealers should be able to wait safely within 2 tiles of a single schrat, and then advance and hit it with a 2H mace, leaving it low on initiative (and low on damage if it gets another chance to attack).
units.zh: 树苗多数时候只是小麻烦，无视护甲伤害弱得多，但基础护甲伤害仍不错，得小心别让谁被围得太多。狂战有时很适合清理树苗，不过如果马上再打无盾树妖，又会生出新的。有人被树苗团团围住，或无法进入攻击距离而不同时落入一只或多只树妖的范围攻击时，不屈很管用。理想情况下，输出手应能在某一只树妖的 2 格内安全等待，再上前用双手钉锤敲它，降低它的先攻；若它还有机会出手，伤害也会降低。

units.source: Unlike unholds and schrats, lindwurm heads do not necessarily try to advance to engage anyone. Since their attacks have a range of 2 tiles, without requiring an angle, they often park themselves (along with their tails) behind another head (and tail) that is already engaged, and attack a target that cannot attack them back. This increases the volume of attacks endured by a tank, making it more likely that the armour will be stripped (Indomitable or not) and the HPs exposed. This, along with their higher melee skill, makes Overwhelming Whippers extra-important against lindwurms, since they can keep a precious shield tank alive (so that it can fulfil its destiny of being sacrificed in the Black Monolith). While Indomitable is highly recommended for tanks against lindwurms (along with Nimble or very heavy armour with bone platings), somewhat cheesy fatigue-neutral initiative-based shield tanks (applying Overwhelm with daggers or punches) can also be effective against lindwurms (and schrats) as a stop-gap in the early/mid-game.
units.zh: 林德蠕龙头部与巨魔、树妖不同，并不一定主动推进贴人。它们能不受角度限制地攻击 2 格目标，因此常把头和尾巴停在已经接敌的另一只蠕龙后面，攻击无法还手的人。这会增加承伤者挨打的次数，让护甲更容易被剥光、生命暴露，无论是否开不屈。再加上蠕龙近战命中更高，压制鞭手就格外重要：他们能保住宝贵盾卫，好让盾卫日后在黑色巨石完成英勇献身的宿命。虽然强烈建议盾卫带不屈，再配轻灵或装骨板护层的厚重护甲，但前中期也可以暂时用些取巧方案：以先攻为核心、疲劳收支平衡的盾卫，用匕首或拳头叠压制，对林德蠕龙和树妖也能有效。

units.source: An advantage of the wurm heads’ tendency to hang back is that it leaves offensive characters free to focus damage on the more advanced heads/tails, knowing that the ones behind are unlikely to move even a single tile to attack them if they stay out of range.
units.zh: 蠕龙头部喜欢留在后面，也有一个好处：输出手可以放心集中打更靠前的头或尾，只要自己不进攻击范围，后面的蠕龙多半连一格都不愿挪过来追击。

units.source: The initial priority against lindwurms is to engage as many heads as possible with as few shield tanks as possible, while simultaneously trying to avoid having each shield tank being in range of heads/tails that are already being tied up by others (try to avoid giving them the option to focus attacks on a tank whose armour is stripped). Once this is done, offensive characters with longaxes/bills/polehammers should try to remove the armour from a couple of them (the most isolated ones that can be attacked most freely) as quickly as possible. These exposed wurms can then be spammed with 2-tile or whip attacks, and the Overwhelming Whippers (with their extra bleeding damage from mastery) can also prioritize attacking these ones to hasten their demise (but may want to apply Overwhelm to other heads/tails if a tank is in trouble elsewhere). Once some of the wurms have been removed, the tanks may still be in good health (in which case the same process can be followed) or they may be in a bit of trouble. If they are in trouble, the offensive characters (after removing most of the remaining wurms’ armour from distance) can close in en masse with 2H maces to try to keep everything dazed (using Indomitable when it isn’t or if their armour has been stripped). Since the damage-dealers are easier to hit, this should divert some attacks from any endangered tanks, and the greater volume of high-damage attacks (combined with continued Overwhelming and bleeding applied by whippers) should (hopefully) be sufficient to slay the beasts before anyone loses an eye.
units.zh: 对林德蠕龙，首要任务是用尽可能少的盾卫贴住尽可能多的头，同时避免每名盾卫进入已被其他人牵制的头、尾攻击范围，尽量不给蠕龙集火某个护甲已被剥光者的机会。完成后，拿长柄斧、钩镰或长柄战锤的输出手，应尽快拆掉几只蠕龙的护甲，优先选择最孤立、最容易安全攻击的。无甲蠕龙随后可以用 2 格武器或鞭反复攻击。压制鞭手有精通带来的额外流血，也可以优先攻击它们，尽快击杀；但若别处的承伤者遇险，可能仍要转去压制其他头尾。消灭一些蠕龙后，盾卫可能状态仍好，那就重复流程；也可能已经有些危险。这时输出手应先从远处削掉剩余蠕龙的大部分护甲，再集体拿双手钉锤靠近，尽量让所有目标维持恍惚。目标没恍惚，或自己护甲已经掉光时，就用不屈。输出手更容易被命中，因此应能替危险中的承伤者分担一些攻击；更多高伤害攻击，加上鞭手持续的压制和流血，希望足以在任何人丢掉一只眼睛前杀光巨兽。

units.source: Have the Resilient perk. Move into attacking range of the hexen and use Adrenaline. Wait turn. Recover from any charms at the end of the round, having used Indomitable on anyone who’s Hexed. Kill. Repeat as necessary. Similar (but more relaxed) for alps.
units.zh: 带顽强。进入女巫的攻击距离，使用肾上腺素，然后等待。回合末摆脱魅惑；中了咒缚的人则提前用好不屈。杀掉女巫，必要时重复。对梦魇也类似，只是更轻松。

units.source: The White Company is my third and latest company. Named after the greatest mercenary company ever, this group of misfits lived up to the name having ended the Noble House War and Greenskin Crisis, raided a couple orc bases (warlord & co. Thanks Sarissofoi, your wedge formation rocks!) and on the 259th day raided the Black Monolith without retreating or losing a single man. (Poor Tornhelm the Sniper lost his nose tho).
units.zh: 白色战团是我的第三支，也是最新的一支战团。它以史上最伟大的佣兵团命名，这群乌合之众也没辱没这个名字：他们终结了贵族战争和绿皮危机，袭击了几处兽人基地，打败了军阀和他的手下。谢谢 Sarissofoi，你的楔形阵太棒了！到第 259 天，他们攻下了黑色巨石，既没有撤退，也没有损失一个人。不过，可怜的“神射手”托恩赫尔姆丢了鼻子。

units.source: As a teacher by profession, I can't avoid explaining things as thoroughly as possible. Old habits die hard, I suppose.
units.zh: 我的本职工作是教师，所以总忍不住把事情尽量讲透。大概是积习难改吧。

units.source: Early in the game you shouldn't be concerned about epic loot, raiding orc warcamps/goblin cities/Black Monolith. You're there to survive, slowly building up your company. Focus on small contracts and commerce. In time, build up towards something like the following:
units.zh: 游戏前期，别急着惦记史诗战利品，也别忙着袭击兽人战营、地精城市或黑色巨石。你得先活下来，慢慢壮大战团，专心做小委托和贸易。随着实力增长，逐步组建下面这样的队伍：

units.source: {#1} {/#1}Aim for the best possible Ranged Atk, Initiative, Ranged Defense and if{#2} {/#2}{#3}possible, decent Melee Atk, in that order.{/#3}
units.zh: {#1} {/#1}尽量提高远程命中、先攻和远程防御；如果{#2} {/#2}{#3}还有余力，再兼顾近战命中，优先顺序如上。{/#3}

units.source: {#1} {/#1}{#2} {/#2}{#3}Aim for the best possible Melee Defense, Fatigue and Melee Atk.{/#3}
{#1} {/#1}{#2} Go for high Melee Atk, Fatigue and Melee Defense{/#2}
units.zh: {#1} {/#1}{#2}优先提高近战命中、疲劳上限和近战防御。{/#2}

units.source: {#1}​{/#1}{#2} {/#2}{#3} High Resolve is mandatory, Fatigue is a must-have and Ranged Defense is essential. So yeah, good luck finding one (mine used to be a beggar){/#3}
units.zh: {#1}​{/#1}{#2} {/#2}{#3}意志必须高，疲劳上限不能低，远程防御也不可或缺。总之，祝你早日找到合适的人选；我的军士以前是个乞丐。{/#3}

units.source: Whenever you have your 12-ish guys and decent armor (200-ish on frontliners is a decent landmark) you can start to shift your company towards a late game composition.
units.zh: 等你凑齐约 12 人，并且有了不错的护甲，前排护甲达到约 200 就是一个不错的节点，便可以开始向后期配置转型。

units.source: {#1}​{/#1}{#2} {/#2}{#3} Having a polearm is tempting (and I even fell for that), but the Resolve bonus is too good to pass. Keep the banner, he's not there to DPS{/#3}
units.zh: {#1}​{/#1}{#2} {/#2}{#3}拿长柄武器很诱人，我自己也踩过这个坑，但战旗的意志加成实在不能舍弃。让他继续举旗，他不是来打输出的。{/#3}

units.source: {#1}​{/#1}{#2} {/#2}{#3} Later in the game your 50 melee skill just won't cut it, so throw it off the window and go ham on Ranged Atk, Initiative and Ranged Def.{/#3}
units.zh: {#1}​{/#1}{#2} {/#2}{#3}到了后期，50 点近战命中根本不够看，干脆放弃它，全力提高远程命中、先攻和远程防御。{/#3}

units.source: {#1}​{/#1}{#2} {/#2}{#3} Archers and Sergeant require bodyguards as other people do their work. They're useless in most levels but mandatory on the hard ones.{/#3}
units.zh: {#1}​{/#1}{#2} {/#2}{#3}其他人执行各自任务时，弓手和军士需要护卫。这些护卫在多数战斗里派不上什么用场，但高难度战斗中必不可少。{/#3}

units.source: {#1}​{/#1}{#2} {/#2}{#3} These guys are the bread and butter of any lategame company. High Melee Attack and Defense keeps them alive for a very long time. 300/300 plates keep them alive against arrows and crossbows and sky-high fatigue keeps them moving.{/#3}
units.zh: {#1}​{/#1}{#2} {/#2}{#3}这些人是任何后期战团的中坚。高近战命中和防御让他们长久生存，300/300 的板甲配置用来抵挡箭矢和弩箭，极高的疲劳上限则让他们持续行动。{/#3}

units.source: {#1}In normal missions/ambushes/contracts run forward and slash the enemy to bloody pieces. Keep 1 or 2 tiles between your 2-handed fighters so they can swing away undeterred.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}普通任务、伏击和委托中，直接向前推进，把敌人砍得血肉横飞。双手武器手之间留出 1 或 2 格，让他们能毫无阻碍地挥击。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}In harder missions/Orc Warcamps, try forming a Wedge Formation. It's the one that looks like a > , placing your archers and sergeant in the center but leave enough space for your 2-handed's swings.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}遇到较难的任务或兽人战营，可以试试楔形阵，也就是形状像 > 的阵形。把弓手和军士放在中央，同时给双手武器手留出足够的挥击空间。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Sarissofoi has a great example of it in this video {/#1}{#2}https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mxsrPluqLec&t=392s{/#2}
units.zh: {#1}Sarissofoi 的这段视频是一个很好的示范：{/#1}{#2}https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mxsrPluqLec&t=392s{/#2}

units.source: For the Black Monolith, i'll add a proper chapter with screenshots.
units.zh: 黑色巨石的打法，我会单独开一章，配上截图。

units.source: As for each class they should be self explanatory but let's go !
units.zh: 各个角色的分工应该已经很清楚了，不过还是逐一说说吧！

units.source: Shield Brother - standard defensive unit. Has no down or upside. Just a guy with a shield and a one-handed weapon protecting his brothers. Later in the game, their best use is to block line of sight to your archers and help keep them alive.
units.zh: 持盾弟兄：标准防御单位，没有突出的长处或短板，就是用盾牌和单手武器保护弟兄的人。游戏后期，他们最有用的工作是挡住射向弓手的火线，帮助弓手活下来。

units.source: Sergeant - back-line supporter. He's NOT there to fight or DPS. He's there to keep morale in check.
units.zh: 军士：后排支援。他不是来近战或打输出的，而是负责稳住士气。

units.source: Archers/Polearm - early in the game, archers suck and suck HARD. That's why moving them behind the frontline and poking with polearms is a good choice. Becomes irrelevant later on, tho.
units.zh: 弓手兼长柄武器手：游戏前期的弓手很弱，而且是非常弱。因此，把他们放到前排后面，用长柄武器戳人是个不错的办法。不过到了后期，这种打法就没什么意义了。

units.source: Dedicated Archers: Later in the game, archers are great shooters and rarely ever miss. Inflict as many wounds as possible. They CAN kill enemies, but are there mostly to cripple and/or rout them.
units.zh: 专职弓手：游戏后期的弓手射术精湛，很少失手。尽可能多给敌人造成伤势。他们当然能杀敌，但主要任务是致残敌人或让敌人溃逃。

units.source: 2-handed men - THESE are the guys doing the killing. Enemies softened/crippled up by archers equals a reset (berserk perk) making it quick and easy to sweep an entire battlefield.
units.zh: 双手武器手：真正负责杀敌的是这些人。弓手先削弱或打伤敌人，给他们创造击杀后触发狂战的机会，就能又快又轻松地横扫战场。

units.source: As stated before, these guys are there for protection.
units.zh: 如前所述，这些人负责保护队友。

units.source: {#1}Stats{/#1}: Whenever hiring a new guy, aim for Melee Defense, Fatigue and Melee Attack. If possible, try to get a bit of natural ranged defense on him. The guy on the photo has been with the company for 260 days which means he was hired on day 1 !!!
units.zh: {#1}属性：{/#1}招募新人时，重点看近战防御、疲劳上限和近战命中；如果还能有一点基础远程防御就更好了。照片里这位已经在战团待了 260 天，也就是说，他第 1 天就加入了！！！

units.source: {#1}Student is an amazing perk. Faster exp and you get the perk back at level 11. Absolute godsend, absolute no-brainer.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}好学是个很棒的特长：经验获得更快，到了 11 级还会返还特长点。简直是天赐之物，想都不用想。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Gifted - max rolls on stats, great early boost. No better option on that line anyway.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}天赋异禀：属性按最高成长值增加，是很好的前期提升。反正这一层也没有更好的选择。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Shield Expert - He's called SHIELD brother. I won't dwell on this any further.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}盾牌精通：他可是“持盾”弟兄。我就不多说了。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Brawny - Everyone but archers should have it. More fatigue to swing your weapons in battle{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}壮硕：除了弓手，人人都该有。留出更多可用疲劳，才能在战斗中多挥几下武器。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Sword Mastery - Swords have extra hit chance, so i went for them early on. Pick whatever you prefer tho.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}剑术精通：剑自带命中加成，所以我前期选了剑。当然，你喜欢什么就选什么。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Underdog - Being surrounded is a constant in mercenary life. Get it and you wont die (that easily){/#1}
units.zh: {#1}以少敌多：被包围是佣兵生活的常态。选了它，你就不会那么容易死。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Berserk - An extra hit whenever I score a kill. Not a bad choice. Not at all. You could also go Nimble here, but this perk is wonderful on goblins.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}狂战：每次击杀后能多打一下，绝对是个好选择。这里也可以选轻灵，不过狂战对付地精尤其好用。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Nimble - I don't use these guys to run into enemies. I use them to protect archers. With Nimble and high defenses, they're nearly immortal, since the more fatigue you have in the pool, the greater Nimble's bonus is. Since they sit by the archers and play cards, Nimble is always active.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}轻灵：我不会让这些人冲入敌阵，而是让他们保护弓手。有轻灵和高防御，他们几乎不会死，因为按当时的机制，剩余可用疲劳越多，轻灵的加成就越大。他们只是在弓手身边闲着打牌，所以轻灵始终能发挥作用。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Battle Forged - Moar armor = less damage. Go for it. No-brainer.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}久经战阵：护甲越厚，受到的伤害越少。选就对了，不用犹豫。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Fearsome - if I knew better, I'd have gone for Pathfinder, to be honest. It does help on harder battles tho, especially orcs.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}威慑：老实说，要是早知道这些，我会选寻路者。不过它在艰难的战斗里仍有帮助，尤其是打兽人时。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Killing Frenzy - There's no other option, really. They'll never rush w/o a shield and indomitable drains too much fatigue. Again, Nimble is an option since these guys are more def than offensive, but works quite nicely on goblins, once again.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}杀戮狂热：其实也没什么别的选择。他们从不丢下盾牌冲锋，不屈消耗的疲劳又太多。轻灵也仍然是个选项，毕竟这些人偏重防御。不过再说一次，杀戮狂热对付地精很好用。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Pathfinder instead of Fearsome. As stated above, if I knew better, I'd probably have done it.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}用寻路者替代威慑。正如上文所说，要是早知道这些，我多半会这么选。{/#1}

units.source: S{#1}teel Brow instead of Killing Frenzy, so no more head-shots.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}用钢铁额骨替代杀戮狂热，免得再被爆头。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Taunt instead of Berserk/Nimble. Could be a godsend when saving archers. Did not test it myself.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}用挑衅替代狂战或轻灵。营救弓手时，它可能非常管用。不过我没亲自试过。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Rotation instead of Nimble/Berserk. Same reason as above.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}用换位替代轻灵或狂战，理由同上。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}These guys aren't necessarily KILLERS. They're there to snipe priority targets and then cripple and rout your enemies. Also to soften them up so the other guys can reset off of them.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}这些人不一定要当杀戮机器。他们负责狙击优先目标，再打残敌人、逼其溃逃，也负责削弱敌人，让其他人靠击杀触发额外行动。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}{#2}Stats: {/#2}Whenever hiring an archer, focus on Ranged Attack, Initiative and Fatigue. Good Ranged Defense is good, but not that mandatory since they'll have shieldbrothers blocking for them.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}{#2}属性：{/#2}招募弓手时，重点看远程命中、先攻和疲劳上限。远程防御高当然好，但不算必需，因为有持盾弟兄替他们挡着。{/#1}

units.source: Pathfinder. Getting to high ground ASAP and having enough AP to flee enemies is a good option.
units.zh: 寻路者：尽快占领高地，并在逃离敌人时保留足够的行动点，是个不错的选择。

units.source: Crippling Strikes. As stated before, the more you cripple enemies, the better. Injuries just like on your brothers, can completely make an enemy useless for that battle.
units.zh: 致残打击：如前所述，能让越多敌人受伤越好。敌人和你的弟兄一样，受伤后可能在这场战斗里完全失去作用。

units.source: Bullseye. The guys you REALLY want to cripple or snipe out are usually behind their own shield brothers. That's where it gets so good. Also reduces chances of hitting your own brothers.
units.zh: 鹰眼：真正值得打残或狙杀的目标，通常躲在他们自己的持盾弟兄后面。这时它就特别好用，而且也能降低误中己方弟兄的概率。

units.source: Dodge. 15% of current initiative as bonus melee AND ranged defense. That guy has 136 initiative. That's + 20 Melee and Ranged Defense. Absolutely amazing !
units.zh: 闪避：把当前先攻的 15% 转化为近战和远程防御加成。这个人有 136 点先攻，也就是 +20 点近战和远程防御。太棒了！

units.source: Bow Mastery: Bows. Bows bows bows !!! Crossbows do deal more damage per shot and all that, but what you REALLY want is the synergy between shooting twice per round + fearsome + crippling strikes + Overwhelm. We'll get there.
units.zh: 弓术精通：弓，弓，还是弓！！！弩的单发伤害的确更高，也有其他优点，但你真正想要的是每回合射两箭，再结合威慑、致残打击和压制。后面会讲。

units.source: Overwhelm: Amazing perk. If they attack after you, you get -10% Ranged AND melee defense per shot fired HIT or MISS !!! If you invest on Initiative, you'll "always" go first. -20% battle usefulness for your enemies.
units.zh: 压制：很棒的特长。如果敌人在你之后行动，每射一箭，无论命中还是落空，都能让其近战命中和远程命中 -10%（原文误写为防御）。只要提高先攻，你“总能”先出手，让敌人的作战能力 -20%。

units.source: Footwork: Sometimes you'll mess up. Sometimes you'll be knocked back. Then you take a quick step, get out of melee range and re-establish your line.
units.zh: 灵活步法：你偶尔也会犯错，偶尔也会被击退。这时迅速退开一步，脱离近战，再把战线重新组织起来。

units.source: Berserk: Godly especially versus goblins. Extra shots = either extra kill or extra injury. At the very least, extra overwhelm stack.
units.zh: 狂战：对付地精尤其神。多射一箭，就多一次击杀或致伤机会，最少也能多叠一层压制。

units.source: Fearsome: Make them rout ! You're not paid to kill every single enemy. Leave one or two alive so they can tell stories about the evil men who devour little children if they misbehave. Making them flee is how legends are born! Also, lowers their combat effectiveness and your brothers can get extra hits whenever enemies flee.
units.zh: 威慑：让他们逃吧！雇主可没要求你杀光每一个敌人。留一两个活口，让他们回去讲那些专吃不听话小孩的恶人的故事。把敌人吓跑，传奇就是这样诞生的！此外，这还会降低敌人的作战能力；敌人逃跑时，弟兄们也能趁机多打几下。

units.source: Killing Frenzy: More damage whenever you score a kill. I do like it, but I question myself if Quick Hands wouldn't be better. Most fights I don't even get to spend a full quiver, but the hardest ones do. Could be useful in those, for every turn/shot counts.
units.zh: 杀戮狂热：击杀后增加伤害。我确实喜欢它，但也在想快手会不会更好。大多数战斗我连一整袋箭都射不完，最难的战斗却会打空。在那种每个回合、每次射击都重要的战斗里，快手或许有用。

units.source: ​Quick Hands instead of Killing Frenzy. Reasons stated above.
units.zh: 用快手替代杀戮狂热，原因如上。

units.source: Sarges aren't supposed to fight. Like every good boss, they are amazing at giving orders and awful at executing them. I know some of you will relate. LOL
units.zh: 军士不该负责打架。和所有好上司一样，他们发号施令很在行，亲自执行却很糟。我知道你们有些人会心有戚戚，哈哈。

units.source: {#1}Stats: {/#1}{#2}This guy is there to keep morale up. Period. Don't fall for the polearm trap, get the extra resolve with the banner. In order to keep morale up this guy will need: Stupid high Resolve, endgame he'll need quite a high fatigue and Ranged Defense since he should never go melee.{/#2}
units.zh: {#1}属性：{/#1}{#2}这个人就是来稳住士气的，仅此而已。别掉进长柄武器的陷阱，拿战旗享受额外意志。为了稳住军心，他需要高得离谱的意志；到了后期，还要有相当高的疲劳上限和远程防御，因为他绝不应该近战。{/#2}

units.source: {#1}Do NOT follow the stats on the picture !!! I goofed up on this guy and am leveling a new one. Will edit this page someday.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}不要照搬图中的属性！！！这个人被我练歪了，我正在培养新的军士。以后会修改这一页。{/#1}

units.source: Pathfinder. So you can move to needing allies more quickly and Rally them
units.zh: 寻路者：更快赶到需要帮助的队友身边，用鼓舞稳住他们。

units.source: Fortified Mind. Main stat = Resolve. This gives 25% extra Resolve. Duh.
units.zh: 坚定心智：主属性就是意志，它能额外增加 25% 意志。还用说吗？

units.source: Anticipation: The farther they are, the more Ranged Defense you get. Amazing for staying alive.
units.zh: 预判：敌人越远，你获得的远程防御越多。保命很好用。

units.source: Brawny: Get him heavy armor, he'll never die and with Brawny he won't get as tired.
units.zh: 壮硕：给他穿上重甲，确保他不会死；有壮硕，也不会那么容易累。

units.source: Rally The Troops: This is what MAKES a Sergeant. If he doesn't have THIS perk, he shouldn't carry the banner.
units.zh: 重振士气：这个特长才让军士成为军士。如果连它都没有，就不配扛旗。

units.source: Polearm Mastery: Because why not?! I'd maybe swap this for something like Colossus. Nothing could be worse than a dead sergeant.
units.zh: 长柄武器精通：为什么不呢？！不过我也许会把它换成巨人体魄之类的特长。没什么比军士阵亡更糟。

units.source: Quick Step: If the enemy ever closes in on the sarge, two things are certain: 1. you goofed up somewhere; 2. you gotta get him out ASAP.
units.zh: 灵活步法：如果敌人逼近军士，可以肯定两件事：1. 你肯定在什么地方犯错了；2. 必须尽快把他救出去。

units.source: Berserk: I did goof it up in him. Berserk is completely useless (at least the way I USE him, not the way I BUILT him). Would probably swap this one for Nimble.
units.zh: 狂战：这个人确实被我练歪了。狂战完全没用，至少按我的用法如此，虽然配点不是这么回事。我可能会把它换成轻灵。

units.source: Battle Forged: Since he uses heavy armor... less damage received. This is THE guy who can't ever die. Ever. Whatever it takes.
units.zh: 久经战阵：既然穿了重甲，就让他少受点伤。这个人绝对不能死，无论如何都不能。

units.source: {#1}​{/#1}Sergeants are too serious to leave any options. "Do as you're told or I'll have your skin flayed off you farkin lowborn lazy ass coward! Yarrrrgh! " - Sir Geofram, The Sarge, Apr. 2017
units.zh: {#1}​{/#1}军士太严肃，可不会给你什么选择。“叫你干什么就干什么，不然老子扒了你的皮，你这个他妈的下贱、懒惰的胆小鬼！吼啊！”——“军士”吉奥弗拉姆爵士，2017 年四月。

units.source: Now THESE guys are awesome. They're the ones pulling the real weight and dealing massive AoE all over the place. Try leaving a tile or two between each of them and the enemy will cripple in those holes and get slaughtered.
units.zh: 这些人才是真正的猛人。他们是扛起战团重担的主力，到处打出大量范围伤害。试着让他们彼此间隔一两格，敌人挤进空隙后就会被打残、被屠杀。

units.source: (Do note, in the picture how many kills and days this guy has. And he's not my best kill-to-day ratio, I chose him for the high fatigue and awesome beard)
units.zh: 注意看看图里这人的击杀数和入团天数。他的日均击杀还不是最高的；我选他展示，是因为他疲劳上限高，而且胡子帅。

units.source: {#1}Stats: {/#1}In order to chop heads off, you need strength. High Melee skills, fatigue and good melee defense. This is what you're looking for. Ranged defense is a good extra, but not mandatory.
units.zh: {#1}属性：{/#1}想砍下敌人的脑袋，就得有实力。你要找的是高近战命中、高疲劳上限和不错的近战防御。远程防御是加分项，但并非必需。
