source_exception.reason: 原站在受保护的真实图片之后重复输出了同一图片的转义HTML；保留原图片及属性，仅去除纯a/img重复文本。

units.source: Pathfinder: You'll see why when you fight in swamps or snow. Trust me, get this.
units.zh: 寻路者：等你在沼泽或雪地打过仗就明白了。信我，选它。

units.source: Gifted: Perfect rolls for more Melee Attack, Fatigue and Defense? Shut up and take my perk ! (if you REALLY want, you can skip this for Executioner to further capitalize on your archers, but I'd still keep this one)
units.zh: 天赋异禀：用最高成长值增加近战命中、疲劳上限和防御？别说了，特长点给你！如果你真的想进一步利用弓手打出的伤势，也可以换成刽子手，不过我还是会选它。

units.source: Brawny: mandatory. Heavy armor is heavy indeed. This perk helps with that.
units.zh: 壮硕：必选。重甲确实很重，这个特长正好解决问题。

units.source: Sword Mastery: Weapon of choice mastery, really. But I like swords. Lighter than the other 2 handed stuff and this mastery gives extra chance to hit. And scoring a hit is essential because ....
units.zh: 剑术精通：其实就是按所选武器点相应精通。不过我喜欢剑，它比其他双手武器轻，这项精通还增加命中率。而打中敌人非常重要，因为……

units.source: Reach Advantage: Whenever you score a hit, you get a stack of Reach Advantage, increasing melee defense by 20% per stack up to 6 stacks. In reality you'll get around 3. That guy has 48 Melee def. 48 + 60% = 77. Enemies rarely score a hit on him.
units.zh: 长兵优势：按当时的机制，每次命中增加一层长兵优势，每层使近战防御提高 20%，最多叠 6 层。实战中通常能有 3 层左右。这个人有 48 点近战防御，48 + 60% = 77。敌人很少能打中他。

units.source: Underdog: You don't want to get hit, remember? Underdog helps with that. Being surrounded has no penalty (and you WANT to be surrounded)
units.zh: 以少敌多：记得吗，你不想挨打。以少敌多正好能帮忙，被包围不再带来防御惩罚，而且你本来就希望被包围。

units.source: Berserk: Brilliant when it procs. And your archers can set that up real nice. Whenever you score a kill you can basically attack again. Lovely skill, I'd say it's a must-have.
units.zh: 狂战：触发时太棒了，弓手又能替它做好铺垫。每次击杀后，你基本都能再攻击一次。我认为这是个很棒的必选特长。

units.source: Battle Forged: More armor = less damage received. So you barely get hit and when you do, it's like they punched a brick wall. Hell yeah!
units.zh: 久经战阵：护甲越多，受到的伤害越少。你本来就很少被打中，真挨到一下，也像是敌人一拳打在砖墙上。太爽了！

units.source: Killing Frenzy: Extra 25% damage {#1}for two turns {/#1}when he kills someone. And he's there TO kill someone. Amazing perk to have especially later in the game.
units.zh: 杀戮狂热：击杀后，{#1}连续两回合{/#1}额外造成 25% 伤害。而他本来就是来杀敌的，后期尤其值得选。

units.source: Fearsome: I love making them rout. It's good, it's useful but dead allies have the same effect on enemies so maybe, just maybe, you can change it up for Executioner, Steel Brow or even Recovery.
units.zh: 威慑：我喜欢让敌人逃跑，它很不错，也很实用。不过队友阵亡对敌人的士气也有同样的效果，所以也许可以把它换成刽子手、钢铁额骨，甚至恢复体力。

units.source: ​Executioner could be a good perk to capitalize even more on your archers;
units.zh: 刽子手可以进一步利用弓手造成的伤势，是个不错的选择。

units.source: Steel Brow could make them nearly immune to head damage. I wouldn't go there, to be honest.
units.zh: 钢铁额骨可以让他们几乎不怕头部伤害，不过老实说，我不会这么选。

units.source: Recovery. Against undead hordes this perk would be incredible. The Black Monolith would've been easier (more like less hard) if I had this instead of Fearsome, since Undeads don't ever rout.
units.zh: 恢复体力：面对亡灵大军，这个特长会非常出色。如果当时用它代替威慑，黑色巨石就会更容易一些，或者说没那么难，毕竟亡灵根本不会溃逃。

units.source: Colossus. You barely get hit, when you do it deals minor damage.... BUT well, what if you could also be immune to injuries? That's basically Colossus on a 2-handed dude.
units.zh: 巨人体魄：你很少被打中，挨打时伤害也不大。但如果还能几乎不受伤呢？对双手武器手来说，巨人体魄大致就是这个作用。

units.source: Don't fight naked. That's kinda all there is to it.
units.zh: 别光着身子打架，基本就这么回事。

units.source: On a serious note tho, equipment is pretty straight forward.
units.zh: 认真说来，装备选择其实很直接。

units.source: Shield Brothers: heavy armor + helmet + weapon of choice + shield. (kite shields are better vs goblins, Heater Shields are better on a daily basis). Have DAGGERS as your backup weapon.
units.zh: 持盾弟兄：重甲、头盔、自选武器和盾牌。鸢形盾更适合对付地精，熨斗形盾则更适合日常使用。备用武器要带匕首。

units.source: Archers: Light armor. Helmet that doesn't mess up their vision. Level a couple tailors (I had 4 early on), they'll eventually make wolf armors and that's all you'll be needing. Also, bows. bows bows bows. Bows are SO much better than crossbows (xbows are better early on tho, since they have extra chance to hit)
units.zh: 弓手：轻甲，加上不影响视野的头盔。培养几个裁缝，我前期有 4 个，他们迟早会做出狼皮甲，这就够用了。还有弓，弓，还是弓！弓比弩好用得多；不过前期弩更好，因为它有额外命中加成。

units.source: Sargeant: heavy armor + banner + heavy helmet. Never engage in battle, but when/if it happens, you gotta survive.
units.zh: 军士：重甲、战旗、重型头盔。绝不要让他近战，但万一陷进去了，必须活下来。

units.source: 2-handed badass: Heavy armor, Heavy Helmet, Heavy underwear if possible. 2handed weapon of choice. AoE to victory. Have DAGGERS as your backup weapons.
units.zh: 双手武器猛男：重甲、重型头盔，能有重型内裤也来一条。再带上自选双手武器，靠范围攻击赢得胜利。备用武器要带匕首。

units.source: The Black Monolith is a superlategame raid you can make and get a SEXY piece of equipment out of... If you can survive the 47 undeads, being 4 priests (AoE fear and AoE poison), several vampires (I believe around 6-8?) and the stupidly large horde of heavy armored and tower-shielded Ancient Guards.
units.zh: 黑色巨石是大后期可以挑战的地点，能拿到一件漂亮得不行的装备。前提是你能从 47 个亡灵手里活下来：其中有 4 个祭司，会范围恐惧和范围毒雾；还有几个吸血鬼，我记得大概是 6-8 个，以及多得离谱、身披重甲、手持塔盾的古代卫士。

units.source: I did explain how to use The White Company to achieve success, but this raid deserves more in-depth thought.
units.zh: 我已经介绍了如何用白色战团取得胜利，不过这次攻坚值得更深入地讲解。

units.source: {#1}Archers and Sergeant in the very center. Guys on the RIGHT hand on the screen have the highest Melee Defense on the Company. As you get left it gets lower. Also, they're the only ones allowed to Swing (2h sword attack #3), the other guys only used Split (2h sword attack #2).{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}弓手和军士位于最中央。画面右侧的人近战防御最高，越往左越低。而且只有他们可以使用挥击，也就是双手剑第 #3 项攻击；其余人只用劈开，也就是双手剑第 #2 项攻击。{/#1}

units.source: This formation had as it's main objective to protect my archers and Sargeant from the Vampires. Everybody held the line while those engaged with vampires focused them hard. Archers are using bows because of high hit chance and 2 shots + overwhelm, making it easier for other brothers to score their own hits.
units.zh: 这个阵形的主要目的是保护弓手和军士免受吸血鬼攻击。所有人稳住战线，与吸血鬼接战的人则集中火力消灭它们。弓手用弓，是因为命中率高，而且每回合 2 次射击能叠加压制，方便其他弟兄打中目标。

units.source: Impossible to hit my archers, so they can rain arrows on vampires.
units.zh: 敌人打不到我的弓手，他们就可以放心向吸血鬼倾泻箭雨。

units.source: If ally routs (AoE fear Priests have) there's no empty space for them to run so they just skip turn (and don't get free-hit by enemies) until Sergeant can Rally again next turn.
units.zh: 即使队友因祭司的范围恐惧而溃逃，也没有空位可退，因此只会跳过回合，不会在逃跑时被敌人白打，等到下回合军士再次鼓舞就好。

units.source: Enemies spawn East and North of you. Securing a strong Southwest can guarantee an escape route later on. I had 4 guys barely surviving in the very end, ran all 4 of them south while the rest cleaned up the fight. (wish I knew about retreating to thin numbers lol)
units.zh: 敌人出现在你的东侧和北侧。守稳西南方向，就能为之后保留退路。最后我有 4 个人濒死，于是让这 4 个人全部向南撤，其他人负责扫尾。早知道可以用撤退分批削减敌人数就好了，哈哈。

units.source: Everybody is super-close to the Sergeant, so AoE fear fails often and Rally works almost every time on every member of the Company.
units.zh: 所有人都紧靠军士，所以范围恐惧经常失败，鼓舞也几乎每次都能影响全队成员。

units.source: {#1}After their vampires died and the enemy army was still collapsing I began to spread the formation outwards until I had a clear enough field.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}吸血鬼死光后，敌军仍在不断瓦解，我便开始向外扩展阵形，直到周围有足够的空地。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Used archers to strip Honor Guards from their armors (their health bars are nearly immune, their armor are not) setting up Berserk-chains for my fighters.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}用弓手削掉荣誉卫士的护甲。它们几乎不掉生命值，但护甲照样会损失，这就能让我的战士接连击杀，连续触发狂战。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Ran south with injured/low health characters (4 of them, especially due to Miasma) since the rest of the enemies were coming from the north.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}让受伤或生命值低的人向南撤。他们共有 4 人，主要是被瘴气伤到了，而其余敌人正从北面赶来。{/#1}

units.zh: {#1}扫尾，胜利，拿到一件好盔甲。唯一留下的永久伤势如下。{/#1}

units.source: Peace (or war, since we want more and more contracts!),
units.zh: 愿和平常在——还是战争常在吧，毕竟我们还想要更多委托！

units.source: Modeled after the 400 days old Expert Ironman Honey Stealers company that face successfully orcs, goblins and undead hordes.
units.zh: 这套配置以“偷蜜者”战团为蓝本：那是一支在专家铁人模式下存续了 400 天，成功对抗过兽人、地精和亡灵大军的战团。

units.source: Early Company rely on 2nd row for damage when shields bros keep the line.
units.zh: 前期靠第 2 排输出，持盾弟兄负责稳住战线。

units.source: Late company rely either on superior firepower or hack enemy to pieces with massed heavy troopers.
units.zh: 后期则依靠优势火力，或集中重装战士把敌人砍成碎片。

units.source: Sergeant - heavy armored support armed with polearm (long range melee weapon), his main role is to raise company morale and prevent routs, fight from backrow avoid engaging in personal face to face combat, high Resolve is necessary for this character
units.zh: 军士：穿重甲、持长柄武器的支援角色，主要负责提升全队士气、防止溃逃。他在后排作战，避免与敌人贴身交锋。这个角色必须有较高的意志。

units.source: Archers/Polearm users - ranged oriented character which main task is to eliminate enemy ranged troops and spellcasters, could be also used to weaken incoming lightly armored enemy troops and double as backrow polearm user, high Ranged and Melee skills are necessary for this character
units.zh: 弓手兼长柄武器手：以远程作战为主，首要任务是消灭敌方远程部队和施法者，也能削弱接近中的轻甲敌人，并兼任后排长柄武器手。这个角色需要较高的远程命中和近战命中。

units.source: Shield Bearer - typical defensive oriented soldier that serve as shield that protect the rest of company, uses shields and one handed weapons, no particular weakness
units.zh: 持盾卫士：典型的防御型战士，充当保护全队的屏障，使用盾牌和单手武器，没有明显短板。

units.source: Heavy Trooper - heavy armored soldier armed with Area of Attack 2 handed weapon, high potential for massive damage, high effectiveness against multiple targets
units.zh: 重装战士：身披重甲，使用具有范围攻击的双手武器，拥有很高的伤害潜力，尤其擅长对付多个目标。

units.source: Duelist - specialized soldier armed with one handed weapon but without using shield, great against single targets/lesser foes, highly mobile
units.zh: 决斗家：使用单手武器但不持盾的专精战士，擅长对付单个目标和较弱的敌人，机动性很高。

units.source: Guy who keep soldiers in line. With current build it benefit high level companies more (%increase) and increase more offence than defense. Still important for ow level companies because it essential to prevent routs.
units.zh: 负责稳住军心的人。按当时版本的配点，他的增益按百分比（%）计算，因此更有利于高等级战团，而且对进攻的提升大于防御。不过低等级战团也很需要他，因为防止溃逃至关重要。

units.source: {#1}Recommended Equipment:{/#1} Heavy armor and helmet, polearm of choice, dagger
units.zh: {#1}推荐装备：{/#1}重型盔甲与头盔、自选长柄武器、匕首。

units.source: {#1}Essential Perks:{/#1} Fortified mind, Rally the Troops, Sergeant, Footwork
units.zh: {#1}必要特长：{/#1}坚定心智、重振士气、军士、灵活步法。

units.source: Essential in fights against Orc War bosses as their Roar attack can easily break even experienced soldiers.
units.zh: 对抗兽人军阀时尤其重要，因为它的咆哮很容易让经验丰富的战士也失去斗志。

units.source: With current builds any trooper with average resole and Talent in it can be considered as a potential candidate for position. Having high melee skills and ranged defense is also a plus. This make Retired Soldiers and Swordsmen good candidates when Adventurous Noble not.
units.zh: 按这套配点，只要意志尚可，而且在这项属性上有天赋，就可以考虑担任军士。近战命中和远程防御较高也有帮助。因此，退伍军人和剑士是不错的人选，冒险贵族反而不适合。

units.source: {#1}Recommended Equipment:{/#1} Heavy armor and helmet, 1 handed weapon of choice, dagger
units.zh: {#1}推荐装备：{/#1}重型盔甲与头盔、自选单手武器、匕首。

units.source: {#1}Essential Perks:{/#1} Shield Expert, Brawny, Underdog, Battle Forged, Weapon of choice proficiency
units.zh: {#1}必要特长：{/#1}盾牌精通、壮硕、以少敌多、久经战阵，以及所选武器的精通特长。

units.source: Ranged character that doubles as polearm user. His main task is to eliminate enemy spellcasters and ranged units with secondary task to snipe enemy high damage units (two handers/polearm users, berserkers). Range is essential for this task so its preferred to use bows.
units.zh: 兼任长柄武器手的远程角色。首要任务是消灭敌方施法者和远程单位，其次是狙杀高伤害敌人，例如双手武器手、长柄武器手和狂战士。完成这些任务很依赖射程，因此优先用弓。

units.source: {#1}Recommended Equipment:{/#1} Light armor and helmet that nor reduce view range, 1 ranged weapon of choice (bow), polearm of choice, spare ammo
units.zh: {#1}推荐装备：{/#1}轻甲、不降低视野的头盔、1 件自选远程武器（弓）、自选长柄武器、备用弹药。

units.source: {#1}Optional Perks: {/#1} Backstabber, Fearsome, Bags and Belts, Quick hands, Killing Frenzy, Crippling Strikes
units.zh: {#1}可选特长：{/#1}背刺者、威慑、行囊与腰带、快手、杀戮狂热、致残打击。

units.source: notice Quick hands instead Crippling strikes, Quick hands make for more versatile character when also eliminate increased chance to wound your own troops when/if you use your archers to support your engaged units Commentary:
units.zh: 注意，这里用快手代替了致残打击。快手让角色的用途更多；若用弓手支援正在近战的队友，也不会再因致残打击而提高误伤己方造成伤势的概率。补充说明：

units.source: In early stage of game they serve more as melee units (as usually player can't afford costly Warbows and polearms are more reliable than low skill archers). Also enemy spellcasters rarely show early.
units.zh: 在游戏前期，他们更常充当近战单位，因为玩家通常买不起昂贵的战弓，而长柄武器比低命中的弓手更可靠；此外，前期也很少遇到敌方施法者。

units.source: pikes with Backstabber perk make solid early choice -high chance of hit
units.zh: 长枪配合背刺者，是前期可靠的选择，命中率很高。

units.source: long axes can be used to strip enemy from shields
units.zh: 长柄斧可以用来劈碎敌人的盾牌。

units.source: {#1}Recommended Equipment:{/#1} Heavy armor and helmet, 2 handed weapon of choice, dagger
units.zh: {#1}推荐装备：{/#1}重型盔甲与头盔、自选双手武器、匕首。

units.source: {#1}Essential Perks: {/#1}Reach advantage, Berserker, Brawny, Underdog, Battle Forged, Weapon of choice proficiency
units.zh: {#1}必要特长：{/#1}长兵优势、狂战、壮硕、以少敌多、久经战阵，以及所选武器的精通特长。

units.source: Best used in loose formation with enough space to perform multiple target strikes. Two handed swords are great for that task as their are accurate and have two multi strikes:Split and Swing.
units.zh: 最好采用松散阵形，留出足够空间使用多目标攻击。双手剑很适合这个任务：它的命中率高，而且有劈开和挥击两种多目标攻击。

units.source: Reach advantage is absolutely essential for multistrike build and berserk also is needed so at last 6. Armor at last more than 200 but more is better. Melee defense is important part and when you use Warbrand and lighter armor Nimble is really helpful. Remember if your soldier don't get hit in first place he don't need heavy armor.
units.zh: 对于多目标攻击配点，长兵优势必不可少，也需要狂战，因此至少要到 6 级。护甲至少应超过 200，越高越好。近战防御很重要；如果使用长刃战刀和较轻的护甲，轻灵会很有帮助。记住：如果战士根本不会被打中，就不需要靠厚重盔甲保命。

units.source: -melee defense to not get hit (high base plus Nimble and Reach advantage.
units.zh: —近战防御：靠较高的基础值，再加上轻灵和长兵优势，避免被击中。

units.source: -melee attack so he can reliable hit enemies (that why swords are good they have bonus hit chance) and buff his defense.
units.zh: —近战命中：确保能稳定打中敌人，进而提高自身防御。这也是剑好用的原因：它自带命中加成。

units.source: -fatigue so he can swing his sword a lot (Iron lungs and weapon proficiency or Recovery help a lot).
units.zh: —疲劳上限：让他能反复挥剑。铁肺、武器精通或恢复体力都很有帮助。

units.source: Rest is secondary. High HP is nice but better don't get hit in first place. Heavy armor in this case is mostly anti ranged (goblins and bandit xbows) and protection against enemy melee lucky hits - as you don't want your guy get hit as wounds can cause serious effects - lowering defense or max fatigue - heavy armor reduce greatly damage to HP and chance for wounds.
units.zh: 其余属性都属次要。生命值高固然好，但最好还是别被打中。这里的重甲主要用来抵御远程攻击，例如地精和强盗弩手，也防范敌人在近战中侥幸命中。你不会希望战士受伤，因为伤势可能带来严重后果，例如降低防御或疲劳上限；重甲能大幅减少生命伤害和受伤几率。

units.source: Warbrands are good against low health or unarmored targets, swords are best universal weapon, hammer against heavy armor and axe for lone wolves. If you give H. Trooper Quick hands he can carry shield and then switch to 2handers when in melee - it helps a lot against ranged but lower fatigue a little. Main danger are goblin Shamans and their spells, also nets and swamps as they lower defense or are tiresome.
units.zh: 长刃战刀适合对付生命值低或不穿护甲的目标；剑最通用，锤适合破重甲，斧则适合独自作战的人。若给重装战士选快手，他就能先持盾，接敌后再换双手武器。这对抵御远程攻击很有帮助，但会略微降低可用疲劳。主要威胁是地精萨满及其法术，还有网和沼泽：它们会降低防御或加重疲劳负担。

units.source: Soldier who specialize in singe target damage. More mobile than Heavy Troopers.
units.zh: 专精于单体伤害的战士，机动性比重装战士更高。

units.source: {#1}Recommended Equipment:{/#1} Medium armor and helmet, 1 handed weapon of choice, dagger
units.zh: {#1}推荐装备：{/#1}中型盔甲与头盔、自选单手武器、匕首。

units.source: {#1}Essential Perks: {/#1}Berserker, Brawny, Underdog, Nimble, Duelist, Weapon of choice proficiency
units.zh: {#1}必要特长：{/#1}狂战、壮硕、以少敌多、轻灵、决斗家，以及所选武器的精通特长。

units.source: Highly specialized troopers, they need high melee defense, decent ranged defense and high melee skill. As that Sellswords, Swordmaster and Retired Soldiers are preferred.
units.zh: 这些战士专精程度很高，需要较高的近战防御、不错的远程防御和较高的近战命中，因此优先考虑佣兵、剑术大师和退伍军人。

units.zh: {#1}https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mxsrPluqLec&t=392s{/#1}

units.source: wedge formation with enough space between Heavy Troopers to perform multi strikes.
units.zh: 采用楔形阵，在重装战士之间留出足够的空间，以便使用多目标攻击。

units.source: supporting troops (Shield Bearers, Duelist, Archers, Polearms users) stuffed behind.
units.zh: 支援部队，包括持盾卫士、决斗家、弓手和长柄武器手，都集中在后方。

units.source: Shield Bearers, Duelist fill the gap and concentrate damage on single targets when Heavy Troopers keep enemy busy and bleeding.
units.zh: 持盾卫士和决斗家填补空隙，集中攻击单个目标；重装战士则牵制敌人，持续造成伤害。

units.source: lack of Sergeant could turn into rout if enemy Warlord keep his Roar up.{#1/}{#2/}
units.zh: 如果没有军士，而敌方兽人军阀不断咆哮，队伍就可能溃逃。{#1/}{#2/}

units.source: back to flat area so Orc warriors wont push and take high ground.
units.zh: 背靠平地，避免兽人战士把我方推开后抢占高地。

units.source: high enough defense plus Reach advantage make my Heavy Troopers almost non hit-able (excluding that one on the bottom who has the lower defense and old type build - starting companion but at last he has plenty of HP).
units.zh: 足够高的防御加上长兵优势，让我的重装战士几乎不会被命中。最下方那人除外：他的防御较低，用的也是旧配点。他是初始老战友，不过至少生命值够多。

units.source: Duelist with named orc cleaver and hammer equipped Shield bearers fill the gaps and concentrate attacks.{#1/}{#2/}
units.zh: 持名贵兽人斩刀的决斗家和持锤的盾卫填补空隙，集中攻击。{#1/}{#2/}

units.source: zombies are resistant but have low damage output, skeletons are fragile but with better dps and weapons.
units.zh: 僵尸比较耐打，但输出低；骷髅较脆，却有更高的输出和更好的武器。

units.source: notice that soldiers get exhausted at the end of battle - perk Recovery or trait Iron lungs help a lot.
units.zh: 注意，到战斗结束时战士们已经筋疲力尽。恢复体力特长或铁肺特性对此很有帮助。

units.source: if enemy necromancers were still alive battle would take much longer.
units.zh: 如果敌方亡灵法师还活着，这场战斗会拖得更久。

units.source: Quick hands perk is very helpful for Heavy troopers as they can carry a kite shield to cover them against ranged fire.
units.zh: 快手对重装战士很有帮助：他们可以先拿鸢形盾，抵挡远程火力。

units.source: A few people asked to share my Duelist build so i figured I'd make a post with the builds i used this play-through. As an introduction i want to say, BB is really rich, these last 4 play through i have used very different party compositions and they all worked well. So don't take this as a guide but more like, hey, here's one more possibility.
units.zh: 有几个人想看看我的决斗家配点，于是我决定发帖，介绍这次游玩所用的各套配点。先说一句，《战场兄弟》的玩法真的很丰富：最近 4 局我用了差别很大的队伍配置，效果都不错。所以别把这篇当成攻略，就当是“嘿，还有这么一种玩法”。

units.source: Took me a while to do that because my first attempt at making hybrid Duelists didn't go well, i wasn't satisfied with what i did and it performed poorly.
units.zh: 拖了一阵子才写，是因为我第一次尝试打造混合型决斗家时并不顺利。我对自己的方案不满意，实战表现也很差。

units.source: Also as a reminder, hopefully this will convince more people it's perfectly possible to do well with average recruits since most of them are nothing extraordinary.
units.zh: 也顺便提醒一下：这些人多数都不是什么天赋出众的好苗子，希望这能让更多人相信，普通新兵也完全可以打得很好。

units.source: Famous for a killing power. Well tested on Veteran difficulty.
units.zh: 以强大的杀伤力闻名，已在老练难度下充分检验。

units.source: Facetanking and damage soaking, these guys aren't here to deal damage, they're here to control aggro and create windows of opportunity for the rest of the party. That is not to say they never attack, but it's not their primary role. In fact they can spend entire turns just taunting and raising shields. The fact that they're so tanky also allows them to charge at turtling enemies to disrupt their formation, and then hold their grounds until i can follow up with damage.
units.zh: 这些人负责正面扛伤，而不是输出。他们的任务是吸引敌人，为其他队员创造机会。这并不代表他们从不攻击，只是攻击并非首要职责；实际上，他们有时整回合都只在挑衅和举盾。他们足够耐打，也就能冲向抱团固守的敌人，打乱敌阵，然后守住位置，等我把输出接上。

units.source: Flanks have spears to control, push aggro center, and break formation to hunt Geists when the opportunity arises.
units.zh: 两翼持矛，负责控制敌人、把进攻引向中央，也会在有机会时脱离阵形去追杀怨魂。

units.source: Things i would possibly change : drop FA or Backstabber for Fortified Mind, need better base stats to do so. Would have liked to fit Indomitable in but it's simply too expensive with fatigue.
units.zh: 可能调整的地方：把快速适应或背刺者换成坚定心智，不过这需要更好的基础属性。本来还想塞进不屈，但它消耗的疲劳实在太多。

units.source: Went totally differently with this one compared to what i used to do. Technically he's just an average Marksman but with the ability to Rally. Found a good Retired Soldier with nice base stats so went for it. Recover to keep Rally going. Brawny because he's an old geezer and will eventually be even older so i need to compensate for the low fatigue. A better recruit would have Pathfinder instead. Nimble is at 33%. Quick hands because you never know when you're going to need an emergency banner+rally, and because nets.
units.zh: 这个人的培养思路与我过去完全不同。说白了，他就是一个能使用鼓舞的普通射手。我碰到了一名基础属性不错的退伍军人，就这么练了。恢复体力让他能持续鼓舞；选壮硕，是因为他已经是个老头，以后还会更老，需要弥补偏低的疲劳上限。换成资质更好的新兵，我会改选寻路者。轻灵的数值是 33%。选快手，一是因为你永远不知道什么时候得赶紧换出战旗再鼓舞，二是为了用网。

units.source: Pretty straightforward, i guess everyone is familiar with that one by now. No Gifted because Steel Brow, otherwise you're bolt food. Recover to keep them AoEs and berserk going.
units.zh: 这套相当直接，我想大家都已经很熟悉了。没选天赋异禀，是因为要留位置给钢铁额骨，否则就等着挨弩箭吧。恢复体力用来维持范围攻击和狂战带来的连续输出。

units.source: More personal that one, crazy headshots juggernaut. He has backstabber because like Greataxe users he AoE's very rarely. Doesn't need Recover because he's fine with tanks taunting and only using Pound, especially with iron lungs. Can't use berserk, too much fatigue needed. Could be possible if he came with better fatigue though, or i could have dropped his armor down but he doesn't have the luxury of Reach Advantage. Well to put it simply he's just one big brute crushing skulls.
units.zh: 这套更有个人特色，是个疯狂敲脑袋的重装猛男。他选了背刺者，因为和巨斧手一样，他很少使用范围攻击。他不需要恢复体力：有盾卫挑衅分担压力，自己只用重砸，尤其再加上铁肺，就已经够用了。狂战则用不起，疲劳消耗太大。如果他原本的疲劳上限更好，或许可以；也可以给他减轻护甲，不过他可没有长兵优势来撑防御。简单说，他就是一个专门砸碎脑袋的大块头。

units.source: Speaking of which if i ever find a Killer on the run (for 10% increase headshot) with iron lungs, good fatigue AND brute, my day will be made.
units.zh: 说到这里，要是我能招到一个既有铁肺、疲劳上限又好，还带蛮力的在逃杀人犯，靠这个背景再多 10% 的爆头概率，那我可就乐坏了。

units.source: Kind of a missed design tbh but he still does well. Specifically here to snipe Necros and well protected xbows. Realized too late he wouldn't be able to capitalize so much on throwing weapons.
units.zh: 老实说，这套设计有些失误，不过他表现仍然不错。他专门负责狙杀亡灵法师和受到严密保护的弩手。我醒悟得太晚，才发现他其实不太能发挥投掷武器的优势。

units.source: My main innovation for this playthrough and a lot of fun at that. Basically these guys do everything. Rain deathbolts, once frontlines clash rain deathaxes, and cut down the oveflow with swords. Duelist is crazy good, damage is through the roof, critical injuries on every hits. Squishy though, hence why they came with taunt tanks. Still able to hold their own a bit, even against Orc Warriors. No Quick Hands because i found during the flow of battle they already do well enough and i don't need the occasional extra AP on switch. Could have used Executionner instead of Gifted, but all of them are pretty average backgrounds and i needed more accuracy and defense, not more damage. Will do so once i start minmaxing my roster and send them to well deserve vacations. Nimble is between 25 and 40% depending on what's left in their inventory. Potentially could use padded leather armor instead of mail shirt for better nimble against bolts, i decided mail shirt because they often go into melee.
units.zh: 这是我这局最主要的新尝试，玩起来也很有趣。这些人基本什么都能干：先射出致命的弩箭，双方前排交锋后改扔致命的飞斧，再用剑砍倒漏过来的敌人。决斗家强得离谱，伤害极高，每次命中都能造成严重伤势。不过他们很脆，所以我才给他们配了负责挑衅的盾卫。即便如此，他们也有一定的独立作战能力，面对兽人战士都能撑一撑。我没选快手，因为实战中他们已经足够好用，我不需要偶尔换武器时省下的那点行动点。原本可以用刽子手替代天赋异禀，但他们的出身都很普通，我更需要命中和防御，而不是更多伤害。等以后开始追求队伍的极致属性，让这批人好好休假时，我会在接班人身上这样做。轻灵的数值会随背包里剩余物品变化，介于 25 和 40% 之间。也可以考虑把锁甲衫换成衬垫皮甲，让轻灵在对抗弩箭时更有效；我之所以选锁甲衫，是因为他们经常要近战。

units.source: That'll be all hopefully i didn't forget anything. Feel free to ask questions ~
units.zh: 大概就是这些，希望没有漏掉什么。有什么问题尽管问～

units.source: I am Diethelm. Marred into my mind I will not forget long as I am idle the battle on that snowy hill. There is narry a man with will and boldness enough to withstand the orc charge. A noble brother, Leonhart chattered his teeth against the monstrosity. A visage of doom, the orcs were. Their teeth bared beneath metal and their eyes - Gods the eyes! A fantastic blackness in those eyes. Ferocity is an understatement when standing 'fore an orc clad in his mail.
units.zh: 我是迪特赫尔姆。那座雪山上的战斗已经烙进脑海；只要闲下来，我就忘不了。鲜有人能有足够的意志和胆量，顶住兽人的冲锋。高贵的弟兄莱昂哈特面对那怪物，也禁不住牙齿打战。兽人简直就是毁灭的化身。铁甲下面獠牙毕露，还有那双眼睛——诸神啊，那双眼睛！漆黑得骇人。站在一个披着锁甲的兽人面前，“凶猛”二字都显得太轻。

units.source: A brother to my left and a brother to the right - Albricht and Leonhart. Albricht is still discontented about a quirrel long forgotten by my brothers. That was his way, but on the snowy evening the orcs fell upon us, I needed him close. I spoke underbreath 'Albricht you and I will have the time to meet Him another day. Not today, Albricht. Albricht are you with me?' The man bolstered seconds before the first orc came at me in a full tilt. Metal battering on wood and between the violence a long orcish blade swings and leaves a tall gash on my shoulder.
units.zh: 左右各有一名弟兄：阿尔布里希特和莱昂哈特。阿尔布里希特还在为一场大家早已忘记的争吵耿耿于怀。他就是那样的人。但在那个兽人扑来的雪夜，我需要他守在身旁。我压低声音说：“阿尔布里希特，你我改天还有的是机会去见祂。今天不行，阿尔布里希特。阿尔布里希特，你还跟着我吗？”他才鼓起勇气，第一个兽人就全速撞了上来。铁器猛砸木盾，混乱之中，一柄兽人的长刃挥来，在我肩上豁开一道长长的口子。

units.source: My shield was thrust back so quick, I lost myself a moment. There is a lot of weight in those greenskins.
units.zh: 盾牌猛地被顶了回来，快得让我一时失神。这些绿皮可真够沉的。

units.source: Dazed and gashed I regain clarity fast enough to duck another's axe. Heart racing and adrenaline hit and oh my, nothing will light your lantern quite as quick. With my cleaver I swung straight and true, repaying the orcs their hatred. One, two. Exposing skin underneath. They can bleed after all.
units.zh: 我头昏眼花，肩膀撕裂，却还是及时清醒过来，低头躲过另一把斧子。心跳狂乱，肾上腺素猛冲上来——老天，再没有什么能让人清醒得这么快。我挥起斩刀，直直劈向兽人，把它们的恨意原样奉还。一下，再一下，露出了甲片下的皮肉。原来它们也是会流血的。

units.source: Havard threw an axe from somewhere behind me, catching the first orc warrior who hit me. These things, these wretches - so foul and odorous - take everything without flinching. Albricht hammers another one while Leonhart works his Masterwork Manslayer, and shows that it's also good at slaying Orcs.
units.zh: 哈瓦德从我身后某处投来一把斧子，击中了最先撞我的那个兽人战士。这些东西，这些恶臭的孽畜，挨了什么都不退缩。阿尔布里希特正用锤子招呼另一个，莱昂哈特则挥舞着他的“精工杀人者”，证明那武器杀起兽人来也一样在行。

units.source: Another swing of the cleaver and another, the beast is too slow when he's up close. But there are more.
units.zh: 我又挥出一刀，再一刀。贴得这么近，那野兽就显得太慢了。但敌人还在涌来。

units.source: One in particular howls so loud and so deep he might be behind me and his immensity couldn't be mistaken. Sound like that liable to make Hans shit himself, the superstitious git. Mortgul, could it be?
units.zh: 其中一个吼得又响又沉，仿佛就在我背后；光听声音，就知道那家伙庞大得惊人。这样的吼声准能把汉斯那个迷信的蠢蛋吓得拉进裤子。难道是莫特古尔？

units.source: I catch myself before losing focus. I cleave and I cut at everything behind those iron slabs only an orc could call a shield. I see him finally as he attacks from behind the wall he carries. Bloodstained and lost helm. He is hopefully broken. No time to think.
units.zh: 我及时收住心神，继续劈砍那些铁板后面的一切——也只有兽人才会把那玩意儿叫盾牌。它从自己扛着的铁墙后出手时，我终于看清了它：浑身是血，头盔也没了。希望它已经撑不住了。没空多想。

units.source: Dodge. Dodge. Thank the fates he is so clumsy and slow.
units.zh: 躲开，再躲开。感谢命运，它这么笨拙，这么迟缓。

units.source: Suddenly the top of my shield splinters. Then I am naked before the storm.
units.zh: 盾牌上缘突然炸成碎片。转眼间，我赤裸裸地暴露在风暴面前。

units.source: I lead my cleaver to its throat. Unburdened by my shield, the cleaver does it's job taking the beast's head.
units.zh: 我把斩刀送向它的喉咙。没了盾牌的负担，斩刀干净利落地砍下了野兽的脑袋。

units.source: Accomplishment is short lived as his mass buckles and falls, for a terrible one takes his place. This must be him, Mortgul. Were I Albricht, I may have wavered here, but as long as there is one brother kicking behind me I shall never falter.
units.zh: 那庞大的身躯屈膝倒地，我却只来得及得意一瞬，因为一个更可怕的家伙顶了上来。准是它了，莫特古尔。换作阿尔布里希特，此刻也许会动摇。但只要身后还有一名弟兄站着，我就绝不退缩。

units.source: Mortgul carries a heavy excuse for a thumper, nails throughout its length. I am taken aback also by his armor. Gods! The thing adorned himself with heads. Fresh heads of men, blood still in, they leer with looks of terror.
units.zh: 莫特古尔拎着一根勉强能叫棍棒的沉重家伙，上面钉满了长钉。它的铠甲也让我倒吸一口气。诸神啊！那东西竟拿人头当装饰。新鲜的人头，血还没流干，恐惧的神情僵在脸上，直直瞪着我。

units.source: An axe flies overhead. It catches the mark, and then another. Hans?
units.zh: 一把斧子从头顶飞过，正中目标，接着又是一把。汉斯？

units.source: No matter, I bring my metal down with my full weight and damnit I had to miss.
units.zh: 管不了那么多。我压上全身重量劈出一刀——该死，偏偏砍空了。

units.source: My limbs are tired, and my shoulder gives when I attempt again to strike. Damn my body that it shouldn't be stronger.
units.zh: 四肢已经乏力，再次挥刀时，肩膀也撑不住了。该死的身子，怎么就不能再强壮一点。

units.source: Before me it seems are black iron walls and from behind an arm extends in a wild arc I didn't anticipate.
units.zh: 眼前仿佛尽是漆黑的铁墙，一条胳膊忽然从后面伸出来，划出一道我完全没料到的凶狠弧线。

units.source: Ugh! the pain of ribs breaking and clobbered without being able to do anything is saddly too familiar. But this one was especially blunt and I feared I might meet my maker after all.
units.zh: 呃！肋骨断裂的痛，被人狠砸却无力还手的滋味，可悲地熟悉。但这一击格外沉重，我真怕自己到底还是要去见造物主了。

units.source: And the fates oh my lord oh my angel must've been watching. Or is it that my brothers on left and right flank had the best of their ugglies? Wouldn't you know it that Gisbert took hammer to the side of Mortgul. A clean dent breaks the armor and blood pools from somewhere within. Another hammer meets a severed head on the back of Mortgul, goes through that and into the crusted mail beneath. Sigfried, my savior.
units.zh: 命运啊，我的主，我的天使，一定在看顾我。又或是左右的弟兄终于解决了各自的丑八怪？只见吉斯贝尔特一锤砸中莫特古尔的侧身，甲胄凹裂，鲜血从里面涌出来。另一柄锤子砸上它背后挂着的人头，穿过断颅，打进下方结着硬痂的锁甲。西格弗里德，我的救星。

units.source: And there are more of the axes. Three axe swings total and maybe a fourth in time.
units.zh: 斧子也接连劈来。一共三下，也许还赶得上第四下。

units.source: I find strength somewhere within and cleave a coup de gras.
units.zh: 我不知从哪里又挤出一股力气，挥下了致命的最后一刀。

units.source: There are no cheers. There are no hugs. Albricht is too fallen along with another. I don't remember the Greenhorn's name or his face.
units.zh: 没有欢呼，也没有拥抱。阿尔布里希特也倒下了，还有另一个人。那个新人的名字和面孔，我已经记不清了。
